jobs.title: Associate Director, Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Planned Parenthood is the nation’s leading provider and advocate of high\-quality, affordable sexual and reproductive health care for all people, as well as the nation’s largest provider of sex education. Planned Parenthood organizations serve all people with care and compassion, with respect, and without judgment, striving to create equitable access to health care. Through health centers, programs in schools and communities, and online resources, Planned Parenthood is a trusted source of reliable education and information that allows people to make informed health decisions. We do all this because we care passionately about helping people lead healthier lives. Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) is a 501(c)(3\) charitable organization that supports the independently incorporated Planned Parenthood affiliates, which operate non\-profit health centers across the U.S. PPFA also works to educate the public on and advocate for issues of sexual and reproductive health. Formed as the advocacy and political arm of Planned Parenthood Federation of America, Planned Parenthood Action Fund is a separate non\-profit membership organization tax\-exempt under section 501(c)(4\). The Action Fund engages in educational, advocacy, and limited electoral activity, including grassroots organizing, legislative advocacy, and voter education in furtherance of the Planned Parenthood mission. Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) and Planned Parenthood Action Fund seek a dynamic and effective Associate Director, Information Security Engineer. This job reports directly to the Dir, Security Operations in the Information Security division of PPFA. The Office of Information Security provides the strategy and implementation of the information security program that safeguards the data entrusted to Planned Parenthood by its patients, supporters, donors, and staff. ### **Purpose:** The Security Engineer manages Information Technology security protections with the goal of protecting PPFA from and reducing the impact of security incidents and system compromises for the organization. This position provides security monitoring, event investigation and analysis, and countermeasure proposals on a 24x7 basis along with providing support and guidance to Tier I Analysts, will provide technical assistance for Tier II \& III incidents as assigned, and is responsible to directly interface with the InfoSec Operations Team, Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) and IT Managed Service Provider (MSP) as it relates to security event architecture, collection, management, reporting, and alerting within PPFA’s SIEM Platforms. ### **Engagement:** The Security Engineer will engage with InfoSecOps, InfoSec, ITOps/MSP, the MSSP, ATS and staff within both PPFA and Affiliates. ### **Delivery:** The Security Engineer will deliver by identifying, implementing, and maintaining Information Security toolsets, primarily focused on SIEM, to protect the organization; interfacing with IT Ops to ensure proper security event logging setup; and, where applicable, supporting the Information Security SIEM management needs of PPFA and Affiliates. Act as a Subject Matter Expert for PPFA’s SIEM (currently Splunk) and be able to configure, manage, operate, and administer the platform from a managed SIEM perspective. * SIEM Security Monitoring – Provide security monitoring and threat/risk analysis in a 24/7 environment. * SIEM Event Filtering – Monitor \& ensure established processes for event identification are followed, and, where required, make recommendations for new or refined event filtering, ensuring all updates are completed. * SIEM Event Investigation \& Assignment – Monitor \& ensure established processes are followed for collecting relevant data and performing the necessary levels of analysis on that data. Ensure events are assigned appropriately. * Tier II Event Escalations \- Follow an established process for handling Tier II escalations, identifying the source of the escalation (MSSP, MSP, Affiliate, or other) and the appropriate triage and documentation processes. * Creating and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the Information Security Ops group, and providing recommendations on security process improvements * Support and engage on complex security tool\-specific tasks with the assistance and guidance of management, vendor \& MSSP resources * Assist in Vulnerability Assessments setup, scanning, analysis, and remediations, working with IT Ops staff and corporate vendors as needed in correcting errors and alerts as found with the IT infrastructure systems. * Assist in IR incidents as assigned by management * All other duties as assigned ### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):** * Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of industry experience * Passion for working on newer technologies and exploring the security domain. * Independent decision\-making capabilities, especially in identifying analysis tracks for escalated events, analysis assignments, and escalation decisions ranging from a base Tier I event to Incident Response\-level remediations. * Experience in compliance requirements and industry standards like PCI, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, CSF, MITRE ATT\&CK, ITIL, COBIT, Sarbanes\-Oxley, and SANS 20\. * UNIX, AIX \& Solaris, Linux, Windows Server Operating Systems * Network/System Intrusion Detection or Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS) * Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) * Vulnerability scanner/Penetration testing systems * Wireless Networking * Switches/Routers, Firewalls (basic configuration) * TCP/IP networking, VPN, VLAN, NAT, and security concepts * Software \& Hardware Asset Management * Security threat and attack countermeasures * Experience conducting forensic analytical studies and investigations * Flexibility and ability to adapt to quickly changing priorities and ambiguous situations * A deep commitment to Planned Parenthood’s mission of promoting Sexual and Reproductive Health $125,000 \- $130,000 a year **Travel:**(0\-10% travel as needed) Planned Parenthood's cultural ethos, "In This Together", reflects our commitment to building a workplace culture that fosters belonging, promotes learning throughout the employee lifecycle, and recognizes individual contributions to our mission. Planned Parenthood Federation of America participates in the E\-Verify program. Planned Parenthood Federation of America is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a non\-discriminatory work environment, and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Planned Parenthood is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Banking
jobs.description: *PuduVison* is a financial technology company building software that helps banks, credit unions, and fintech businesses keep financial records accurate and resolve operational issues faster. Our platform, PuduVison Reconcile, connects banking and payment systems, compares transaction records, flags discrepancies, and gives finance teams the tools to investigate and resolve them. We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to develop the services, integrations, and data processing workflows behind the platform. **About the Role** This is a mid\-level individual contributor position with ownership of clearly scoped features—from discussing requirements and designing solutions through implementation, testing, and production release. You’ll work with backend and frontend engineers, a product manager, and a shared QA engineer. Senior engineers will support you with larger architectural decisions and unfamiliar technical challenges. This role suits someone who enjoys working with data, building reliable integrations, and investigating why systems produce unexpected results. **What You’ll Do** * Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI. * Build integrations with banking platforms, payment processors, and financial data providers. * Implement transaction ingestion, validation, normalization, and reconciliation workflows. * Develop matching rules and exception queues that help operations teams investigate discrepancies. * Build background jobs with retries, duplicate prevention, and clear failure handling. * Design PostgreSQL schemas, write migrations, and improve query performance. * Handle transaction corrections, late\-arriving events, and historical data reprocessing. * Implement permissions and audit histories for sensitive operational actions. * Write automated tests covering financial calculations, integration failures, and recovery scenarios. * Collaborate with frontend engineers on APIs for reporting and investigation tools. * Monitor production services, investigate incidents, and address their underlying causes. * Document technical decisions, integration behavior, and operational procedures. **What You’ll Bring** * Approximately three or more years of professional software development experience, or equivalent experience delivering production applications. * Practical backend development experience with Python or a comparable language. * Experience building REST APIs and integrating third\-party services. * Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data modeling. * Familiarity with asynchronous processing, background jobs, and webhook handling. * An understanding of data validation, transaction boundaries, and duplicate prevention. * Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive data. * Experience using Git, reviewing code, and writing automated tests. * The ability to investigate problems across application services, databases, and external systems. * Clear written and spoken English and effective remote collaboration skills. * Experience taking a defined feature from requirements through production release. A computer science degree is welcome but not required. Previous banking or fintech experience is helpful, but we also welcome engineers who have built dependable, data\-intensive applications in other industries. **Nice to Have** * Experience with reconciliation, payment processing, transaction reporting, or ledger systems. * Familiarity with monetary precision, currencies, time zones, and settlement dates. * Experience with FastAPI or Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, and Docker. * Knowledge of event\-driven systems, message queues, and idempotent operations. * Experience building tools for investigating data discrepancies. * Familiarity with application monitoring, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. You don’t need experience with every tool or domain listed to apply. **Our Technology Stack** Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. Our frontend applications use React and TypeScript. **Compensation and Working Arrangements** * **Base salary: $135,000–$165,000 USD annually**, before taxes, paid twice monthly. * **Annual performance bonus target: 8% of base salary**, dependent on company and individual performance. Bonus payments are variable and not guaranteed. * Full\-time, permanent W\-2 employment. * Remote work within approved U.S. employment locations. * A 40\-hour workweek, Monday through Friday. * Flexible start and finish times, with availability from **12:00–4:00 p.m. Eastern Time** for collaboration. * A business\-hours support rotation, approximately one week every six weeks, with reduced feature work during that period. * No overnight on\-call rotation or scheduled evening or weekend work for this position. * Up to two company\-paid U.S. team gatherings annually. Your offer will reflect relevant technical skills, production development experience, and demonstrated feature ownership. Compensation is reviewed annually. Benefits are separate from cash compensation. **Benefits** * Medical coverage from day one, with 90% of employee premiums and 60% of eligible dependent premiums covered. * Fully company\-paid employee dental and vision premiums. * A 401(k) plan after 90 days, with an immediately vested employer match on the first 4% of eligible pay contributed. * 20 vacation days annually, plus 10 paid sick days, 11 company holidays, and two floating holidays. * 12 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment. * Company\-paid basic life and disability insurance. * A company\-provided laptop and peripherals, plus a one\-time $750 home\-office allowance. * $75 monthly internet reimbursement. * Up to $1,500 annually for approved professional development and three paid learning days. * An employee assistance program and $50 monthly reimbursement toward eligible wellness expenses. * Structured, paid onboarding with an assigned engineering buddy. **How We Work** We work in two\-week development cycles, keep meetings focused, and document decisions to support asynchronous collaboration. Engineers participate in product discussions and help identify edge cases before implementation. For our team, that means thinking through what happens when a banking partner sends a corrected transaction, a data feed arrives late, or two systems report different amounts for the same payment. We build features that make these situations visible and give users a clear path to resolution. You’ll have room to work independently, with teammates available for pairing, design discussions, and troubleshooting. We value realistic commitments, maintainable software, and respect for personal time. **Your First 90 Days** * **First 30 days:** Learn the platform and data model, understand our development and release process, and ship a small improvement with support. * **By 60 days:** Deliver a scoped integration or reconciliation feature, including tests, documentation, and production monitoring. * **By 90 days:** Lead a medium\-sized backend feature with appropriate senior input and contribute an improvement to data accuracy, processing reliability, or investigation tools. Success is measured by delivery quality, reliable operation, effective collaboration, and useful outcomes for customers. **Interview Process** * A 25\-minute introductory conversation about your background, expectations, and working arrangements. * A 45\-minute interview with the Engineering Manager focused on previous projects and feature ownership. * A 75\-minute practical technical session using a sample application with simulated transaction data. * A 45\-minute team conversation covering collaboration and a lightweight system design discussion. No unpaid take\-home project is required. We aim to complete the process within two to three weeks, with time for your questions at every stage. **How to Apply** Submit your resume in English. Links to LinkedIn, GitHub, or relevant work are welcome but optional. A cover letter is not required. Pay: $135,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Customer Delivery Lead
jobs.description: ### Our Mission Salt AI is building the intelligence layer for the enterprise, starting with life sciences. In a world where AI is fragmented across models, tools, and data silos, Salt unifies them through a compliance\-first orchestration platform that lets regulated organizations deploy AI securely, at scale, and with confidence. We're creating the backend systems that power real\-world AI workflows across drug discovery, clinical development, and commercial operations. Our platform turns complex, regulated environments into intelligent, adaptive systems where autonomous AI agents operate in harmony with existing infrastructure. ### About the Role As a Customer Delivery Lead, you own our most strategic enterprise deployments end to end — from initial scoping through production go\-live and customer self\-sufficiency. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, you'll work with leading pharma, biotech, investment banking, and energy enterprises deploying Salt into demanding SaaS, VPC, and on\-prem environments. This is a senior, judgment\-heavy role. You define what we're building, negotiate what we're not, direct the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts, and hold the line when a customer pushes to expand scope mid\-engagement. You'll keep engagement detail current in our existing AI\-first project management flow (Slack Notion Linear), where engineers groom their own tickets — so your time goes to scoping and direction, not ticket administration. ### The Role (What You'll Be Doing) * Scope engagements down to one or two named workflows with fixed timelines, and drive customer stakeholders to converge on them quickly. * Define the engagement exit before work begins: what customer self\-sufficiency looks like, written down and agreed. * Own SOW terms and the deal scope boundary — including the authority to decline out\-of\-scope asks from senior customer stakeholders. * Run post\-engagement debriefs and drive field learning back into product and platform priorities. * Provide and leadership, prioritization, and technical direction to the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts. * Lead executive communication with customer sponsors throughout the engagement lifecycle. * Stay engaged after go\-live on the technical outcome — adoption depth and scoping the next workflow. Sales owns the account relationship and review cadence. * Partner with Sales on expansion: they lead the pursuit, you control what can be committed on scope, timeline, and capacity. * Own the SOW Approval Gate on new and expansion business — no contract or SOW goes to a customer without your sign\-off on scope, timeline, and capacity. * Build reusable delivery patterns — templates, integration components, and reference architectures that make each subsequent engagement faster. * Work with the account's Executive Advisor to bring domain expertise into scoping and validate outputs where correctness depends on it. ### Requirements \- Core Skills (Must Have) * 5\+ years owning complex enterprise technical deployments end to end — as a forward deployed engineer, technical program manager, solutions architect, or delivery lead at a technical consultancy or enterprise software company. * Technical fluency: enough depth in cloud architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and integration patterns to scope work credibly and direct engineers without needing translation. Engineering or technical background required. * Scope discipline: demonstrated ability to hold a line against pressure from senior stakeholders, and the judgment to know when holding is right. * Written communication and document hygiene: scopes, exit criteria, and decisions live in writing, not in your head. * Executive presence: credible in the room with VP\- and C\-level customer sponsors at large enterprises. * Comfort with ambiguity: our customers often don't know their highest\-value use case when we arrive, and finding it is part of the job. ### Preferred/Bonus Skills (Nice To Have) * Experience with on\-premise, VPC, or air\-gapped deployments in regulated industries — pharma, life sciences, financial services, or government. * Familiarity with GxP, HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar compliance and validation frameworks. * Background at a company running a forward deployed engineering model. * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML workflows, model deployment, or agent orchestration. * Track record turning one\-off engagements into repeatable delivery motions. ### What Makes You A Great Fit * You measure success by whether the customer is actually using what you built — not whether it shipped. * You'd rather say no early than deliver a bloated engagement late. * You're energized by walking into a messy enterprise environment and finding the one workflow that matters most. * You're comfortable being the most senior person in the room on delivery, and the person accountable when it goes sideways. * You want to build the function, not just work in it — this is the first Customer Delivery Lead at Salt, and the patterns you set become how we operate. * You're excited to apply your skills to AI in life sciences and support teams doing high\-impact scientific work. ### Perks And Benefits * Competitive salary based on location and experience. * Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, mental health. * Fully remote role, collaborating primarily within U.S. time zones. **Based in Southern California, Salt AI is pioneering the future of life sciences with advanced AI. Founded in 2024 by Aber Whitcomb and Jim Benedetto—veterans of MySpace, Jam City, Gravity, and Core Scientific—our leadership team brings over 15 years of collaboration. We’re not just building products, but transforming what’s possible in research and discovery. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to an inclusive team. If you’re excited about shaping the future of AI in life sciences, we'd love to connect with you.**

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Python and AWS
jobs.description: About Peregrine Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. People first. Ownership always. We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will carry analytical questions for a federal agency from the data to a defensible, documented answer. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a remote position, although a hybrid arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area with openness to a variable commuting cadence is preferred. Wherever you work from, occasional travel to DC is part of the job. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. Your first project Your first project will likely have you transforming client data, structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured, into analytic processes and outcomes that help drive mission\-critical initiatives. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Frame analytical questions with the people who own the mission, and turn them into designs that can actually be tested. * Build analyses and models in Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) on cloud\-native data platforms hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS). * Build models that earn their place: forecasting, classification, risk scoring, and anomaly detection matched to the question, the data, and the scrutiny a federal decision has to survive. * Design the evaluation that shows a model is fit for a client environment, with baselines, validation designs, error analysis, documented limits, and documentation that lets someone else verify your results. * Build analytical features and datasets from large, messy, document\-heavy corpora, including text extracted with Amazon Textract and analyzed with foundation models through Amazon Bedrock. * Harden one\-off notebooks into repeatable, reviewed analytical pipelines. * Put findings in front of decision\-makers in plain language, with visuals that carry the argument instead of decorating it. * Use artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted analysis as standard practice, with language models and coding assistants across the lifecycle and your judgment on top. Adaptability and a demonstrated capacity to learn new concepts, systems, and tools are what keep you ahead of program needs as projects complete and priorities shift. Who you are You are rigorous about method and honest about uncertainty: when the evidence supports a narrower claim, you make the narrower claim. You care what the data is for, not just what it contains, and you would rather spend a day understanding the process that produced a number than a week modeling it wrong. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. What you bring* A working command of statistics and machine learning applied to real operational data, not just curated coursework sets. * The engineering habits that make analysis trustworthy: version control, reproducible pipelines, tested transformations, and documentation someone else can follow. * The communication craft to make a technical result understandable to the people who depend on it. * The precision to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional. When we talk Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. What we offer You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. What we commit to As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of applied data science or statistical modeling experience * Bachelor's degree * Strong working command of Python and SQL * Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning, and model validation * Familiarity with cloud\-based data and analytics services on AWS * Ability to carry an analysis from question to defensible, documented answer * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel Preferred* Master's degree in a relevant field * Experience with modern data tools and platforms (Amazon Aurora, Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\) with Apache Iceberg, AWS Glue, or Trino) * Experience applying large language models to analytical work (Amazon Bedrock or comparable services) * Data\-visualization craft, from chart design through dashboards and charting libraries * Federal information technology experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $78,000 to $147,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, Quality Assurance
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Director/Senior Director, Quality Assurance**Department:** Quality **Reports to:** CEO **Location:** Onsite, 2\-3 days/week – Berkeley, CA **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Bonus/Equity:** Eligible About Azalea Azalea Therapeutics is enabling precision genome engineering directly inside the body, with an initial focus on creating cancer immunotherapies *in vivo*.Azalea is pioneering a new way to turn a person’s own T cells into a powerful cancer therapy — directly inside the body. Instead of removing cells and manipulating them in a lab, we use precision genome editing tools to engineer T cells where they already live. At the center of our approach are Enveloped Delivery Vehicles, or EDVs. As highly selective couriers, EDVs are designed to specifically locate T cells within the patient and deliver our genome engineering cargo. Once inside the cell, the anti\-cancer agent is inserted into a precise site in the genome, ensuring safe and potent modifications to fortify the T cells against cancers. **Why this matters:*** We aim to make cell therapy faster and more accessible by avoiding complex manufacturing outside the body. * Our platform is designed for precision, so the right cells are safely programmed to effectively fight cancer. * This technology has the potential to treat a wide range of cancers with a streamlined, scalable process. **Our goal is simple:** develop next\-generation delivery technologies to bring genetic engineering and cell therapies to more patients. How We Work Azalea is building ambitious science in a fast\-moving environment. The people who thrive here are accountable, adaptable, rigorous, humble, and direct. Across roles and functions, we look for team members who demonstrate the following:* **Outcome Ownership \-** We own results, close loops, and follow through without needing to be prompted. We take responsibility for moving work forward and making sure important decisions, deliverables, and handoffs do not fall through the cracks. * **Comfort with Ambiguity \-** We operate in an early\-stage environment where information may be incomplete and priorities may evolve. We clarify quickly, make thoughtful decisions with the information available, and adapt without unnecessary drama. * **High Standards, Low Ego \-** We care deeply about the quality of the work and the impact it can have for patients. We raise the bar while staying humble, direct, and open to feedback. * **Collaboration and Candor \-** We share context early, communicate clearly, partner across functions, and operate with transparency. We believe strong collaboration requires both trust and direct communication. The Opportunity The Director/Senior Director, Quality Assurance will be Azalea’s first dedicated Quality Assurance hire and will build the QA function required to support external manufacturing, GMP readiness, regulatory interactions, and future clinical supply. This is a hands\-on leadership role for a Quality Assurance leader who can establish phase\-appropriate and right\-sized systems in an early\-stage company while maintaining rigorous standards for patient safety, data integrity, and regulatory compliance. The role will partner closely with CMC, Process Development, Analytical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and CDMO partners and consultants to advance AZA\-2509 and pipeline programs toward first\-in\-human clinical development. Key Responsibilities* Build and lead Azalea’s Quality Assurance function, including the quality strategy, operating model, roadmap, and resourcing plan appropriate for an early\-stage biotechnology company advancing toward first\-in\-human studies. * Establish, implement, and continuously improve a phase\-appropriate Quality Management System, including SOPs, document control, training, deviation and CAPA management, change control, risk management, vendor qualification, batch record review, product disposition, audits, complaints, and quality metrics. * Serve as the QA business partner to CMC, Process Development, Analytical Development, External Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Program Team leaders to ensure quality considerations are embedded into program planning and execution. * Lead QA oversight of external consultants, CDMOs, testing laboratories, and other GxP vendors, including quality agreements, vendor qualification, audit planning, issue escalation, and ongoing performance management. * Establish and execute batch release and disposition processes for development, engineering, GMP, and future clinical materials, including review of batch records, deviations, investigations, analytical data packages, certificates of analysis, and supporting documentation. * Provide QA leadership for EDV and AAV manufacturing and analytics, including phase\-appropriate controls for process development, analytical method development, pilot runs, engineering runs, and GMP manufacturing readiness. * Define and maintain quali ill be commensurate with experience, qualifications, training and market. * This role is eligible for annual performance bonuses, equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, retirement plan with company match, and paid time off. If applicable, Azalea will provide a California applicant privacy notice describing categories of information collected, purposes, retention, and rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA).**Job Description Disclaimer:** This job description may change at any time based on business needs. It is not a contract and does not create a promise of employment for any particular duration. **Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies:** Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Azalea Therapeutics through this page. jobs.title: Entry Level Water/Wastewater Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** About this opportunity Laberge Group, a 60\+ year fixture in New York State municipal engineering, is now part of Artheon and the Trilon Group. We're looking for an Associate Engineer to start a career in municipal water and wastewater engineering, working alongside licensed engineers on real infrastructure projects for Capital District municipalities. This role includes a seat in Blueprint, Artheon's early career development program for engineers with 0\-4 years of experience. Over six months you'll get structured mentorship, exposure to project delivery, and a clear path toward EIT certification and PE licensure. About Artheon Artheon is a trusted engineering and consulting firm offering services that rival large organizations while maintaining the personalized client relationships of a boutique firm. With expertise spanning civil/site engineering, environmental permitting, transportation infrastructure, construction management, and advanced surveying technologies, we are committed to delivering high\-quality, timely solutions to local, state, and federal clients. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Assist project engineers with calculations, drawings, and technical documentation for water and wastewater projects * Support field data collection, surveying, and site investigations under supervision * Learn municipal engineering fundamentals, including NYSDOH, DEC, and EFC regulatory processes * Take on increasing project responsibility as skills and experience develop * Participate in firm\-supported preparation for the FE exam and EIT certification ### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise** * B.S. in Civil or Environmental Engineering (recent graduate or graduating within the next several months) * No PE or EIT required. Active pursuit of EIT certification within the first year is expected * Familiarity with AutoCAD Civil 3D or similar design software preferred * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Willingness to learn municipal water and wastewater engineering fundamentals ### **Benefits** The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. Artheon offers a competitive compensation package including medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, educational assistance program and paid time off/parental leave. ### **About Artheon** Deliver transformative infrastructure solutions that strengthen communities, drive sustainable growth, and accelerate our people’s careers—to provide value added services for our clients by combining local knowledge with national expertise.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Environments & Post-Training
jobs.description: **About Hillclimb** ------------------- Hillclimb works with the world's best researchers, scientists, and engineers to teach AI to think like them so that it has the means to improve itself. We're a founding team of former DeepMind \& quant researchers backed by Garry Tan, Jeff Dean, Tier 1 VCs \& angel investors from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, SpaceXAI \& Meta Superintelligence Labs. We achieved SOTA for math shortly after graduating YC. **About this role:** -------------------- You're work will consist of the following and many more: * Turn ML research problems into environments that reward a model for real progress and good research taste * Test whether each environment's reward is repeatable and tracks the quality of the work it scores * Build systems that create environments at scale and catch broken ones before they reach training * Run post\-training experiments to find which environments are trainable **Preferred Experience:** ------------------------- * Experience with LLMs, RL, RLHF/RLAIF, RLVR, post\-training, evals, graders, synthetic data, model training, or coding agents * Understanding of what makes a reward evaluation trustworthy, and how models exploit one that is not * Previous experience in designing automated systems for building, validating, and quality checking environments. **Benefits:** ------------- * Extremely competitive salary and equity * Health, Dental, Vision insurance * Competitive 401k match * Free lunch and dinner

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI-Platform
jobs.description: **About Roger** --------------- Roger is an AI platform that frees home health clinicians from paperwork so they can focus on what matters: delivering life\-changing care to our most vulnerable elderly patients in the comfort of their homes. Backed by leading healthcare investors like SignalFire, we've powered millions of visits, deployed to thousands of clinicians, and we're just getting started. **Why This Role Exists** ------------------------ Roger's AI platform sits at the center of how clinicians and admin staff document care. The product decisions we make directly impact whether a nurse gets home in time for dinner or spends another hour on paperwork. We need a Product Manager who feels the weight of that and is energized by it. This isn't a "write tickets and attend standups" role. You'll be deeply embedded with clinicians, agency operators, and our engineering team to identify the problems worth solving and ship solutions that make a real operational impact. This is an early product hire with real ownership over product direction and the opportunity to shape how product is done at Roger as we scale. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Live in the customer's world:** Talk to clinicians and agency leaders every week. Understand their workflows deeply, not abstractly. * **Own product discovery and direction:** Identify the highest\-impact problems, translate customer needs into clear specs, and define what success looks like. * **Partner closely with engineering:** Work side by side with engineers to ship high\-quality solutions quickly. Stay involved from spec through launch. * **Work cross\-functionally:** Collaborate with sales, customer success, and operations to validate priorities and ensure what we ship works in the field. * **Drive outcomes, not output:** Define success metrics, measure real usage, and iterate relentlessly. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of product management experience in an early\-stage or high\-growth startup environment. * Technical background: Whether through engineering, CS, or hands\-on experience building with technical teams, you can go deep with engineers and have meaningful conversations about AI/ML systems. * First principles thinker: You break problems down to their fundamentals rather than defaulting to how things have been done before. * Strong customer instincts: You're in the field, on calls, and in the data constantly because you know you can't build great products from a conference room. * Experience owning workflow\-heavy or operational products where the details matter. * Comfort making tradeoffs with incomplete information and moving fast without sacrificing quality. * Clear communicator: You can align a room and write a spec that engineers actually want to read. * High ownership mentality and comfort operating in ambiguity. * Mission motivated: You care about healthcare and are excited to build products that genuinely change clinicians' lives. **Why Join Us?** Platinum health, dental, and vision insurance Unlimited PTO Retirement: 401(k) plan Unmatched career growth opportunity as an early product hire Make a tangible difference in the lives of clinicians and patients Work on a mission that matters, backed by AI innovation and top\-tier investors **Make a Real Difference \- Hear from our Users:** *“If I had to give Roger a rating out of 10, I’d give it an 11! You guys changed my life!!” \- G.M. from San Francisco, Registered Nurse* *“Roger AI saves me hours per day. I can easily focus on my patients now too.” \- J.L. from Tucson, Registered Nurse* *“Being a single mom is tough, but with Roger I can take the time to go to my daughter’s soccer game and also pursue further education.” \- T.M. from Dallas, Licensed Vocational Nurse* Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Associate Procurement Coordinator - Mechanical Equipment
jobs.description: At Rowan Digital Infrastructure, we are transforming data center delivery for speed and scale. Our mission is to deliver best\-in\-class data center solutions to hyperscale customers who share our commitment to sustainability, and to do so with an unwavering focus on efficiency, quality, and flexibility. Our data center solutions are tailored to our customers’ needs and delivered by our exceptional end\-to\-end team. Rowan is assembling a strategic portfolio of data center sites in Tier 1 markets across the United States at various stages of development, and we’re looking for incredible and passionate people to help us advance our company and our commitment to building a more sustainable future. Rowan is backed by Quinbrook, a leading investor in the energy transition, and Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Ready to join us in transforming the future of data centers and sustainability? Apply now to explore exciting career opportunities at Rowan Digital Infrastructure and be a part of our mission to revolutionize data center delivery. **Role Summary** We are seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Procurement Coordinator to join our growing Procurement team. This role is responsible for supporting the procurement lifecycle from strategic sourcing through purchase order execution while ensuring suppliers meet project schedules, quality requirements, and contractual obligations. This position will play a critical role in ensuring major equipment and materials are sourced efficiently, contracts are administered professionally, and suppliers perform to project expectations. This work will directly support successful project execution by helping deliver critical mechanical infrastructure on schedule and within budget. The successful candidate will coordinate Requests for Proposal (RFPs), administer Master Supply Agreements (MSAs), issue and track purchase orders, and work closely with engineering, construction, project management, legal, finance, and suppliers. Experience with mechanical equipment used in commercial or mission\-critical facilities is highly desirable. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment supporting large capital construction projects. **Travel:** Up to 25% to project locations and manufacturing facilities for expediting, site visits, RFP requirements, and initial delivery management. **Location:** Denver, CO (3\-day hybrid in\-office role) **Compensation:** $90K \- $115K (Offers Bonus) **Essential Responsibilities** * Coordinate competitive sourcing activities, Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Quotation (RFQs) * Assist in administering Master Supply Agreements (MSAs), supplier contracts, and commercial terms * Generate, issue, and maintain purchase orders in accordance with company procurement policies * Monitor purchase order status from issuance through delivery, proactively identifying schedule risks and expediting critical materials when necessary * Maintain procurement logs, supplier databases, contract files, and purchasing records * Coordinate with project managers, engineers, construction teams, and suppliers to ensure timely procurement of equipment and materials * Track supplier commitments, production schedules, shipping status, and delivery milestones * Support supplier performance reporting, KPI tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives * Review quotations and proposals for completeness, commercial compliance, and technical coordination * Ensure procurement documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with company standards * Assist with invoice reconciliation and resolution of purchasing discrepancies * Support strategic sourcing initiatives and supplier relationship management **Education, Skills, and Experience** * Education in Business, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) * 3\-5 years of procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or construction procurement experience * Experience in administering purchase orders and supplier contracts * Understanding of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies, and contract administration * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel * Strong attention to detail * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities * Ability to work effectively across engineering, construction, finance, and legal teams * Professional communication and supplier relationship management skills * Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team * Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability **Preferred Experience** * Experience supporting mechanical construction or mission\-critical/data center projects * General knowledge of mechanical systems, including HVAC equipment, chillers, pumps, cooling systems, piping, controls, or related mechanical infrastructure * Experience working with suppliers of commercial or industrial mechanical equipment * Working knowledge of Procoreconstruction management software * Experience with procurement reporting, supplier scorecards, and project scheduling * Familiarity with contract negotiation support and Master Supply Agreement administration **Fueled by Excellence \& Collaboration** At Rowan, we are a distributed team united by a common mission to transform data center delivery. Across our two offices, we offer a hybrid work environment supported by teamwork, technology, and in\-office gathering time to help you be successful. We are headquartered in downtown Denver, Colorado and have an office in Seattle, Washington. Our team of talented and passionate individuals is spread out across the U.S. **Here to support you** At Rowan, we want to make sure you can do great work. We offer competitive benefits focused on helping you be and achieve your best. * Hybrid working environment * Team building and educational opportunities * Generous benefits package including robust health benefits and a 401(k)\-company contribution * Unlimited PTO * RTD ECO pass or parking reimbursement * Competitive compensation, bonus, and an incentive plan **Equal Opportunity Employer** Rowan Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity in all aspects of our workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Compensation Range: $90K \- $115K

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **About Kovari** Kovari develops frontier technology to transform physical businesses. We partner with established operators to change how they run, and we build and operate businesses of our own through our subsidiaries. We are a small team of builders, operators, and researchers. We deploy on site, alongside the businesses we serve, and iterate in the field. We have raised over $6M from leading investors. We are based in San Francisco and work in person. **The Role** As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will own mechanical subsystems of our robots end to end, from concept through production, including actuator selection and structure to drivetrain, linkages, and field\-ready assembly. You make architecture and design tradeoffs, design it, machine it, assemble it, and fix it on robots running in live operations. This is not a bench role. Your designs face real constraints: variable floors, tight corridors, elevator transitions, and duty cycles that push hardware hard. **What You'll Do** * Own mechanical architecture and subsystem design from concept through production: drivetrain, structure, actuation, linkages, enclosures * Select and integrate motors, gearboxes, bearings, and actuators, making tradeoffs across performance, reliability, cost, and manufacturability * Run load, stress, and tolerance analysis to size parts and predict failure * Build prototypes in our in\-house shop (mill, lathe, welding, 3D printing, laser cutting) * Design for manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, and field reliability, working closely with vendors and manufacturers * Debug mechanical failures on deployed robots and drive fixes back into the design * Mentor junior engineers and manage vendors for machined, sheet metal, and molded parts **What You Bring** * 5\+ years of relevant industry experience designing and shipping hardware * Strong mechanical fundamentals: material selection, GD\&T, tolerance analysis, DFM * Track record owning actuated or mobile mechanisms from concept through production * CAD fluency in SolidWorks, Fusion, or Onshape * Hands\-on fabrication: you've run a mill and lathe, bent sheet metal, and welded * Experience making architecture and design tradeoffs, mentoring junior engineers, and working with manufacturers * A track record of hardware you've shipped and a portfolio of things you've built on your own time * Bias toward action: prototype fast, test early, fix what breaks **Values** * Pace of learning trumps everything. * Relentless refinement of our craft. * Low ego, high ownership. * All\-in on the mission. We work in person, and this isn't a 9\-to\-5\.

Ollama, vLLM, or Model Context Protocol integrations). * Background in virtualized infrastructure (Proxmox, Xen, ESX) or cloud platforms (AWS). jobs.description: **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ **The Agency's mission is to be boldly innovative in improving the health and quality of life for South Carolinians.** This is position is located in **Bureau of IT Infrastructure \& Operations, Richland County.** This is an in\-office role and not a telecommute or remote position. **Are you the One?** We are looking for a **Systems Engineer II**who, under minimal supervision, is responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise infrastructure and systems technologies. The Systems Engineer II ensures platforms are secure, scalable, and aligned with organizational and security requirements. Shares knowledge through cross\-training and contributes to improvement initiatives. * Other duties as assigned by management and lead staff. **The South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services offers an exceptional benefits package for FTE and TGE positions that includes:** * Health, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, and Children. * 15 days annual (vacation) leave per year. * 15 days sick leave per year. * 13 paid holidays. * State Retirement Plan and Deferred Compensation Programs. **Minimum and Additional Requirements** --------------------------------------- A bachelor's degree in computer science or related field and experience in computer system development and modification. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered with prior State Human Resources approval. **Additional Requirements:** * Sitting or standing for long periods of time. * Overtime and/or weekend work with Deputy approval. * Lifting requirements: 25 lbs. * Valid driver's license. * In\-office role. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Extensive knowledge of information technology system analysis, design, testing, and maintenance techniques. * Extensive knowledge of computer or network hardware, software, operating systems, programming languages, or other information technology tools/resources. * Ability to solve complex problems and apply critical thinking skills to needs or problems, both individual and as part of a team. * Ability to prepare status reports and complex technical reports in a clear and concise manner. * Ability to work effectively with users, vendors, staff members, and other IT units. * Ability to follow technical directions. * Ability to communicate in a clear and concise manner. * System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) * Intune/MECM co\-management and autopilot * Active Directory and Conditional Access PowerShell automation and scripting * Security baseline enforcement and vulnerability remediation. * Microsoft certifications such as: MD\-102: Endpoint Administrator Associate SC\-300: Identity and Access Administrator **Additional Comments** ----------------------- Please complete the State application to include all current and previous work history and education. **A resume will not be accepted nor reviewed to determine if an applicant has met the qualifications for the position. jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The job** ----------- You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Bonus** --------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **About Company** 1 Click Logistics, founded in 2018, is a third\-party logistics (3PL) provider committed to delivering exceptional service in distribution, warehousing, transportation, and innovative logistics solutions. With locations in Sparks, Nevada; Sacramento, California; Dayton, Ohio; and Hagerstown, Maryland, we are strategically positioned to serve customers across the U.S. Our mission is to serve our customers, team, and community while fostering a unique, employee\-centered culture. Our comprehensive services include warehousing and distribution, retail and e\-commerce fulfillment, and transportation management, all designed to streamline operations and reduce costs for our customers. We also provide value\-added services, such as re\-packaging, labeling, and light assembly, to meet specific customer needs. Utilizing advanced technology, our web\-based Warehouse Management System (WMS) and integrated Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) connect seamlessly with major retailers, ensuring transparent and efficient operations. Our ability to serve some of the world’s largest retailers, including Walmart, Target, Costco, and Home Depot, reflects our commitment to quality and efficiency. At 1 Click Logistics, we prioritize our employees’ well\-being, fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment that empowers our team to provide the exceptional service our customers expect and contribute positively to our community. **Job Summary** =============== The Software Engineer II is a hands\-on technical leader within the Software Development team, responsible for the architectural integrity and performance of core applications and the coordination of day\-to\-day development work. Working primarily with ColdFusion and React, this individual translates business requirements into technical solutions, guides Software Engineer I team members, and drives assigned projects from planning through completion. The position combines software development with work allocation, mentoring, progress monitoring, and stakeholder communication to support reliable, timely delivery. **Duties and Responsibilities** =============================== * System Architecture: Lead the design and scalability of software applications, ensuring integrations align with long\-term business strategy. * Standards and Governance: Define and maintain coding standards and development best practices to keep the codebase secure, performant, and maintainable. * Integration Leadership: Architect complex API integrations and data exchange workflows, researching third\-party system requirements to ensure seamless connectivity. * Process Optimization: Identify inefficiencies in the development lifecycle and implement improvements, including CI/CD, automated testing, and process automation. * Full\-Stack Ownership: Develop and maintain nationwide enterprise applications, from frontend React components to backend ColdFusion logic and MySQL database optimization. * Project Planning and Delivery: Translate business goals into technical milestones, estimates, acceptance criteria, and deadlines. Coordinate dependencies and available resources with management and monitor work through testing, deployment, and completion. * Work Allocation and Follow\-Up: Coordinate and assign development tasks within management\-approved priorities, considering team capacity and skill levels. Track progress in the project management system and follow up on outstanding commitments. * Team Leadership and Mentorship: Provide daily technical direction, onboarding support, coaching, and code\-review feedback to Software Engineer I team members. Identify training needs and provide management with factual input on work quality and delivery. * Progress Reporting and Escalation: Keep task status, owners, deadlines, and blockers current. Provide regular progress updates to management and promptly escalate risks to deadlines with proposed solutions and revised estimates for approval. * Cross\-Functional Coordination: Serve as the technical point of contact for Customer Service and other business units, clarifying requirements, communicating priorities, and managing expectations regarding scope and delivery. * Quality and Release Readiness: Coordinate code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment readiness. Verify completed work against acceptance criteria and address defects before closing assignments. * Application Support and Documentation: Coordinate troubleshooting of application issues with IT and business teams, prioritize issues by business impact, and maintain technical documentation and end\-user guidance. * Reliability and Accountability: Maintain regular, punctual attendance and availability during assigned work hours and scheduled meetings, consistent with company policy and approved arrangements. Complete assigned work by agreed deadlines and promptly communicate attendance issues, blockers, or anticipated delays. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Required Skills and Abilities** ================================= * Tech Stack: Proven experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6\+), and React.Backend and Logic: Experience with ColdFusion (willingness to be trained is acceptable) and MySQL. * API Expertise: Deep understanding of REST and SOAP methodologies and JSON, XML, and CSV data formats. * Design Patterns: Knowledge of software design and architectural patterns. * Tooling and Deployment: Proficiency with Git and project/ticket tracking software, such as Jira or Azure DevOps, and familiarity with CI/CD and application deployment in AWS or Azure. * Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root\-cause analysis. * Leadership: Ability to guide developers, delegate clearly, provide constructive feedback, resolve technical disagreements, and build a collaborative team. * Project Coordination: Ability to estimate effort, prioritize competing requests, monitor multiple assignments, and adjust plans in coordination with management. * Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, document decisions, and provide concise progress and risk updates. * Self\-Management and Follow\-Through: Ability to work independently, meet commitments, maintain accurate task records, and address delays proactively. * Professional Judgment: Attention to detail, confidentiality when handling sensitive information, and sound judgment about when to escalate concerns. **Education and Experience** ============================ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Application Development, or a related field required. * Minimum of 2–3 years of professional software development experience. * Technical Requirements: + JavaScript/React: 3–4 years. + APIs/Integrations: 3–4 years. + CSS/Frontend: 3–4 years. + Database/Backend: 2–3 years. * AWS Certified Developer Associate or similar development\-centric certifications preferred. **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * Must be able to lift 25 pounds at times. 1 Click Logistics is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Title:** ========== Data Engineer**Job Description:** ==================== **NOW HIRING: Data Engineer** **Compensation: $118,000\-$130,000 per year** **This role will be on\-site in our Sacramento Office.** **Job Overview** The Data Engineer will design, evolve, and govern the data architecture supporting the organization’s internally developed application systems. This position will own the architecture of existing operational databases, develop scalable data models and pipelines, and evaluate the transition of appropriate data assets into a data warehouse. Working closely with the dedicated Integrations Engineer and other technology teams, the Data Engineer will provide architectural direction that aligns application, integration, analytics, reliability, and reporting needs. **Roles \& Responsibilities** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
