jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Storefront Services Team
jobs.description: **Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era** ======================================= At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI\-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever\-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you. We work as a distributed team across time zones, so we value clear writing and independence: thoughtful design docs, detailed pull requests, async discussions anyone can pick up, and the trust to move your work forward without waiting on others. We believe the people who build something are best placed to ship it, so our engineers take their own changes all the way to production and see them through with confidence. We are a team where you'll have real ownership, and where your work reaches shoppers on every BigCommerce storefront. BigCommerce, part of the Commerce brand family, helps merchants increase sales at every stage of their growth. From small startups to mid\-market businesses and large enterprises, we provide the leading e\-commerce platform. Our customers can then concentrate on what's most important: growing their businesses. We enable our customers to build, innovate, and grow, collectively reshaping the e\-commerce industry. **What you'll do** * Build and maintain features in the service that powers every BigCommerce storefront, working with product managers and partner teams to shape the requirements and design the solution before building and releasing it * Add and extend GraphQL Storefront API queries and fields, following our schema guidelines so changes stay backward compatible for headless storefronts and third party integrations * Help evolve the storefront service to support AI driven shopping, so that agents and shopping assistants can browse, build carts, and check out for shoppers * Investigate and fix production issues, and improve performance and reliability in the areas of the service you work on Review code from teammates and the other engineering teams that contribute to the storefront service, and grow your design skills through design reviews and pairing with senior engineers * **Who Are You** * 5\+ years of experience building backend services that run in production * Education: Preferred minimum Bachelor's degree in CS, EE, SW, CE, MIS; or equivalent experience * Production experience with Scala or Kotlin preferred; backend engineers experienced in other languages (e.g., Java, Go, etc.) who are eager to learn Scala are encouraged to apply * Experience working with product managers or other stakeholders to turn requirements into a technical design, and delivering it to production * Working knowledge of HTTP fundamentals such as caching headers, cookies and sessions, and timeouts * Familiarity with GraphQL APIs * Familiarity with service to service communication and caching (e.g., gRPC, Redis, etc.) * Experience debugging production issues using metrics, traces, and logs (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Sentry, etc.) * Familiarity with releasing changes safely through feature flags and gradual rollouts * Experience writing automated tests and working with CI/CD pipelines * Uses AI coding assistants as a regular part of development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), and reviews AI generated code with the same care as code written by hand Interest in how AI agents use APIs (e.g., MCP, tool calling, etc.) * Work Where You Thrive For candidates based in the Austin or Atlanta metro area, the position follows a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office, balancing focused individual work with meaningful in\-person collaboration. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-GC1 (Pay Transparency Range: $116,000\.00 \- $195,000\.00\) **Compensation Transparency** ============================= The national base salary range for this role is posted above in this job post. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams. Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution. **Inclusion and Belonging** =========================== At Commerce, we believe that celebrating the unique histories, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes a difference for our company, our customers and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and the inclusive atmosphere we build together will make room for every person to contribute, grow and thrive. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. Learn more about the Commerce team, culture and benefits at https://www.commerce.com/careers/ **Identity Verification** ========================= To protect our candidates and company from fraudulent activity, our interview process includes a government ID and biometric verification via Persona, our trusted identity verification provider. All information is collected and processed securely in accordance with applicable privacy laws. **Protect Yourself Against Hiring Scams: Our Corporate Disclaimer** =================================================================== Commerce, along with many other employers, has become the subject of fraudulent job offers to hopeful prospective job seekers. Be advised: Commerce does not offer jobs to individuals who do not go through our formal hiring process. jobs.description: **THE POSITION** ---------------- Step into a role that helps protect communities and natural resources as an Environmental Projects Construction Inspector with the Department of Environmental Protection. This position gives you the chance to support important reclamation work that improves land and water quality. You will work with skilled professionals who guide you through detailed field inspections on a variety of projects. Build a meaningful career by shaping safer and healthier environments across Pennsylvania. **DESCRIPTION OF WORK** ----------------------- This position focuses on the inspection of abandoned mine land reclamation projects and supports supervisors and project engineers within the Bureau of Abandoned Mine Reclamation. As an Environmental Projects Construction Inspector, you will perform the following duties: * **Project Review:** Examine plans and specifications to identify differences between field conditions and design expectations * **Site Inspection:** Inspect backfilling, grading, seeding, storm\-water ditches, and material installations on active reclamation sites * **Structure Work:** Monitor construction of stream channels, wetlands, ponds, drainage structures, and treatment systems * **Documentation Tasks:** Maintain detailed daily records of work completed, equipment used, and contract quantities for payment * **Borehole Oversight:** Observe drilling, sealing, and monitoring of boreholes and record measurements related to subsidence control activities * **Compliance Monitoring:** Inspect erosion and sedimentation controls, enforce corrective actions, and ensure contractor compliance with project requirements Interested in learning more? Additional details regarding this position can be found in the position description. **Work Schedule and Additional Information:** * Full\-time employment * Work hours are 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Monday \- Friday, with a 30\-minute lunch. * **Telework:** You will not have the option to telework in this position. * **Salary:**Selected candidates who are new to employment with the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania will begin employment at the starting annual salary of $46,827 (before taxes). * You will receive further communication regarding this position via email. jobs.description: Overview: We are seeking a motivated Senior AI Engineer to contribute to the design and development of our agentic framework and centralized AI platform. This role will focus on implementing and integrating AI agents, experimenting with open\-source AI tools, and supporting the delivery of customer\-facing and internal AI\-powered applications. You will work closely with senior AI engineers, backend developers, and product engineers to bring agentic solutions to life, gaining hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge AI frameworks and infrastructure. Responsibilities: * Implement and maintain components of agentic AI framework under the guidance of senior engineers * Leverage open\-source AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen) to build and experiment with agents for diverse use cases * Incorporate selected open\-source solution into our agentic AI framework * Collaborate with product engineers to integrate AI agents into customer\-facing applications and internal tools * Write clean, maintainable Python code for AI workflows, APIs, and data integration tasks * Assist in testing, debugging, and improving performance of AI\-powered workloads * Contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing across the team * Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting. * Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned. * Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * 5 years of software engineering experience, with exposure to AI/ML concepts or platforms. * Solid programming skills in Python; familiarity with frameworks like FastAPI or Flask a plus * Hands\-on experience with at least one agentic AI. framework (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) through projects, internships, or work experience. * Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Exposure to orchestration frameworks (Kubernetes). * Familiarity with modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). **Cognitive/Metal Requirements:*** Ability to work independently as well as collaborate as a team with a sense of urgency. * Professional with ability to properly handle confidential information. * Be value\-driven, understand that success is based on the impact of your work rather than its complexity or the level of effort. * Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:*** Flexibility to work with global teams as well geographically dispersed US based teams. * Must be able to provide high\-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance. * Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area. This experienced professional position develops, tests, and implements scalable solutions, collaborates with data scientists and engineers, and provides knowledge sharing and support to team members. Responsibilities: * Develop and implement machine learning solutions for healthcare applications. * May provide knowledge sharing and support to team members. * Collaborate with data scientists and other engineers to design and build scalable solutions. * Write, test, and maintain high\-quality code along with Code coverage. * Participate in design and code review sessions. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues. * Document your work and share knowledge with the team. * Apply established development standards and best practices. * May assist with onboarding or knowledge transfer activities. * Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting. * Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned. * Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years’ experience of developing AI/ML solutions. * Strong programming skills in Python, and machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch. * Working knowledge of data mining and statistical analysis/predictive analytics. * Ability to solve problems with analytical thinking and the ability to conceptualize, design, and build models from scratch. * Hands\-on experience in defining and designing the models for predictive analytics based on business requirements. * Deep understanding of data architecture principles, have good experience with different data sources and databases like Oracle, and MS SQL Server. * Hands\-on experience building CI/CD pipelines for production deployment of models. Hands\-on experience with ML Ops is an added advantage. * Experience with cloud\-based ML/data services (AWS, Azure, or GCP). * Experience working with generative AI/LLM frameworks and tools (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face, vector databases, RAG pipelines, LLM APIs). * Understanding in Agile, SDLC. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Familiarity with Agile processes and tools like Jira and Confluence. * Strong drive to learn and advocate for development best practices, must be a team player with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a deadline driven environment. * Knowledge in the Healthcare Insurance sector is an added advantage. **Cognitive/Mental Requirements*** Curious: You are always looking to deepen your understanding of complex problems. * Creative: You enjoy coming up with innovative solutions to difficult challenges. * Practical: You focus on delivering solutions that have real\-world applications and value. * Focused: You maintain a clear vision of your goals and work diligently to achieve them. * Determined: You are committed to contributing to the development of advanced machine learning capabilities. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions*** Must be available during normal business hours. * Must be flexible to extend beyond the normal business hours based on project need. * Must be able to provide high\-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance. *Base compensation ranges from $132,000 to $155,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.* *Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17\-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our* *Careers page.* *This* *role is based remotely and all interviews will be conducted virtually.* Date of posting:09/28/2026 Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 11/28/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. \#LI\-Remote \#senior \#LI\-MC1

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar commerce industry from the ground up. We are an American technology company and one of the fastest\-growing retail companies that has established an unparalleled reputation for being a leading and reliable force in global commerce. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial, surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Role Overview** Coupang is seeking a highly technical and execution\-focused Staff Technical Program Manager to lead Engineering Controls, Operational Governance, IT SOX Compliance, Security, Privacy and Technology Risk initiatives across Coupang's technology ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, operational excellence, compliance, and AI\-enabled governance. The primary focus is ownership of IT SOX Change Management controls and serving as a Second Line of Defense (2LOD) partner to engineering teams by independently assessing control effectiveness, monitoring software deployment activities, identifying compliance risks, and driving scalable engineering controls. As Coupang continues to evolve its engineering platform, this role will help modernize compliance through automation, analytics, engineering telemetry, and AI\-driven monitoring. The TPM will build a control environment that improves risk visibility, audit readiness, and operational excellence while minimizing compliance friction for engineering teams. Unlike traditional audit or compliance roles, this position requires deep expertise in modern software development, CI/CD, release management, cloud\-native architectures, deployment automation, and engineering operations. The ideal candidate is a former Software Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or SRE who has transitioned into technical program leadership and can effectively partner with engineers, architects, security leaders, auditors, and executives. You will work closely with Engineering, Platform, Security, Privacy, Finance, Internal Audit, and Governance teams to strengthen controls, automate compliance processes, improve reliability, and enable rapid software delivery without compromising risk objectives. **What You Will Do** **Lead Change Management Governance** * Own the strategy, governance framework, and roadmap for IT SOX Change Management controls across Coupang's software development lifecycle. * Evaluate release processes, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments to ensure compliance requirements are consistently met. * Perform independent monitoring and oversight of deployment activities using engineering and compliance data. * Identify compliance exceptions, unauthorized changes, control failures, and process gaps through continuous monitoring. * Establish and improve controls related to: * + Code Reviews + Release Approvals + Segregation of Duties (SoD) + Emergency Changes + Production Deployments + Change Monitoring and Reporting * Leverage AI, analytics, and deployment telemetry to identify elevated\-risk changes, anomalous deployment patterns, and control exceptions. * Provide guidance to engineering teams and drive remediation of identified risks and control gaps. * Balance engineering velocity with effective risk management through automation and scalable controls. **Drive CI/CD Governance \& Engineering Controls** * Partner with Platform Engineering teams to embed preventive and detective controls directly into software delivery workflows. * Improve governance across CI/CD, release management, deployment authorization, and production change processes. * Define control observability frameworks that provide real\-time visibility into software delivery controls. * Partner with Platform and Data teams to develop automated monitoring capabilities that detect unauthorized changes, control bypasses, deployment anomalies, and emerging risks. * Establish key control and risk indicators that proactively surface compliance concerns. * Design monitoring and reporting solutions for: * + Release Compliance + Deployment Risk + Control Effectiveness + uous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, and risk analysis. * Working knowledge of SOX, ITGCs, change and access management controls, segregation of duties (SoD), and industry frameworks such as COBIT, COSO, NIST, and ISO 27001\. * Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CIA, PMP, or cloud platform certifications are highly desirable. **Pay \& Benefits** Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. At Coupang, your base pay is one part of your total compensation. The base pay for this position ranges from $155,000/year in our lowest geographic market to $267,000/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills and experience. **General Description of All Benefits** * Annual bonus is 0\-20% of the base salary * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life, AD\&D insurance * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Savings Account (HSA) * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) program * 401K Plan with Company Match * 18\-21 days of the Paid Time Off (PTO) a year based on the tenure * 12 Public Holidays * Paid Parental leave * Pre\-tax commuter benefits **General Description of Other Compensation** "Other Compensation" includes, but is not limited to, bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation that would be offered to the hired applicant in addition to their established salary range or wage scale. **Recruitment Process** * Application Review \- Phone Interview \- Onsite (or Virtual Onsite) Interview – Offer * The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances. * Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e\-mail address submitted at the application stage **Details to Consider** * This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled. * Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. * Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. **Privacy Notice** * Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy\-policy/ *Coupang is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race (including traits historically associated with race, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hair styles), color, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, ,ancestry, national origin (including language use restrictions), age (40 and over), physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, HIV/AIDS or Hepatitis C status, family status (including but not limited to marital or domestic partnership status), military or veteran status, use of a trained dog guide or service animal, political activities or affiliations, ancestry, citizenship, family and medical leave status, status as a victim of any violent crime, or any other characteristic or class protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Coupang is also committed to providing a safe work environment for its employees and its consumers. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application of recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at* usrecruiting@coupang.com **Job Requisition ID**: R0073013

jobs.title: Business Process and AI Product Owner
jobs.description: From the beginning, our goal was to establish an advisory firm that stands apart from the rest – one that is grounded in our Core Values and dedicated to creating a positive experience not just for our clients, but for our people too. We firmly believe in the strength of collaboration, enthusiasm, generosity, and perseverance as the driving forces behind our success. With advisory solutions spanning accounting and risk, technology\-enabled transformation, and transactions, we partner with our clients to solve today’s challenges and deliver present and future value. Our commitment to our people has earned us numerous awards including Inc5000's Fastest Growing Companies and Glassdoor's Best Places to Work. Explore what our employees have to say about our unique culture by clicking here. CrossCountry Consulting’s AI Innovation \& Transformation practice builds the next generation of agentic AI solutions for the Office of the CFO and other enterprise functions. We design, deploy, and manage AI agents that automate and augment core enterprise workflows grounded in production\-grade data foundations and domain expertise. As a Business Process \& AI Product Owner on this team, you will be the bridge between what clients want to achieve and what AI can actually deliver: translating strategic finance and operational priorities into a disciplined AI product roadmap, orchestrating the cross\-functional work required to bring agents from concept to production, and ensuring every deployment creates measurable, defensible enterprise value. **The Role** AI transformation at scale requires more than strong data and great engineering – it requires someone who deeply understands how finance, operations, and technology intersect within an enterprise, can diagnose process dysfunction and quantify value opportunities, and can own a product backlog with the rigor of a seasoned product manager and the credibility of a former finance leader. You will serve as the primary client\-facing AI Product Owner, owning requirements, redesigning processes, sprint planning, stakeholder alignment, running training and customer success programs, and value realization from kick\-off through steady\-state managed outcomes. ### **What You'll Do:** * **Process discovery \& value architecture:** Lead structured current\-state process assessments across finance and adjacent functions (accounting, FP\&A, treasury, procurement, revenue operations, HR finance, legal ops); quantify value opportunities by AI and automation tier, identify high\-ROI agent use cases for the enterprise, and build the business case for AI investment with CFO\-ready financial models. * **Process redesign \& optimization:** Where AI and Machine Learning solutions create value, help clients redesign roles, org structures, and operating models to capture the full value of AI/ML, working across value streams and domains; advise on workforce transition, upskilling, and governance model changes required to operate AI\-augmented finance functions. * **AI product roadmap ownership:** Define, prioritize, and maintain a rolling AI product roadmap for each client engagement, sequencing deployments and platform build\-out by value, feasibility, and data readiness; balance quick wins against strategic platform capabilities. * **Requirements \& user story development:** Translate business requirements, inclusive of new capabilities that AI can bring, into detailed agent specifications: user stories, acceptance criteria, data input/output schemas, exception\-handling logic, HITL/HOTL decision points, and success metrics. * **Sprint planning \& delivery governance:** Lead development planning, demos, and deployments in collaboration with Forward Deployed Engineers and Data Architects; manage scope, track velocity, surface blockers, and maintain delivery confidence against committed timelines and fixed\-fee budgets. * **Stakeholder management \& executive alignment:** Build trusted relationships with client CEOs, CTOs, CHROs, CFOs, Controllers, VP FP\&A, and functional leaders; facilitate executive steering committees, present sprint demos, and communicate roadmap progress and tradeoffs in business terms that resonate with finance leadership. * **Change management \& user adoption:** Design and execute change management plans that drive user adoption of AI \& ML solutions within client finance teams; develop training programs, change champions networks, and adoption KPI dashboards; address resistance with empathy and clear articulation of individual benefit. * **Value realization \& ROI measurement:** Define outcome metrics at the start of each engagement (revenue growth, retention, spend optimization, hours recovered, error rate reduction, cycle\-time compression, variance\-explanation coverage, etc.); instrument agentic solution to capture those metrics and produce periodic Value Realization Reports that demonstrate ROI against the original business case. Transform/establish processes to put nt function (treasury, procurement, sales operations, revenue operations, HR, IT, or legal); CPA, CFA, or MBA is strongly preferred. * Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in an enterprise software, SaaS, or digital transformation context; proficiency with agile methodologies. * Experience deploying or overseeing AI/ML or intelligent automation (RPA, NLP, or LLM\-based) solutions in a finance or operations context; sufficient technical fluency to evaluate feasibility, challenge engineering assumptions, and communicate credibly with data architects and engineers. * Deep domain knowledge of at least 1\-2 industries, including their business models and key performance metrics, grounding a clear view of where the AI value levers are in the industry and how to capture them * Track record of building and presenting rigorous business cases for technology investment, including NPV/IRR analysis, payback period modeling, and sensitivity analysis, tailored to CFO and board\-level audiences. * Exceptional workshop facilitation and process\-mapping skills. * Strong executive presence and communication skills; ability to navigate complex client politics, manage competing stakeholder priorities, and maintain delivery momentum in large, matrixed organizations. * Demonstrated change management competency; experience designing and executing change programs for technology\-driven finance transformation. * Comfort operating in a startup\-within\-a\-consulting\-firm environment: building playbooks from scratch, context\-switching across clients, and maintaining high quality under deadline pressure. ### **Qualifications:** * A bachelor’s degree from an accredited university; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced degree or certification strongly preferred. * Certified SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, CSPO, or equivalent agile product certification preferred. * If remote \- willingness to travel domestically up to 30%–40% (varies by client engagement phase). * If hybrid \- availability to work on client site or in office 3 days a week, with 2 days remote. *\#LI\-Hybrid* *\#LI\-Remote* *\#LI\-TK1* *\#LI\-NB1* ***Benefits Summary****The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. Additionally, employees can take advantage of generous parental and maternity leave policies, technology stipends, and wellness reimbursement programs, all designed to support both professional growth and personal well\-being. For detailed information about benefits at CrossCountry, please visit our dedicated benefits site:* https://www.crosscountry\-consulting.com/careers/benefits/. ***Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)****CrossCountry provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and believes that respect and fair treatment are critical to creating a productive and inclusive workplace.* *As an equal opportunity employer, CrossCountry is fully committed to comply with all federal, state, and local laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetics, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression or any other protected characteristic. The company also complies with pay transparency and labor laws applicable to all terms and conditions of employment.*We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer \& Agentic Workflow Engineer at CrossCountry Consulting you will be the tip of the spear for AI deployment at clients—embedding directly with client finance and operations teams to build, test, and iterate on agentic workflows that deliver measurable enterprise value on a compressed timeline. Operating at the intersection of software engineering, finance domain expertise, and client partnership, you will write production code alongside your clients, own the deployment of agentic solutions, and mentor junior engineers as a member of the practice team. ### **What You'll Do:** **Client Delivery** **Lead the development and delivery of services in the following areas:** * Rapid Jumpstart deployment: Deploy AI Jumpstart packages within client environments, configuring data connectors, calibrating agent logic, and validating outputs against source system controls within the first week of engagement. * Agentic workflow design \& build: Architect and implement multi\-agent orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen; design task decomposition, inter\-agent messaging, tool\-call schemas, and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) / human\-on\-the\-loop (HOTL) checkpoints appropriate to the risk and materiality of each workflow step. * LLM integration \& prompt engineering: Write, version, and optimize system prompts and structured output schemas for LLM\-powered agents; implement function\-calling / tool\-use patterns against financial APIs; and fine\-tune retrieval strategies (hybrid structured \+ RAG) to maximize accuracy and auditability. * Enterprise system integration: Build and certify MCP connectors and REST/GraphQL integrations to ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle), EPM (Adaptive Planning, Anaplan), CRM (Salesforce), and HRIS (Workday) systems, ensuring data freshness, completeness, and reconciliation to source\-system controls. Production deployment \& reliability: Package agents as containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes or equivalent) and configure CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion (dev staging* production), and monitoring/alerting so agents run reliably at client scale. * Client co\-development: Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with client finance, IT, and data teams; experience with FastAPI or equivalent for exposing agent capabilities as APIs. * Deep understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations: prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, context\-window management, cost optimization, and latency tradeoffs across frontier models. * Experience integrating enterprise source systems via APIs and MCP connectors; familiarity with ERP, EPM, EDW/Data Lakes, and CRM data schemas in a finance context is a significant plus. * Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes); experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or equivalent) and RAG pipelines. * Finance domain fluency—ability to understand and implement workflows covering month\-end close, variance analysis, revenue recognition, AR/AP, and FP\&A without requiring extensive hand\-holding from client finance teams. * Exceptional ability to operate in ambiguous, fast\-moving client environments; jobs.description: **Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst** =========================================== * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time * **FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt * **Department:** Managed Services / MSP * **Work Location:** Remote; scheduled Central Time coverage, quarterly on\-call rotation for one week, and occasional onsite client support by agreement Position Summary ---------------- The Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst provides advanced systems and networking support across a variety of managed services client environments. As the first level of the engineering team, this role resolves escalations beyond Tier 2, helps maintain service continuity, and communicates clearly with clients and internal technical teams while building broad expertise across network, server, cloud, and infrastructure technologies.Key Responsibilities -------------------- * Handle advanced escalations across network, server, cloud, security, and client\-impacting issues. * Independently troubleshoot firewalls, VPNs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and connectivity issues across varied client environments. * Troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra, backups, remote desktop, MFA, and related infrastructure issues. * Monitor, triage, document, and respond to technical alerts and time\-sensitive tickets in accordance with established procedures and escalation protocols. * Maintain clear ownership and visibility of high\-priority issues through accurate documentation, client updates, and effective handoffs. * Escalate highly complex or high\-impact issues to senior engineering resources or other subject matter experts when needed. * Document troubleshooting, resolutions, labor notes, client environment details, runbooks, and technical procedures. * Collaborate with senior engineers, Service Desk, Cybersecurity, account managers, cloud specialists, and third\-party vendors to resolve complex issues. * Identify recurring issues and share observations that support process improvement, alert tuning, and consistent service delivery. Required Qualifications ----------------------- * High school diploma or GED equivalent. * 2–4 years of experience in a Service Desk, NOC, IT operations, infrastructure support, or similar technical support role. * Hands\-on networking experience and the ability to troubleshoot firewalls and connectivity issues with limited guidance. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting. * Direct experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365\. * Intermediate experience supporting Azure and Entra environments. * Familiarity with backup troubleshooting, remote desktop support, MFA, ticketing systems, monitoring tools, and technical documentation. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, documentation, prioritization, and client\-service skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Preferred Qualifications ------------------------ * Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field. * Experience supporting multiple clients in a managed services, NOC, or 24x7 technical support environment. * Experience working across multiple firewall and networking\-equipment manufacturers. * Experience supporting dedicated client environments. * Relevant CompTIA, Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, or similar certifications. What Success Looks Like ----------------------- A high\-performing NOC Analyst resolves advanced networking and systems issues accurately and independently, keeps clients and internal teams informed, and maintains clear, reliable documentation. jobs.title: Full-Stack/API Developer
jobs.description: Description: The Full\-Stack/API Developer is a core software engineer responsible for hands\-on feature development, API endpoint implementation, UI component creation, and spatial data ingestion. Working within an integrated Agile engineering team, this role contributes directly to building next\-generation features for the National Water Prediction Service (NWPS), including new hydrograph visualization options, gauge location search tools, and precipitation frequency data displays. Collaborating with Senior Developers, GIS Specialists, and Government hydrologists, the Full\-Stack/API Developer writes clean, maintainable code, implements accessible frontend components, writes automated unit tests, and moves software updates through automated VLab GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Requirements: * **Feature \& Endpoint Development:** Develop, test, and deliver new full\-stack features, web pages, and RESTful API endpoints for NWPS modernization tasks. * **Frontend UI Component Building:** Construct responsive, accessible web interface components (hydrographs, data tables, map widgets, location search views) using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript, ensuring strict compliance with WCAG 2\.1 AA and Section 508 standards. * **Backend Ingestion \& Data Services:** Write Python scripts and SQL queries to parse, transform, and store multi\-source hydrologic datasets in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and S3\. * **Automated Unit \& Integration Testing:** Write automated unit and integration tests (Pytest, Jest, or unittest) for all new code to guarantee compliance with the mandatory \=80% statement test coverage requirement. * **GitLab/GitHub CI/CD Workflows:** Utilize VLab GitLab and GitHub for daily feature branching, pull/merge requests, automated pipeline execution, and peer code reviews. * **Agile Sprint Participation:** Active participation in daily Scrum stand\-ups, sprint planning, story estimation, and issue tracking in Jira/VLab Redmine. * **Community Code Review Support:** Assist senior engineers in running automated sandboxed tests and schema checks for public community\-driven code contributions. **Experience Required** * **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. * **Total Professional Experience:** Minimum of 3 to 5 years of professional experience in full\-stack web application development and API engineering. * **Application Engineering:** Hands\-on experience building full\-stack web applications, consuming and creating REST APIs, and querying relational/spatial databases. * **Version Control \& Test Automation:** Practical experience using Git workflows (branching, pull requests) and writing automated unit tests. **Technical Skills Required** * **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django), JavaScript/TypeScript, and HTML5/CSS3\. * **APIs \& Databases:** Practical knowledge of RESTful API design, PostgreSQL / SQL, JSON/GeoJSON parsing, and relational database schema design. * **Web Accessibility:** Demonstrated ability to build accessible web components adhering to Section 508 and WCAG 2\.1 AA guidelines. * **Cloud \& Container Fundamentals:** Familiarity with AWS cloud environments (AWS Fargate, S3, Aurora), Docker containerization, and basic Infrastructure as Code concepts. * **Testing \& Development Tooling:** Experience with Pytest, Jest, Git repositories (VLab GitLab/GitHub), and issue tracking tools (Jira/Redmine).

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Gemini App, Data Engineering, DeepMind
jobs.description: In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance * Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment * Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance * Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks * Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks * Holidays: 13 paid days per year Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Seattle, WA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with Apache Spark, Flink, Beam, Airflow, or BigQuery/Snowflake or other similar infrastructure. * Experience developing, debugging, and supporting large\-scale data pipelines. * Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and workflow orchestration tools. * Experience in Go/C\+\+. * Experience in a technical Lead or similar role, ideally setting technical direction for a small group of executive and junior software engineer. * Ability to address daily business data requirements, ensure that development obstacles are cleared to maintain the Gemini App's changing growth. **About the job** ----------------- As a part of the Gemini Apps Data Engineering team, you will architect and operate the data pipelines that deliver critical telemetry across all Gemini surfaces. You will combine deep technical expertise with Google\-scale operating experience to solve the unique data issues inherent in building a transformative, global product during a time of massive growth!. Gemini’s user base is growing continuously and our traffic has sometimes even doubled just over the course of a week. In this role, you will provide the technical leadership necessary to scale our infrastructure. You will architect durable data products and drive critical engineering initiatives across multiple teams to ensure we continue delivering metrics and training data quickly, reliably, and accurately at a massive global scale. In this role, you will leverage your experience in building and running scalable systems, and utilize modern data warehouse infrastructure at Google, lead a small team of executive and junior engineers to scale the data pipelines that drive Gemini Apps’s analytics and power model and product improvement. You will work directly with key stakeholders, including our Data Science, model release, model quality, and feature teams, as well as teams across DeepMind, to identify and solve key problems to help make Gemini the next billion\-user product.Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer varied learning opportunities and career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Work closely with our Data Science counterparts in definition and driving the goals for a Modern Data Warehouse. * Architect and build scalable batch and real\-time pipelines that power experimentation, product analytics, and ML/AI training loops. * Own data quality, reliability, and observability end\-to\-end, including defining and operating Service Level Agreements (SLAs)/ Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical production datasets. * Mentor and grow other engineers, raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and actionable feedback. * Drive cross\-functional engineering initiatives that span multiple teams, translating ambiguous requirements into technical designs. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer, AI Automation
jobs.description: **Date:** Sep 28, 2026 **Location:** Waltham, MA, US, 2451 **Company:** Dentsply Sirona, Inc **Requistion ID**: 84236 Dentsply Sirona is the world’s largest manufacturer of professional dental products and technologies, with over a century of innovation and service to the dental industry and patients worldwide. Dentsply Sirona develops, manufactures, and markets a comprehensive solutions offering including dental and oral health products as well as other consumable medical devices under a strong portfolio of world class brands. Dentsply Sirona’s products provide innovative, high\-quality, and effective solutions to advance patient care and deliver better and safer dental care. Dentsply Sirona’s headquarter is located in Charlotte, North Carolina. The company’s shares are listed in the United States on NASDAQ under the symbol XRAY. Visit www.dentsplysirona.com for more information about Dentsply Sirona and its products. Dentsply Sirona's software engineering and cloud operations team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer II to focused on AI\-driven automation across one or more products, services, or platforms. This is a senior individual contributor role combining hands\-on software engineering, technical expertise, and architectural influence. You will design, build, and operate AI\-powered automation capabilities, collaborate across teams, and help drive responsible adoption of AI technologies through engineering best practices, governance, and operational excellence. **Responsibilities for Employment \-** Technical Leadership \& Delivery * Lead the technical design and implementation of AI automation initiatives within one or more epics or projects. * Collaborate with Product, UX, QA, Security, and Cloud Operations teams to deliver high\-quality solutions. * Influence technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews, and engineering best practices. * Mentor and support engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing. Technical Implementation \& Development * Design and implement AI\-enabled automation workflows for parts of the software development lifecycle (requirements/story generation, documentation scaffolding, code scaffolding) within the program area. * Design and implement RAG pipelines, lightweight intelligent agents, and MCP or equivalent integrations to support engineering workflows. * Integrate AI\-assisted code generation and validation into CI/CD with guardrails, automated checks, feature flags, staged rollouts and safe rollback conditions. * Ensure human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, prompt and policy guardrails, provenance/traceability, and least\-privilege access controls for embeddings and logs. * Prepare runbooks, dashboards and alerts; participate in incident responses and contribute to post\-incident reviews for owned services. * Monitor and optimize reliability, latency, correctness and cost of AI features; manage model drift and retrieval quality metrics. * Continuously evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies to improve developer productivity, quality and efficiency. Governance, safety \& quality * Define and enforce team\-level AI governance: data handling policies, retention, access control and regulatory traceability where required. * Establish detection of metrics and validation processes to detect hallucinations, data leakage and model drift; automate tests where feasible. * Ensure delivered features include automated tests, documentation, and observability (logs, metrics, traces). **Qualifications** Education: * BS or MS in computer science or a related engineering discipline. Years and Type of Experience: * 8\+ years as a Software Engineer, Full Stack Engineer or comparable role. * Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives, driving architecture decisions, and delivering production\-grade software systems. * Proven track record designing and delivering production\-grade systems and driving technical excellence across projects. * Hands\-on experience integrating AI components (RAG, embeddings/vector DBs, light agents, MCP\-style integrations) into engineering workflows. * Experience with distributed systems, APIs and service\-level design. * Experience contributing to operational readiness, incident response, and service reliability practices. **Key Skills, Knowledge \& Capabilities:** * Proven pragmatic system and service design skills at program scope. * Deep understanding of scalability, performance optimization and cost trade‑offs for AI and platform services. * Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization (Docker) and exposure to Kubernetes. * Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions/Jenkins/GitLab), feature\-flagging, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform/ARM). * Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores/vector DBs, prompt engineering and retrieval\-quality evaluation. * Strong testing and observability discipline: unit/integration tests, logging, metrics and distributed tracing. * Awareness of data privacy, access controls and secure handling of embeddings/logs. * Strong collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams. * Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken); German advantageous. * Regulated\-industry (medical device) experience is a plus. **Nice to have** * Experience integrating AI checks into CI/CD (policy checks, automated test generation, documentation synthesis). * Familiarity with model evaluation, offline/online metrics and A/B testing for ML features. * Experience with MCP or similar context\-sharing protocols. **How We Work the DS Way \- Key Leadership Behaviors** * Actively articulates and promotes Dentsply Sirona’s vision, mission and values. * Advocates on behalf of the customer. * Promotes high performance, innovation and continual improvement. * Consistently meets Company standards, ethics and compliance requirements. * Clear and effective communication with stake holders, which span across multiple levels, socio\-geographic areas and functional expertise. The base salary and target annual incentive for this role located in Massachusetts is between $176,000 \- $198,000\. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific office location. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Dentsply Sirona is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without unlawful discrimination or regard for race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, sexual or gender identity, national or ethnic origin, age, marital status, disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable local law. **Eligibility:** All successful applicants must be eligible to work in the country the position is based. **Assistance:** If you need assistance with completing the online application due to a disability, please send an accommodation request to accommodationrequest@dentsplysirona.com. **Agencies:** Please note that Dentsply Sirona does not accept or respond to unsolicited requests or applications submitted by Recruitment Agencies/ Search Firms. **Notice on Fraudulent Job Offers:** Unfortunately, we are aware of third parties that pretend to represent our company offering unauthorized employment opportunities. If you think a fraudulent source is offering you a job, please have a look at the following information: careers.dentsplysirona.com.

jobs.title: Helpdesk Technician
jobs.description: Description: *Leading with our people, Digital Consultants’ mission is to deliver the highest level of professional solutions while being a trusted partner and advisor to our customers. With a culture of practicality, opportunity, and creativity, we remain dedicated to being honest, trustworthy, respectful, and ethical in everything we do.?We are a certified SBA 8(a) small, disadvantaged business that supports multiple IT customers within the Federal, civilian, and private sectors. Digital Consultants also offers our employees growth opportunities, competitive wages, and a full benefits package. Our founding principles, Fairness and Common Sense, make working here more than a job; it’s the Digital family.* Digital Consultants seeks a Helpdesk Technician to provide on\-site Tier I and Tier II help desk and desktop support to the Naval Medical Leader and Professional Development Command (NMLPDC). The role focuses on restoring Apple devices including desktop computers, laptops, peripheral equipment, software, operating systems, and network connectivity to full operational status while delivering responsive customer support in a secure Department of Defense environment. ***Duties to include:*** * Receive technical support requests submitted by email, telephone, or service desk system; assess customer concerns, document reported issues, and manage assigned trouble tickets through resolution and closure. * Provide Tier 1–2 technical support for Apple Mac desktops and laptops, macOS, iPads, iPhones, printers, scanners, docking stations, displays, and other Apple and peripheral devices. * Troubleshoot, test, and diagnose hardware, macOS, application, account, connectivity, and peripheral issues affecting user productivity and access to organizational resources. * Perform hands\-on device setup, configuration, software installation, macOS updates and upgrades, peripheral configuration, user\-profile support, and other corrective actions required to restore systems to full functionality. * Deploy, configure, maintain, and support Mac workstations in accordance with established organizational standards, including device enrollment, security configuration, software installation, and endpoint management requirements. * Assist users with the standard Mac software environment and common commercial off\-the\-shelf applications, including Microsoft 365/Office, Adobe Creative Cloud, Citrix, Oracle, SharePoint, educational applications, and Joint Medical educational systems and programs. * Support users with Apple\-specific functionality, including macOS settings, Apple ID and account\-related issues, printing, file access, application permissions, display and peripheral configuration, and connectivity to enterprise resources. * Troubleshoot network and connectivity issues involving wired and wireless connections, VPN access, network shares, authentication, printers, and other enterprise services from the Mac endpoint. * Coordinate with network services, systems administrators, application development personnel, cybersecurity staff, and Mac engineering resources when incidents require escalation or cross\-functional support. * Escalate unresolved, recurring, or complex incidents to the Senior Mac Engineer, or other designated technical personnel, providing complete troubleshooting history and relevant diagnostic information. * Monitor assigned incidents and work toward resolution within established service\-level expectations; close trouble tickets within three business days unless required parts, repairs, software, or equipment are backlogged, and close backlogged tickets by the next business day after required items are received. * Provide clear, timely status updates to users and maintain accurate technical documentation, including troubleshooting actions, system configurations, asset information, resolutions, and ticket history. * Maintain accurate inventory and configuration information for supported Mac computers, iPads, iPhones, peripherals, and related equipment. * Follow approved cybersecurity, configuration\-management, change\-control, endpoint\-management, and customer\-service procedures when installing, configuring, troubleshooting, or supporting Mac and Apple devices. * Assist with Mac device deployment, replacement, refresh, and lifecycle activities, including preparing equipment for new users, transferring or restoring user data as authorized, configuring required applications, and preparing retired equipment for appropriate disposition. * Identify recurring Mac\-related issues and contribute troubleshooting information, knowledge\-base documentation, and recommendations that improve the efficiency and consistency of Tier 1–2 technical support. Requirements: * **Clearance:** SECRET * **Certifications:** CompTIA Security\+ or an equivalent certification required before accessing the network. * **Education:** High School Diploma * **Experience:** 1 to 2 years Tier I/II Help Desk or Desktop Support. jobs.title: Mechanical Draftsperson (Tool & Die)
jobs.description: Description: **About PrecisionX Group:** PrecisionX Group is a leading provider of precision metal components, serving critical industries such as aerospace \& defense, medical devices, satellite \& space, electric vehicles, mining, and semiconductors. This role works closely with tool designers, engineers, and toolmakers to translate design concepts and customer specifications into accurate, manufacturable drawings. **Essential Functions:** To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each stated essential function, with or without reasonable accommodation. Mechanical. * Create die layout drawings, strip layouts, and die process sheets from customer part prints. * Draft detailed component drawings with correct GD\&T, tolerances, and material callouts suited to micro\-miniature tolerances (often within thousandths of an inch). * Coordinate with machinists on ESPRIT CAM programming needs by ensuring drawings and models are ready. * Revise and update existing die drawings based on engineering changes, tryout feedback, or customer revisions. * Collaborate with toolmakers and die designers to ensure drawings translate accurately to machining and assembly. * Maintain and distribute drawing packages, revisions, and documentation via Adobe Acrobat. * Maintain accurate drawing revision control, BOMs, and documentation within the company's PLM/ERP system. * Support die tryout and troubleshooting by revising drawings based on floor feedback. * Interpret and work from customer\-supplied part prints, models, and specifications. * Ensure compliance with internal drafting standards and, where applicable, customer or industry standards (ASME Y14\.5, etc) **Non\-essential Responsibilities:** * Performs other duties as directed. **Position Qualifications and Competency Statements:** **Required Qualifications** * Associate's degree or technical certificate in Drafting, Tool Design, Mechanical Design, or related field (or equivalent hands\-on experience). * 2\+ years of drafting experience in a tool \& die, stamping, or precision metal fabrication environment. * Proficiency in Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD Mechanical for 2D/3D die design and detailing. * Familiarity with ESPRIT CAM software for programming/reviewing machined die components. * Working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat for managing, marking up, and distributing drawing packages and PDFs. * Strong understanding of GD\&T and precision tolerancing. * Ability to read and interpret complex mechanical drawings and customer part prints. * Familiarity with progressive die design principles (strip layout, station sequencing, punch/die clearances). **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience specifically with micro\-miniature or high\-precision stamping dies. * Knowledge of sheet metal forming principles and stamping processes. * Familiarity with die tryout processes and troubleshooting. **Skills and Abilities:** * Strong spatial reasoning and jobs.title: GMS Development Program – Entry Level Power & Computer Engineer
jobs.description: At ERCOT, our diverse and dynamic work environment provides a platform on which employees can work together to build the future of the Texas power grid and wholesale market utilizing the latest technologies and resources. We encourage you to join our talented, dedicated workforce to develop world\-class solutions for today and tomorrow’s energy challenges while learning new skills and growing your career. ERCOT is committed to fostering inclusion at all levels of our company. It is the cornerstone of our corporate values of accountability, leadership, innovation, trust, and expertise. We know that individuals with a wide variety of talents, ideas, and experiences propel the innovation that drives our success. An inclusive and diverse workforce strengthens us and allows for a collaborative environment to solve the challenges that face our industry today and in the future. As a member of ERCOT Information Technology (IT) \- Grid and Market Solutions (GMS) team, you will work on cutting edge technology solutions that run the electric power grid and wholesale markets within the state of Texas. You will use your creativity and technical expertise to implement industry leading solutions that will help shape the future of the global electric power industry. https://www.ercot.com/careers/programs/gdp ERCOT’s GMS Development Program (GDP) is a 12–16\-month program designed to provide entry level and early career professionals with the skills necessary to be successful Power System and Computer Engineers. The program, which is based in the Grid \& Market Solutions (GMS) Department, will provide experience in day\-to\-day work and instruction in the fundamentals of electric power systems engineering, grid and market applications, software programming, and IT service and operations management. The GDP offers one\-on\-one mentoring, training, field trips, and special assignments. These assignments allow GDP engineers to become knowledgeable and familiar with the various business areas at ERCOT. The GMS leadership team prepares GDP engineers for a future career at ERCOT in power systems and computer engineering. Forecasting, Operator Training Simulator (OTS) etc. * Provide Engineering Support for a portfolio of Market Applications that include Security Constrained Economic Dispatch (SCED), Day\-Ahead Market (DAM), Reliability Unit Commitment (RUC), Congestion Revenue Rights (CRR), QSE Training Simulator etc. * Design, code, test, validate and implement modifications to Grid and Market applications while tools Job Competencies * Functional/Technical Skills * Problem Solving/Analysis * Planning * Decision\-making/Judgment * Quality * Communication (Verbal, Written and Presentation Skills) Power Systems **EDUCATION** * Bachelor's Degree Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Required).
