jobs.title: Associate Application Engineer
jobs.description: Position Overview: **FUJIFILM Electronic Materials, U.S.A., Inc.,** is a global leader in chemical solutions which enable the semiconductor industry and the digital universe. We have an exciting opportunity at our Mesa, AZ facility for an **Associate Application Engineer!** **The Role** This Associate Application Engineer is responsible for development of p\-CMP CMP processes and their introduction and implementation at customer sites. This role will also perform formulation development for developing new chemistries for p\-CMP CMP. Company Overview: FUJIFILM Electronic Materials, U.S.A. fuels innovation in the semiconductor industry—where chemistry meets technology. Our advanced materials and formulations enable manufacturers to build the microchips that power Artificial Intelligence, computers, electric vehicles, smartphones, and more. We’re a global business\-to\-business supplier of chemical formulations and advanced materials used for manufacturing and packaging semiconductors. Our chemical formulations allow top manufacturers to produce microchips that both power and connect our digital world. Think you’ve got what it takes to build a more connected world? Then connect with us today and challenge the boundaries of what’s possible—for the world and your future. We have six U.S. manufacturing and Research \& Development facilities, located in: Mesa, Arizona; Castroville, California; Hollister, California; Carrollton, Texas; and North Kingstown, Rhode Island—each offering unique local experiences, from vibrant cultural scenes to historic charm. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers Job Description: **RESPONSIBILITIES*** Develop, support and improve CMP \& p\-CMP processes for new \& existing products * Act as a process liaison between formulation development chemists and CMP polishing and metrology tools * Technical interface for customers. Support customers in troubleshooting exercises including product characterization and functional testing. Provide on\-site customer support, both domestic and international * Develop new CMP slurries \& p\-CMP formulations in conjunction with CSL/BSL/MSL/FSL slurries as per customer’s/semiconductor technology node need * Investigate chemistry and abrasive interactions with different dielectric and metal films * Fine\-tune chemistry to get desired defects and metrology performance for p\-CMP * Design, filter, analyze and summarize data using statistical software * Coordinates with engineering \& lab staff on process/formulation needs with respect to CMP \& p\-CMP chemistries. Leads cross\-functional teams and provide consultation and technical expertise to Applications, R\&D \& Process Development teams * Applies knowledge of acids/bases, corrosion inhibitors, chemical/particle interactions, electrochemistry, organic/ inorganic chemistry, and interfacial chemistry to CMP slurry development * Participates in new product development and commercialization **REQUIREMENTS*** A minimum of a BS degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Material Science or related fields with nine plus years of experience within the semiconductor industry, CMP slurries, polishing and metrology tools, and CMP process and product development is required. * An MS degree with a minimum of seven years or a PhD with 3 plus years of experience is preferred. * Analytical abilities, experimental skills and expertise in CMP process development, chemistry, and colloids \& interface science is required. Previous proven success in p\-CMP CMP processes is beneficial * Familiarity with Zeta Potential, corrosion, colloidal silica, and electrochemistry desired * Highly motivated, creative individual with a passion for research and development leading to commercialization of high\-impact practical applications/products * Excellent communication, data collection, time management and organizational skills required. * Proficiency in office software such as MS Excel, Word, PPT and Outlook required. * DoE, JMP, data analyses and technical reporting needed * Project management experience strongly preferred. * Ability to handle multiple projects and directions at the same time * Good interpersonal skills and customer interaction capability. * Fluent in Korean preferred * Ability to travel 40%, including international travel. * Ability to take calculated business risks and deal with uncertainty * Ability to work extensively in lab environment \& direct technicians to support project needs in an efficient manner * Must be able to communicate and work well with other professionals in a team environment * Job requires standing and working in the lab for a substantial part of every day **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS** We value a professional, adaptable, and collaborative work environment. The following competencies are essential for success in any role and reflect our commitment to effective teamwork, problem solving, and workplace communication.* **Resilience \-**Ability to adapt to workplace challenges, maintain professionalism, and manage responsibilities effectively. * **Communication \-**Capacity to clearly and professionally exchange ideas, interact respectfully with colleagues and customers, and foster positive workplace relationships. * **Reasoning \& Decision Making \-**Ability to analyze information, follow verbal and written instructions, and make logical, sound decisions. * **Comprehension \-**Capability to understand and complete tasks as assigned and solve problems effectively. * **Organizational Skills \-**Competence in managing multiple priorities, maintaining accuracy, and staying focused despite potential workplace distractions. **To all agencies: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of FUJIFILM about this requisition. All resumes submitted by search firms/employment agencies to any employee at FUJIFILM via\-email, the internet or in any form and/or method will be deemed the sole property of FUJIFILM, unless such search firms/employment agencies were engaged by FUJIFILM for this requisition and a valid agreement with FUJIFILM is in place. In the event a candidate who was submitted outside of the FUJIFILM agency engagement process is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid.** EEO Information: Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc. ADA Information: If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR Department (feus.humanresources@fujifilm.com).

jobs.title: Lead Systems Imaging Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** =========================== Systems engineering is a cross\-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation. In addition, Deliver customer image quality, easy workflow, innovative clinical solutions, product quality, reliability, serviceability, manufacturability, regulatory compliance, and cost for the General Imaging Ultrasound team. Provide systems architecture leadership across ultrasound imaging signal processing, signal path, image processing, probe integration, and related clinical imaging workflows. GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.**Job Description** =================== **Roles and Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Drive customer image quality for General Imaging Ultrasound products, including clinical image quality performance, workflow usability, and translation of customer and clinical feedback into engineering requirements. * Drive ultrasound imaging signal processing and signal path architecture across transmit, receive, beamforming, reconstruction, and downstream imaging subsystems. * Drive ultrasound imaging image processing strategy, including image optimization, post\-processing, display pipeline considerations, and related clinical imaging workflows. * Provide systems architecture leadership across hardware, software, probe, imaging, acoustic output, and clinical workflow functions to deliver high\-quality ultrasound products. * Responsible for requirements development, traceability and flow down, architecture / system design and analysis, FMEA, and development / execution of System Verification and Validation test procedures. * Develop methods to quantify subsystem interactions and their effects on product performance, including signal path, image processing, acoustic output, probe behavior, and clinical image quality. * Participate in software implementation for innovative future ultrasound projects using MATLAB and C\+\+. * Work across functions and team boundaries to define, design, and implement the next generation of ultrasound products. * Work with customers, Product Managers, GE clinical team, and field personnel to refine requirements that can be implemented by engineering teams. * Support manufacturing and the global installed base, and incorporate feedback into new hardware, software, and service specifications. * Lead continuous improvement activities by driving the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives. * Comply with the Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations. * Identify and report quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective action as required. * Maintain full Quality System Regulation (QSR), Current Good Manufacturing Practices (CGMP), regulatory compliance, and other legal requirements. * Ensure compliance and closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Outputs and Program Deliverables. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Master’s degree or equivalent in Ultrasound, Physics, Optics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related field AND 2 years of related experience in ultrasound and/or Imaging. * PhD in related field with no experience is accepted as well. * Ultrasound physics, imaging signal processing, signal path, and image processing knowledge at a graduate level required. * Software proficiency in both MATLAB and C\+\+. This would include, but not be limited to, the ability to create standalone code in both MATLAB and C\+\+ and navigate and debug large code sets in both languages. **Desired Characteristics** --------------------------- * Master’s degree plus 5 years work experience in ultrasound. PhD plus 2 years work experience in ultrasound. * High level understanding of artificial intelligence and deep learning imaging techniques, including practical use of AI in ultrasound image formation, image quality optimization, workflow assistance, classification, segmentation, or related clinical imaging objectives. * Experience with ultrasound probe design and the ability to relate probe specifications to customer impact. Knowledge of acoustic power, acoustic output management, and applicable IEC ultrasound standards is a strong plus. We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity. Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world\-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support. \#LI\-MA4 We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. jobs.title: Lead CNC Programmer 2nd Shift
jobs.description: Are you passionate about innovation? Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world? We operate with a founder’s mindset. We deliver innovation with passion, speed, and courage. We continuously challenge our thinking and are empowered to dream big and take smart risks. As a member of the CAD/CAM team, you will be an active contributor to the factory volume ramp and standardization efforts. **Job Description** =================== **This position is for 2nd shift.** **The Sandbox: State\-of\-the\-Art Tech \& Hardware** You’ll have access to an industry\-leading hardware and software stack: * CAD/CAM Suite: Siemens NX (5\-Axis Continuous Milling, VTL, VBM, HBM, Multi\-Axis EDM, etc). * Digital Twin \& Virtual Prototyping: 100% simulation coverage utilizing Vericut and Siemens Run My Virtual Machine. * Next\-Gen Hardware: Custom 10\-ton multi\-function grinding machines, massive 5\-axis mills, and large VTLs/VBMs up to 2\.5m. Advanced Diagnostics \& Automation: Closed\-Loop Machining (CLM), custom Renishaw probing routines, Caron Engineering TMaC, and Modal Analysis (tap testing) hardware/software. * **What you’ll do** * Process Architecture: Design and optimize high\-efficiency CNC programs for complex multi\-axis setups cutting high\-temperature superalloys (Inconel, Rene, and exotic nickels). * Virtual Prototyping: Use digital twin software (Vericut) to validate code and optimize toolpaths in a risk\-free virtual environment before hitting the shop floor. * Smart Machining: Develop adaptive probing routines, macro programming, and closed\-loop machining processes to make complex setups smooth and predictable. * New Equipment Integration: Partner with Manufacturing Engineers and shop\-floor teams to commission new multi\-million\-dollar machine tools and establish baseline machining standards. * Cross\-Functional Teamwork: Act as a technical mentor and partner on the floor—troubleshooting setups, proving out first\-piece components, and sharing knowledge across the team. * Support large VTL, VMB, 5\-axis mill, multi\-purpose turn/grind machines up to 2\.5m * Generate and maintain CNC programs utilizing NX\-CAM or other software. This could include multi\-axis milling, turning, grinding and/or EDM. * Create programs following standards and qualified machining parameters * Provide CNC related support to M.E. (Manufacturing Engineer) and provide operator training during new / rebuilt machine startup and / or process improvements. * Provide daily operator support in the form of CNC programming and troubleshooting support to the shop floor. * Support and implement tooling \& fixturing requirements associated with CNC machine tools. * Generate and support workstation instructions (methods) for CNC related issues. * Initiate and lead process improvement projects to improve safety, quality, cost and delivery. * Provide effective communication to appropriate team members when needed. * Work effectively as an individual and in a team\-based environment in a matrixed organization. * Work effectively in a fast\-paced environment while embracing and driving positive change inside and outside 5\-axis CNC programs using a CAM (preferably NX) system. * Minimum of 1 year of experience with high\-level machine tool controls including sub\-routine(macro), Renishaw probing routine, and variable based programming, as well as CLM (closed loop machining) * Significant "hands\-on" background as a machinist, with the ability to personally setup and prove out complex first\-piece programs. * A track record of managing tight tolerances on large\-format equipment (VTLs/VBMs/etc up to 2\.5m) where part deflection, work hardening, and thermal stability are critical factors * Extensive experience machining nickel\-based superalloys (Inconel, Rene, Hastelloy, etc.) common in Heavy Duty Gas Turbine (HDGT) or Aerospace industry * Strong problem solving and organization skills, with above average shop math skills in geometry and trigonometry. * Experience using Vericut (preferred) or other CNC verification/machine simulation software. * Strong familiarity with multiple machine Preferred Qualifications * Domain experience in AI Research, Predictive Modeling, Automation, or Decision Intelligence. * Experience with fine\-tuning, adaptation, evaluation frameworks, and safety/guardrails for large language model (LLM) systems. * Familiarity with real\-time ML serving architectures, feature stores, and low\-latency systems. * Exposure to advanced modeling techniques, such as deep learning, reinforcement learning, or natural language processing. * Experience with big\-data and pipeline technologies (Spark, Snowflake, Airflow, DBT). * Knowledge of model explainability, fairness, and governance in regulated industries. jobs.title: IT Security Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: GLOTECH, Inc., founded in 1995, is a privately and minority\-owned company serving military, federal and commercial clients. We are a successful Information Technology firm with a large staff currently providing superior information technology and advanced engineering services around the world. Our success is built on attracting and retaining quality staff through a highly competitive benefits package with a special focus on continuing career development and corporate financial support. We also maintain a collegial working environment and offer our staff opportunities to improve and enhance their skills. GLOTECH is committed to a comprehensive employee benefits program that helps our employees stay healthy, feel secure and maintain a work/life balance. We provide medical dental and vision care, disability insurance (short and long term), Life \& AD\&D Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care and Commuter Transportation and Parking Reimbursement), and Employee Assistance Programs. Additionally, we provide Annual Leave, Sick Leave, Holiday Pay, Educational Assistance, Certification /Training Reimbursement, and a 401(k)\-retirement savings contribution plan (with employer match). Responsibilities: GLOTECH, Inc. is seeking a Security Engineer to support the corporate office of United Parks \& Resorts located in Orlando, Florida. The role will design, install, administer, and optimize company servers, storage infrastructure, and related components to achieve high performance of the various business applications supported. This includes ensuring the availability of client/server applications, configuring all new implementations, and developing processes and procedures for ongoing management of the server environment. Where applicable, this position will oversee the physical and logical security, integrity, and safety of the data center/server farm. Lead and mentor a team on the administration of 1000 servers across the enterprise. Oversee the administration for Hyper\-V and VMware virtual server environments and shared storage infrastructure. Troubleshoot any production issues that arise and guide the system administrators through hurdles on IT Projects. **Primary Responsibilities** * Provide senior level resolution to internal client issues, champion change and effectively manage the implementation of new ideas. * Ongoing maintenance of existing System Center infrastructure. Team effort involving fellow System Engineers and Administration staff. Creation and execution of future SCOR automation run books as required by the business. Assist in SCOM alert tuning, closure event tuning, and reporting. SCCM administration duties are to maintain and enhance already existing infrastructure, including the expansion of the environment from single primary multiple secondary sites to central administration, two primaries, and 2x secondary. * Proactive monitoring of all servers, applications and services using a combination of tools to ensure high availability and exceed SLAs, maintain server performance, collect, and review system data for capacity and planning purposes. Update/monitor server KPIs at defined intervals and compile monthly report summarizing the health/status of servers across the enterprise. * Perform a wide range of system engineering and administration duties on web, application, database, and other servers and storage infrastructure, including install, debug, maintain, upgrade, and tier\-3 support. This would include testing and deployment of hardware and software, assist in disaster recovery planning and create/maintain documentation for all processes and procedures, among other duties. Maintain security best practices on all operating systems. * Participate in on\-call rotation to provide off\-hour support; perform troubleshooting as needed; work closely with the IT team to provide end\-user support and issue resolution, leading efforts for root cause analysis. * Assist in developing, implementing, testing, and maintaining server level disaster recovery plans. * Collaborate with other IT teams to research, evaluate and recommend system technologies to support business requirements. * Ability to perform a wide range of system administration duties on web, application, database, and other servers, including install, debug, maintain, upgrade, and general support. This would include testing and deployment of hardware and software, performing regular and on\-demand backups and recoveries, and create/maintain documentation for all processes and procedures, among other duties. * Provide guidance to administrators on the infrastructure team, as well as other departments within IT. * Proactive monitoring of all servers, applications and services using a combination of tools to ensure high availability and exceed SLAs; maintain peak server performance; collect and review system data for capacity and planning/forecasting purposes; update / monitor server KPIs at defined intervals; compile monthly report summarizing the health/status of servers across the enterprise. * Participate in on\-call rotation to provide off\-hour support; perform troubleshooting as needed; work closely with the IT team to provide end\-user support and issue resolution, support efforts for root cause analysis. * Assist in developing, implementing, testing, and maintaining disaster recovery plans for the server and storage infrastructure, including application availability and business continuity. * Collaborate with other IT teams to research, evaluate and recommend system technologies to support business requirements. * Assist with daily support and maintenance of the storage arrays including but not limited to providing performance metrics, overall health checks and recommendations to maintain service levels. * Assist with maintaining RDS and Virtual Desktop Environments Qualifications: * College degree or equivalent. * Minimum 7 years’ experience with Hardware \& networking. * Ability to organize and prioritize multiple complex projects. * Ability to coordinate cross\-functional work teams toward project completion. * Demonstrated effective leadership and influence skills. * Demonstrated advanced written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to effectively communicate issues and resolutions to all levels of the organization. * Advance knowledge in both network and security practices and processes. * Experience in securing both on prem and cloud infrastructure. * Advanced knowledge of installations, upgrades, patching, and troubleshooting of Server operating systems * Advanced knowledge and experience with Microsoft Active Directory and Group Policy. * Advanced knowledge and experience with Microsoft System Center suite. * Strong technical aptitude and ability to research \& solve complex issues independently. * Knowledge in both Microsoft and Linux operating systems. * PowerShell scripting skills * Experience with Microsoft clustering technologies used in conjunction with SQL Server, DHCP Server, and Hyper\-V * Experience in leading initiatives for root cause analysis and new system evaluations * Experience with NAS/SAN administration **Preferred Skills and Experience** * MCSA, MCSE preferred * Experience migrating applications to Cloud Platform preferred. * Experience migrating applications to Cloud Platform preferred. * Previous hospitality or theme park experience is desirable. **GLOTECH, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer \- Minorities/Females/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.**

jobs.description: **Senior Professional, Software Engineer** ========================================== Date: Sep 29, 2026 Location: Any city, TX, US, 99999 Req ID: 38907 Work Mode: Default Be part of a team that unleashes the power of leading\-edge technologies to help improve the health and well\-being of those most vulnerable in our country and communities. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. You’ll add to your technical credentials and certifications while enjoying a generous, flexible vacation policy and educational assistance. jobs.title: Senior V&V Engineer – Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Test Bench
jobs.description: ### **Who we are** Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle\-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation\-as\-a\-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short\-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world's first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3\-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation. The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom\-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick\-up and drop\-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all\-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations. ### **About the role** The Senior V\&V Engineer – HIL \& Bench will build, execute, and scale Gatik's hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing infrastructure. In this role, you will test autonomous vehicle software on production compute units, ECUs, sensors, and drive\-by\-wire hardware before code ever touches a physical vehicle. You will design real\-time hardware test benches, execute fault\-injection suites, and validate ASIL functional safety mechanisms under hardware\-accurate conditions. This role is onsite 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office! ### **What you'll do** ### **Key Responsibilities** * **HIL Architecture \& Maintenance:** Design, construct, and maintain multi\-ECU HIL test benches representing complete AV vehicle electronics. * **Sensor Injection \& Signal Simulation:** Integrate sensor simulation technology into real\-time test setups. * **Hardware Fault Injection:** Develop automated physical and electrical fault\-injection test suites (e.g., open circuit, short to ground, latency spikes, corrupted signals, power dropouts). * **Automated Test Frameworks:** Write robust Python and C\+\+ test scripts within CI/CD pipelines to execute overnight regression suites on physical HIL rigs. * **ISO 26262 Hardware Verification:** Execute requirements\-based testing to generate formal V\&V audit evidence for ISO 26262 hardware functional safety compliance. * **Cross\-Team Issue Triaging:** Root\-cause hardware\-software interface bugs, bus timing errors, and ECU communication anomalies alongside Hardware and Autonomy engineering teams. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * **Education:** B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or Robotics. * **Experience:** 5\+ years in HIL test environment development and execution for autonomous driving, ADAS, or automotive systems. * **Technical Mastery:** * + Proven expertise setting up and operating commercial HIL hardware (dSPACE SCALEXIO/AutoBox, NI PXI, Vector VT System). + Advanced scripting skills in Python and MATLAB/Simulink for automated test execution. + Deep understanding of CAN, CAN\-FD, Automotive Ethernet, LIN, SPI, and GMSL/FPD\-Link protocols. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience in ISO 26262 V\&V sign\-off audits for production vehicle releases. Salary Range \- $160,000\- $240,000 ### **More about Gatik** Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas\-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the *first and only* company to achieve fully driverless middle\-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability. We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology \- an integration of software and hardware \- to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point\-to\-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik's well\-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper\-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate\-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations. Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles. ### **Notable News** * Forbes: Forget robotaxis. Upstart Gatik sees middle\-mile deliveries as the path to profitable AVs * Tech Brew: Gatik AI exec unpacks the regulations that could shape the AV industry * Business Wire: Gatik Paves the Way for Safe Driverless Operations ('Freight\-Only') at Scale with Industry\-First Third\-Party Safety Assessment Framework * Auto Futures: Autonomous Trucking Group Gatik Secures Investment From NIPPON EXPRESS HOLDINGS * Automotive News: Gatik foresees hundreds of self\-driving trucks on road soon, and that's just the beginning * Forbes: Isuzu And Gatik Go All In To Scale Up Driverless Freight Services * Bloomberg: Autonomous Vehicle Startup Takes Off by Picking Off Easier Routes * Reuters: Driverless vehicles on limited routes bump along despite US robotaxi scrutiny ### **Taking care of our team** At Gatik, we connect people of extraordinary talent and experience to an opportunity to create a more resilient supply chain and contribute to our environment's sustainability. We are diverse in our backgrounds and perspectives yet united by a bold vision and shared commitment to our values. Our culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect and agility. We at Gatik strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that together we can do great things. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Data Engineer supports our distribution operations by building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and data pipelines across sales, inventory, warehouse, and vendor systems. This role transforms ERP and point\-of\-sale data into actionable insights for branch managers, purchasing, and executive leadership — helping drive smarter inventory decisions, pricing accuracy, and operational efficiency across our distribution network.**Key Responsibilities*****Reporting \& Analytics**** Design and maintain dashboards for key distribution metrics: inventory turns, fill rates, branch sales performance, gross margin by product line, and vendor rebate tracking * Write and optimize SQL queries against ERP data (e.g., Infor CloudSuite, or similar distribution ERP) to support pricing, purchasing, and sales reporting * Build automated reporting for branch/location performance comparisons, slow\-moving vs. fast\-moving SKUs, and seasonal demand trends (critical in HVAC given seasonal sales cycles) * Support rebate and vendor incentive program reporting/reconciliation * Automate recurring reports for sales teams, purchasing managers, and branch operations to reduce manual Excel work ***Data Management**** Maintain data pipelines feeding from ERP, warehouse management system (WMS), and e\-commerce/B2B ordering platforms into the reporting/data warehouse layer * Monitor data integrity across item master data, pricing tables, vendor catalogs, and multi\-warehouse inventory records * Troubleshoot discrepancies between systems (e.g., ERP vs. WMS inventory counts, EDI order data mismatches) * Support data cleanup initiatives for SKU rationalization, vendor part number cross\-referencing, and pricing matrix accuracy ***Systems \& Technical Support**** Support and troubleshooting issue with ERP reporting modules, EDI transactions with vendors/manufacturers ***Documentation \& Compliance**** Maintain documentation on data sources, report logic, and business rules specific to distribution workflows (pricing tiers, contract pricing, rebate calculations) * Ensure reporting supports accurate sales tax, compliance, and audit requirements across multi\-state branch operations ***Collaboration \& Communication**** Work directly with end users and sales leadership to understand reporting needs specific to HVAC seasonality and product mix * Present inventory and sales performance insights in a clear format for non\-technical branch staff * Train counter/branch staff and sales reps on accessing dashboards and self\-service reporting tools ***Required Qualifications**** Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience) * Experience in a data/reporting analyst role, ideally within distribution, wholesale, or supply chain * Proficiency in SQL (complex queries, joins across ERP tables) * Experience with at least one BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) * Familiarity with distribution/wholesale ERP systems (Infor, or similar) * Understanding of inventory management concepts (turns, fill rate, min/max, safety stock) * Strong analytical skills with attention to detail on pricing/margin data ***Preferred Qualifications**** Familiarity with EDI transactions (850, 810, 856\) used with manufacturers and big\-box customers * Understanding of HVAC industry seasonality and its impact on inventory/sales cycles * Experience with rebate/incentive program reporting * Knowledge of Power BI, Python, or advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot) * Experience supporting multi\-branch/multi\-warehouse operations ***Tools \& Technologies**** ERP: Infor * BI Tools: Power BI / Tableau / Claude AI * Databases: SQL Server / Postgres / OpenEdge * EDI: SPS Commerce, LBMX or similar * Other: Excel, WMS reporting tools

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Date:** Sep 28, 2026 **Location:** CHICAGO, IL, US, 60654\-4203 **Company:** Grainger Businesses **Work Location Type:** **Hybrid** **Req Number** 334987 **About Grainger** W.W. Grainger, Inc. is a leading broad line distributor with operations primarily in North America and Japan. At Grainger, We Keep the World Working® by serving more than 4\.6 million customers worldwide with maintenance, repair and operating (MRO) products and value\-added solutions delivered through innovative technology and deep customer expertise. Known for its commitment to service and purpose\-driven culture, the Company reported 2025 revenue of $17\.9 billion. For more information, visit www.grainger.com. **Compensation** The anticipated base pay compensation range for this position is $112,900\.00 **–** $188,100\.00\. This role is eligible for an incentive target of up to 10% or $, based on the achievement of individual and company performance objectives in accordance with the current terms of the incentive program which are subject to change. This position is not eligible for any form of sponsorship now or in the future. Individuals requiring sponsorship (e.g. OPT or H1B visa status) should not apply. Only individuals authorized to work in the United States now and for the foreseeable future will be considered for this position. **Rewards and Benefits** With benefits starting on day one, our programs provide choice and flexibility to meet team members' individual needs, including: * Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans with coverage starting on day one of employment and 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist to support your emotional wellbeing. * 23 paid time off (PTO) days annually for full\-time employees (accrual prorated based on employment start date) and 6 company holidays per year. * 6% company contribution to a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required. * Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and free access to financial counseling, education, and tools. * Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non\-birth parents. For additional information and details regarding Grainger’s benefits, please click on the link below: https://experience100\.ehr.com/grainger/Home/Tools\-Resources/Key\-Resources/New\-Hire **Grainger Benefits** The pay range provided above is not a guarantee of compensation. The range reflects the potential base pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual base pay compensation will depend, in part, on factors such as geographic work location and relevant experience and skills. The anticipated compensation range described above is subject to change and the compensation ultimately paid may be higher or lower than the range described above. Grainger reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion at any time, consistent with applicable law. This position is not eligible for any form of sponsorship now or in the future. Individuals requiring sponsorship (e.g. OPT or H1B visa status) should not apply. Only individuals authorized to work in the United States now and for the foreseeable future will be considered for this position. **Position Details** We’re forming a new team which supports the publishing process that brings product data to Grainger.com. As a Senior Software Engineer (Software Engineer III) on this team you will be involved in the full systems life cycle and responsible for designing, coding, configuring, testing, implementing and supporting application software and systems that are delivered on time and within budget.You will work closely with other technical teams, business stakeholders, and product managers to understand the business requirements that drive the design of high quality technical solutions. The publishing process impacts products and systems across multiple domains, so you will work on internal tools and customer\-facing systems. Chicago, IL is the preferred location with a hybrid work environment (2 days per week in the Merchandise Mart office). We will also consider highly qualified remote candidates who are willing to travel to Chicago for onboarding and occasional team meetings. Onsite onboarding will be required. **You Will** • Build applications and develop product solutions in partnership with engineers, architects, product designers, and product managers, leading to scalable, maintainable, and user\- friendly software solutions. • Utilize Full Stack development skills (primarily React and Java) based on specific platform or domain needs. • Implement continuous delivery improvements and drive engineering best practices, with a focus on quality gates and deployment confidence. • Provide production system support, including participating in an evening on\-call rotation and collaborating with engineers and stakeholders to debug issues and uncover root causes. • Support team activities and pair with peers to work on stories • Consistently practice sensible defaults. **You Have** * Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required • 3\+ years experience with modern software engineering; designing, building, and deploying scalable software applications required • Full stack software development experience in modern technologies such as React, Java, Typescript • Working knowledge of backend integration patterns including REST APIs, event\-driven systems, and asynchronous workflows • Understanding of distributed system design • Familiarity with using AI agents to understand existing systems, write code, improve workflows. • Experience analyzing and interpreting complex problems and processes • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps practices *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.* *We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible work environment that includes both providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the application and hiring process as well as throughout the course of one’s employment, should you need a reasonable accommodation during the application and selection process, including, but not limited to use of our website, any part of the application, interview or hiring process, please advise us so that we can provide appropriate assistance.*

jobs.title: IT STATEWIDE APPLICATIONS SENIOR DEVELOPER 1-3 (APPDM FINANCIAL LWC)
jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ The Division of Administration/Office of Technology Services has a vacancy. This position is located in the Applications and Data Management (AppDM) Section. Req. 226432\. POS \# 50549011 The Office of Technology Services (OTS) aims to be a responsible partner in delivering innovative, effective, and reliable solutions that support and enhance the IT functions within the Executive Branch Departments. The Office of Technology Services will work to increase the return on the State's investment in technology by promoting smart decision\-making, solving problems intelligently, increasing the rate of project success, and fostering a skilled and professional staff. The incumbent of this position will be supervised by the IT Statewide Applications Manager and will provide strategic level management consulting to various levels within Louisiana Works (LaWorks) for project management, planning, program analysis, specifications, aberration research, development and QA for highly complex projects relative to several major functional components of the LaWorks; facilitating the strategic goals and direction of organizational policy for information systems through applications and web development; and successfully completing projects based on priorities established by the business units. This position may require travel to other work locations to perform job duties, attend meetings, and participate in training, which will require a current, valid driver's license. The Division of Administration is the state government’s management arm and the hub of its financial operations. Division offices perform a wide variety of activities including the following: * Overseeing the state’s capital construction program * Working to provide state and federal grants for community development * Development of the state budget * Providing technology services * Giving agencies guidance in the state purchasing and contracting process as they seek goods and services * Administering a program that provides federal funds to help Louisiana residents recover from a series of devastating hurricanes **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Five years of experience in information technology; OR Six years of full\-time work experience in any field plus three years of experience in information technology; OR An associate's degree in information technology plus three years of experience in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree plus three years of experience in information technology; OR A bachelor’s degree with twenty\-four semester hours in an information technology, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or business analytics field plus two years of experience in information technology; OR A master’s degree plus two years of experience in information technology. EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION: Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full\-time work experience in any field. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any field. NOTE: A certification in an approved area may be substituted for the education and/or experience requirements at the time of hire or promotion, provided the appointment is made from a Certificate of Eligibles. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: * Performs management consulting, planning, program analysis, quality assurance, technical resource and project management functions in support of LaWorks applications systems. Transfer technical and business knowledge of agency data, systems and existing business rules to applications staff. * Performs business analysis to develop business impact statements, develop legislative fiscal notes, gather business unit requirements, prepare and maintain project, program, and/or system specifications and guidelines for users' electronic systems. Use in depth knowledge of .NET and SQL design techniques to provide guidance to development staff as well as write definitions and descriptions of data elements for use by professionals and users. Prepares and maintains user guides and lT Standards \& Procedures documents. * Provides program analysis, planning, quality assurance, project management, technical analysis, design, development and quality assurance for all web\-based systems at LaWorks. Ensures that IT applications work is accomplished in a timely manner as specified by the user(s) and in a manner consistent with the OTS' standards and applications development methodologies. Utilizes knowledge of and experience with a variety of information system processing equipment to provide information and recommendations on projects relating to the operation and management of information infrastructure technology. Reports project statuses to supervisors. * Assesses organizational structures, department objectives, control procedures, information technology infrastructure, problem areas and operational methods in order to recommend corrective actions of same and to determine short and long\-range system needs. * Develops process for, implements process for and conducts and oversees quality assurance reviews as well as manage the Change Management Board who handles all Requests for Change documentation and approvals of existing and proposed systems and services prior to production deployment. * Functionally provide analysis, planning, quality assurance and supervision/maintenance for the Louisiana Unemployment Insurance \- Benefits Payment System (Due to restrictions on the handling of IRS' Treasury Offset Program data, only LaWorks IT staff can directly maintain TOP data.) * Performs all other tasks, special projects, analysis, studies and plans as directed. Position\-Specific Details: **Appointment Type:** This vacancy will be filled by new hire or by promotion of a current permanent status classified employee. **Location:** This is a full\-time, on\-site position located in the Greater Baton Rouge area. **Career Progression:** This vacancy participates in a career progression group and may be filled from this recruitment as an IT Statewide Applications Senior Developer 1, 2 or 3\. **Compensation:** The salary range listed on the job posting reflects the pay grade minimum and maximum for the IT Statewide Applications Senior Developer 1 job title. The salary range pay grade minimum and maximum for the other levels of the career progression group can be viewed using the links below: IT Statewide Applications SR Developer 2 IT Statewide Applications SR Developer 3 **Substitution:** Applicants who do not meet the minimum education of experience qualifications may receive experience credit from Civil Service approved certifications for up to two years of experience, which may be substituted for the bachelor's degree. Please see the list of approved Certifications for Substitutions at https://www.doa.la.gov/doa/ots/careers/certifications\-for\-substitutions. ***Louisiana is a "State as a Model Employer" for People with Disabilities.*** How To Apply: **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. To apply for this vacancy, click on the “Apply” link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. * Information to support your eligibility for this job title must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education).Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections on your application. Applications may be rejected if incomplete. Prior to a new hire, a background check, including criminal record history, will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment, but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. A criminal history check may be conducted on employees changing positions, including promotions, demotions, details, reassignments, and transfers. Also, prospective employees may be subject to pre\-employment drug testing. New hires will be subject to employment eligibility verification via the federal government's E\-Verify system. **For further information about this vacancy, contact:** Danielle Martin HR Analyst Division of Administration/Office of Human Resources Email: Danielle.Martin@la.gov

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Elixir
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** Green Light is a healthcare technology company focused on helping health plan dollars go as far as possible. Our systems operate on large\-scale healthcare data and require high reliability, correctness, and performance. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate production systems using an Elixir\-based stack. This role is ideal for engineers who prefer **server\-driven architecture**, value **system simplicity**, and enjoy solving complex problems under real\-world constraints. This is a full\-stack role. You will have significant ownership over system design, performance, and reliability, and will help shape the long\-term technical direction of the platform. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Design, build, and operate production systems using **Elixir, OTP, and Phoenix** * Own services end\-to\-end: architecture, implementation, deployment, and production support * Build **interactive user interfaces** * Design and evolve systems for **high\-throughput data processing** * Work with **relational database systems** * Improve system **performance, observability, and reliability** in production * Participate in **incident response, debugging, and root cause analysis** * Contribute to **architectural decisions** with a focus on long\-term maintainability * Collaborate across engineering, product, and operations to deliver high\-impact features * Mentor engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture * Apply **secure coding practices** and ensure systems meet healthcare data privacy and security requirements **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** * Strong production experience with **Elixir**, including OTP and BEAM fundamentals * Experience building applications with **Phoenix** (LiveView experience is a plus) * Experience with **Git**\-based version control workflows and source code management platforms, including branching strategies and merge/pull request processes * Familiarity with **agile** development practices, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and iterative delivery * Experience working with **CI/CD pipelines** \- maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting automated build and deployment workflows * Ability to write clear, well\-scoped tickets and manage work items throughout the development **lifecycle** * Experience designing and operating **distributed systems** or high\-reliability services * Experience working with **relational databases** in production environments * Strong understanding of **functional programming principles** * Experience building **APIs** and backend systems * Experience conducting **peer code reviews** and providing **constructive**, actionable feedback * Ability to reason about **performance, concurrency, and system trade\-offs** * Comfortable owning production systems, including incident response * Experience working in **Linux\-based or containerized environments,** including **Docker** **TEAM \& CULTURE** * Tight\-knit, collaborative team of engineers across multiple disciplines * Close partnership between application and data\-focused engineers * Strong emphasis on **cross\-functional learning and shared ownership** * Culture of **pragmatic problem\-solving, accountability, and continuous improvement** **WHAT TO EXPECT IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS** You will play a key role in building new functionality and supporting a platform to assist health plans in managing negotiation and dispute resolution workflows in a regulated healthcare environment. This includes: * Designing and implementing systems on top of **large\-scale data platforms** * Building performant workflows for analyzing and comparing complex reimbursement scenarios * Partnering with domain experts to translate regulatory and operational requirements into robust software systems This is a high\-impact system with meaningful design ownership, built on top of substantial data assets. **WHAT TO EXPECT** * Primarily **server\-driven web architecture** using Elixir and Phoenix * Systems designed for **correctness, auditability, and reliability** * Emphasis on **pragmatic engineering over trend\-chasing** * Work involves **complex, real\-world data and domain constraints** **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience working with very **large datasets or data\-intensive systems** * Familiarity with **observability tooling** (metrics, tracing, logging) * Experience in **healthcare or other regulated domains** * Exposure to interoperability standards (e.g., claims, EDI, HL7, FHIR)

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Frontend)
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Gridline is here to redefine how private markets operate, making them faster, smarter, and more accessible. We are setting a new standard by building the Turnkey Alternatives Management Platform (TAMP) to help wealth managers run private market programs at scale. As a ledger\-native system of record, Gridline provides a single source of truth that tracks the entire investment lifecycle down to the transaction layer, enabling RIAs, family offices, and private banks to manage their private markets business in one place. Our team brings deep experience across both enterprise technology and alternative investments to build the infrastructure layer the industry has always lacked. Backed by an $18\.5M Series A led by FINTOP, we are creating the systems and structuring the data required to define the next generation of private market investing. Are you up to the challenge? ### **The Opportunity** As a frontend Software Engineer at Gridline, you will be the primary visual architect and user experience champion powering our alternative investment platform. You will hold end\-to\-end ownership of the user interface \- from crafting clean, responsive UI component systems to designing intuitive product workflows for complex financial data. As a key member of our engineering team, you will help us maintain the high standards required for a fintech platform. Our high\-velocity team of builders value systems thinking and long\-term impact, and your role will be critical in evolving our SaaS client experience, ensuring our platform remains performant, beautiful, and capable of streamlining sophisticated financial workflows. This is an amazing opportunity to join Gridline at this inflection point, reporting directly to our Director of Engineering. ### **In this role you will...** * **Maintain A High Standard For Frontend Design \& Craft:** Act as both frontend developer and UI/UX designer, defining visual standards, component patterns, and interaction models across the platform. * **Build Scalable Interfaces:** Develop, maintain, and optimize highly responsive, accessible web applications using React (TypeScript) built with Claude Code. * **Architect SaaS User Experiences:** Translate complex fintech data (such as fund performance metrics and accounting data) into intuitive visual interfaces that spans workflows (e.g. onboarding), dashboards, and reporting tools \- for both internal and external customers. * **Collaborate Cross\-Functionally:** Partner closely with product, backend engineering, and operations teams to translate complex technical and business requirements into seamless client experiences. * **Ensure Performance \& Polish:** Implement robust web performance, cross\-browser consistency, and state management strategies to maintain a high bar for speed, polish, and stability in a regulated environment. ### **You have...** * **Experience:** At least 4 years of frontend engineering experience, specifically with React and TypeScript, along with proven hands\-on UI/UX design capabilities (translating wireframes, user flows, and product specs into production layout without dedicated design handoffs). * **AI Integration:** At least some experience with Claude Code, LLM prompt engineering, and AI\-assisted UI/UX development. * **Domain Expertise:** Ideally, prior experience in Fintech or regulated industries, specifically with dashboards, data visualization, transaction workflows, or complex SaaS platforms. * **Location:** Based in Atlanta, GA (hybrid). ### **Our tech stack is...** * Golang (backend) * React \- JavaScript/Typescript (frontend) * AWS (Terraform / Terragrunt) * MySQL * Salary is determined by a variety of factors, including specialized skills, experience, and relevant education or training. * This salary range is one component of our total rewards package. ### **We offer...** * **Impact:** The opportunity to join a Series A fintech at a high\-growth inflection point. * **Mission\-Driven Work:** The ability to revolutionize the private markets space and build the industry’s infrastructure layer. * **Elite Collaboration:** A tight\-knit team of experienced operators and builders who are passionate about scaling startups. * **Ownership:** A high\-autonomy environment where you are encouraged to take ownership and solve complex problems. * **Full Suite of Benefits:** Competitive salary, equity, and flexible PTO, plus robust medical, dental, and vision coverage. *Gridline is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern - S
jobs.description: About the Role: Turn your classroom learning into real\-world impact with H\&R Block’s Embark 2027 Summer Internship Program, open to students studying **Computer Science** and **Software Engineering**. This 11\-week paid internship offers meaningful, real\-world experience that aligns with your field of study while making a valuable impact on our organization. The Embark 2027 Summer Internship runs from May 17, 2027 – July 30, 2027\. You’ll work at our corporate headquarters in the heart of downtown Kansas City’s Power \& Light District, where you’re just steps, or a streetcar ride, away from incredible restaurants, entertainment, and city energy. Inside our building, you’ll have access to amenities that make work\-life balance easy, including an onsite Starbucks, a company dining hall with plenty of options, a free fitness center, and free parking! Program Highlights:* $25/hour compensation * Paid PTO during H\&R Block’s annual Reboot Week (June 28 – July 2\) * Housing stipend provided for students whose permanent address is more than 50 miles from the KC metro Throughout the 11\-week internship, under the guidance of a leader, some of the internship responsibilities will include:* Research, gather and organize data to provide information for special projects or reports. * Work closely with the QA, User Experience and other teams to ensure consistent understanding of requirements and approach. * Write, test, debug, and maintain code that supports real products and customer experiences * Investigate technical problems and collaborate with team members to identify and implement solutions * Participate in Agile team activities, including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and other team ceremonies * Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to strengthen code quality and development practices * Learn existing applications, systems, architecture, and development practices while contributing to an established codebase * Design, develop and maintain software components and products that support H\&R Block business applications. * Use tools, languages, coding standards and best practices to develop new product features and maintain year over year product functionality and enhancements. * Work alongside experienced engineers while receiving ongoing coaching, feedback, and opportunities for technical development * Interns will be provided with significant guidance and mentoring but will also be encouraged to work independently as well. Throughout the 11\-week internship, as a part of the Embark program, interns will also participate in workshops and events that align with the program's four pillars: Professional Development: includes the basics for a professional role, everything from using Microsoft Office to setting up a Teams meeting and giving a presentation. Giveback: involves participating in Make Every Block Better community service events. The goal is to teach the importance of community, make an impact, and provide bonding time for teams. Networking: entails meeting various executives with offices at H\&R Block’s headquarters, having lunch with directors and vice presidents, spending time with a mentor and getting to know people beyond their assigned department. Connected Culture: is meant to be fun and teach the importance of working hard and playing hard. H\&R Block might take the interns to a Kansas City Royals game or facilitate other competitions meant to be fun or instill teamwork. Required Qualifications: Education:* High school diploma or equivalent * Seeking to obtain a degree in **Information Technology**, **Computer Science**, **Information Science**, **Software Engineering,** or some similar discipline with a GPA of 3\.0 or above * Ability to work as part of a diverse team and independently * Highly motivated, organized, reliable, and detail\-oriented * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Quick learner and not afraid to work with new computer\-based programs and databases * Ability to be effective and contribute in a fast\-paced corporate environment Work Experience:* No previous work experience necessary Preferred Qualifications: * Foundational knowledge of software development concepts, object\-oriented programming, and the software development lifecycle (SDLC) * Experience with or exposure to one or more programming languages, such as C\#, .NET, Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar technologies * Familiarity with cloud technologies and development environments, particularly Microsoft Azure * Exposure to web services, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architecture, or cloud\-native application development * Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL databases, such as SQL Server or Cosmos DB * Interest in mobile application development and native mobile experiences * Familiarity with source control, CI/CD, or development collaboration tools such as Git and Azure DevOps * Interest in AI\-first software engineering, including the responsible use of AI\-assisted development tools * Exposure to or interest in Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning, AI agents, or AI\-enabled application development Why work for us: At H\&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation. That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well\-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Architect, Public Sector
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Solutions Architect **Compensation** ---------------- * $218\.8K – $300\.9K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= Harvey is bringing its AI platform to the U.S. federal government — defense and civilian agencies whose legal, acquisition, and program teams are asking how to adopt AI responsibly. You will be Harvey's first Solutions Architect dedicated to public sector: the technical lead on federal opportunities, the person who designs how Harvey is deployed securely inside government environments, and the one who writes the playbook the rest of the team will follow. You will sit at the intersection of Harvey's platform, agency stakeholders (legal, IT, security, acquisition, and program offices), and our Security \& Trust, Legal Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams. This is an opportunity to help define how AI is adopted across the federal government and to build a flagship public\-sector practice at one of the fastest\-moving companies in applied AI. **What You'll Do** ================== * Lead technical discovery and solution design for federal prospects and customers — defense and civilian — working with legal, IT, security, acquisition, and program stakeholders. * Design, document, and defend secure, compliant architectures for Harvey in government environments, including Harvey's FedRAMP High environment, identity and access patterns, integrations, and data\-handling requirements (CUI, records retention, auditability). * Own the technical thread on a focused portfolio of high\-impact federal accounts, from first conversation through rollout, adoption, and expansion. * Be the field\-facing technical partner to Security \& Trust on agency security reviews — FedRAMP High controls, DoD Impact Levels, ATO and authorization boundaries, NIST 800\-53 — and translate them for program owners and counsel. * Work with Legal Engineers and Customer Success Managers to turn agency workflows and legal or policy use cases into concrete solutions, reusable patterns, and implementation playbooks. * Be the public\-sector technical voice back into Harvey, synthesizing field feedback to inform roadmap, evaluation criteria, deployment options, and government\-specific documentation. * Represent Harvey's technical perspective in public\-sector forums — customer workshops, working groups, and stakeholder briefings — helping agencies understand both the possibilities and the limits of current AI systems. * Build the public\-sector Solutions Architecture playbook — qualification, security review, deployment patterns, and enablement — so the practice can scale beyond one person. **What You Have** ================= * 7\+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or a similar customer\-facing technical role. * Direct experience selling to or supporting U.S. federal customers (Department of Defense and/or civilian agencies) at a SaaS or cloud provider, including navigating agency security reviews and procurement. * Working knowledge of federal compliance frameworks and how they shape deployment — FedRAMP, NIST 800\-53, DoD Impact Levels, ATO processes — and the ability to explain them to CISOs and program managers alike. * Hands\-on depth in SaaS security and identity architecture: SSO/SAML, SCIM, encryption and key management, data residency, audit logging. * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical audiences — from program managers and attorneys to CISOs and enterprise architects — and credibility with senior public\-sector stakeholders. * Hands\-on engagement with modern AI systems (LLMs, prompt design, evaluation, deployment patterns) and a desire to help agencies adopt them responsibly. * Comfort operating in an emerging practice area: energized by ambiguity, willing to build new playbooks, motivated by real\-world impact on public services. **Preferred** ------------- * Prior government service or military experience. * Experience with Azure Government or other government cloud environments. * Experience selling through federal systems integrators or contract vehicles. * Background in legal, e\-discovery, or other document\-heavy enterprise workflows. **Compensation** ================ **$218,800 \- $300,900 USD** **Location** ============ Remote within Washington, DC area \- travel approximately 25–40% to agency and partner sites. ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices** **here****.** \#LI\-TM1 *Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Robotics Data
jobs.description: **About HUD** ============= HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25\. **About the role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Research Engineer for our Robotics team to develop the datasets and evals that make robotics data useful for training and evaluating embodied AI systems. You’ll translate open\-ended research needs into data specifications, build methods to validate data, and run experiments to understand which data and structures improve model performance. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Research the data needs of robot learning and physical AI systems, and turn them into concrete dataset and evaluation specifications * Define data schemas, annotations, ground truth, and quality standards across robotics data types * Design collection and review protocols that external data providers can execute reliably * Build tools and validation workflows to audit datasets, identify quality issues, and give providers actionable feedback * Run experiments and analyze model behavior to understand how data quality, coverage, and structure affect performance * Work with HUD’s research and engineering teams, and when needed with data vendors and buyers, to improve robotics data offerings **Experience** -------------- **You may be a good fit if you have:** * Experience in robotics, robot learning, embodied AI, or closely related multimodal research * Proficiency in Python and experience building data processing, analysis, or evaluation tools * Experience turning research questions into dataset specifications, experiments, and measurable quality criteria * Strong understanding of what makes robotics data useful for training or evaluation—and where it can be misleading * Attention to detail and the ability to spot subtle errors, coverage gaps, and failure modes in complex data * Experience building research tools or pipelines without a fully prescribed roadmap **Strong candidates may also have:** * Worked with robot trajectories, demonstrations, video, sensor data, simulation, or other multimodal robotics datasets * Experience with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or vision\-language\-action models * Worked in unstructured problem spaces and take ownership from early research through production deployment * Early\-stage startup experience and strong communication skills for collaboration across teams and time zones *We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.* **Team \& company details** --------------------------- * **Team Size**: \~25 people currently, mostly full\-time in\-person, but some remote. * **Our team:** Our team includes 4 International Olympiad medalists (IOI, ILO, IPhO), serial AI startup founders, and researchers with publications at ICLR, NeurIPS, etc. * **Company stage:** We have 8 figures in funding and are scaling profitably and quickly to meet very strong demand. **Logistics** ------------- * **Employment**: Full\-time. * **Location**: We have offices in San Francisco or Singapore but are open to remote candidates who **can work hours that 70\-80% overlap with either San Francisco or Singapore time zones.** * **Visa Sponsorship**: We provide support for relocation and visas for strong full\-time candidates to the US or Singapore. * **Timeline**: Applications are rolling. The process is 2 technical interviews and a 2\-3 day work trial. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation * 100% covered top\-of\-the\-line medical, dental, and vision from Blue Shield of CA (US employees) * Lunch and dinner when you’re in the office (in\-office employees) * Company\-wide holiday break (Christmas Eve to New Year’s Day) on top of PTO and paid holidays * Other perks including an Equinox membership, 401k, and commuter benefits (US employees) * Unlimited\* access to tokens for ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, etc. \**By unlimited, we mean no one on our token usage leaderboard has ever hit a limit. So we have no idea what the limit is.* Due to high volume, we may not actively respond to every application, but feel free to contact us at recruiting@hud.so or elsewhere if we missed your application!
