jobs.title: Forward Deployment Engineer – Expert
jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers. Responsibilities: The Expert Forward Deployment Engineer works inside a customer's development program as software developer, systems engineer, and deployment lead in one role, and ships production code. This person reduces broad concepts and business strategies into structured deployment projects, acts as the key technical lead and go\-to person for Department or Senior Management on the most complex, high\-impact engagements, diagnoses problems deep within the protocol stack (Layer 1 to Layer 3\), modifies software, validates fixes, and delivers controlled releases during a customer's early development, integration, and regression cycles. This is a customer\-facing software engineering role where you will embed directly within a customer environment to customize, integrate, and deploy technology into real\-world production systems, solving complex, high\-impact problems. **Core responsibilities*** Reduce broad account concepts and business strategies into structured, multi\-workstream deployment projects * Act as the key technical lead and go\-to person for Department or Senior Management on the most complex or highest\-impact deployment engagements * Architect and own solutions to problems that require a unique or highly specialized skill set * Work onsite or closely with wireless customer development teams during major feature introductions * Analyze signaling flows, traces, timing behavior, and performance data to isolate failures across Keysight and customer implementations * Write and modify application and protocol\-stack software, plus the supporting software and firmware the customer environment requires * Develop and extend Python APIs that customer teams integrate against * Build automation workflows inside the customer's workflows * Create diagnostic instrumentation when existing tools are insufficient * Develop, validate, and deploy controlled patches, feature flags, and interim releases under Keysight's release process * Run rapid prototyping loops directly with customers to test and iterate on new features based on live feedback * Act as a feedback loop to the core product and engineering teams, translating field problems into engineering requirements and defects for product management and R\&D * Incorporate broadly applicable field\-developed improvements into the core product * Mentor lower\-level engineers and help develop the broader forward deployment engineering team Qualifications: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) and 8\+ years of relevant software/systems engineering experience. Post\-graduate study and/or relevant certification/license may be required.* Strong software\-development experience across multiple software stacks * Preferred expertise in at least one domain (PHY/L1, MAC/RLC/PDCP and L2, or RRC/NAS and L3\), plus working knowledge of adjacent layers and end\-to\-end 4G, 5G, and 5G\-Advanced system behavior * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ and Python (including API development), Linux, embedded or real\-time software, and automated testing * Experience debugging protocol interactions through logs, traces, packet captures, call flows, and timing analysis * Familiarity with 3GPP specifications and the practical differences among standards compliance, interoperability, and implementation behavior * Experience in design and test instrumentation and test emulation tools * Ability to produce production\-quality code that ships in a customer's build * The judgment and customer presence to operate inside confidential development programs * Excellent communication skills; able to explain technical trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * Willingness to relocate or travel to a specific customer site as required by the assignment * Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise across multiple protocol layers, software stacks, and deployment domains * Demonstrated technical leadership: ability to design solutions to unusually complex problems and set direction for other engineers **We are unable to support visa sponsorship for this position.** **Careers Privacy Statement** Keysight Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws. The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills. Most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the Salary Range listed below. MIN $132,450 \- MAX $255,150\.00 **Note:** For other locations, pay ranges will vary by region US Employees may be eligible for the following benefits: * Medical, dental and vision * Health Savings Account * Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts * Life, Accident, Disability insurance * Business Travel Accident and Business Travel Health * 401(k) Plan * Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays * Paid Family Leave * Discounts, Perks * Tuition Reimbursement * Adoption Assistance * ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan) * Restricted Stock Units \#LI\-CS1

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Kinomatic is seeking a highly capable **Senior Software Engineer** to help build the next generation of our cloud\-based surgical planning, visualization, and patient recovery platform. This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who combines strong full\-stack technical depth with sound judgment, ownership, and technical leadership. You will work across frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, data, interactive 3D applications, and AI\-enabled workflows. You will contribute directly to production software while also helping shape architecture, technical standards, development practices, and engineering decisions across the team. This role is designed for an engineer who can grow into a trusted technical lead for major areas of the platform. You will work closely with the Director of Software Engineering, other technical leaders, Product, and cross\-functional teams to translate complex business and clinical problems into maintainable, scalable software solutions. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, deploy, and support production software across frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, data, and interactive 3D applications. * Lead technical design and implementation for features and system components, from initial problem definition through architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Grow into ownership of major technical areas of the platform, serving as a trusted delegate for architecture and implementation decisions. * Contribute to software architecture and system design decisions that support scalability, security, performance, reliability, and long\-term maintainability. * Lead and participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and architecture discussions. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers and help improve technical judgment, software design, debugging practices, and development effectiveness across the team. * Partner directly with Product and other departments to clarify requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions that align technical execution with business objectives. * Make sound technical decisions in situations involving incomplete requirements, ambiguity, changing priorities, and competing constraints. * Use modern AI\-assisted development tools, including coding agents, as an integrated part of the software development workflow while maintaining strong engineering judgment and verification practices. * Build and integrate production software systems around AI and machine learning capabilities, including APIs, workflows, data pipelines, inference services, and cloud infrastructure. * Improve engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, development tooling, and software delivery processes. * Balance engineering quality and long\-term maintainability with product velocity and business value. * Help establish and uphold a high standard of engineering excellence, ownership, and accountability. **Education** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required. **Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production software systems. * Strong full\-stack development experience with TypeScript and React. * Strong backend development experience with Go. * Strong experience with relational database design, data modeling, and performance optimization, preferably with PostgreSQL. * Experience building and operating cloud\-native applications on AWS or similar cloud platforms, involving serverless technologies and patterns. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code, automated CI/CD pipelines, production monitoring, logging, observability, and troubleshooting distributed systems. * Strong understanding of API design, authentication, authorization, application security, and modern access\-control patterns. * Strong software architecture and system design skills, including the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and make pragmatic decisions. * Experience developing interactive 3D applications and a strong understanding of foundational 3D graphics concepts such as coordinate systems, transforms, vectors, matrices, cameras, and rendering. * Demonstrated professional experience using AI\-assisted software development tools and coding agents effectively as part of day\-to\-day engineering workflows. * Demonstrated ability to independently work through ambiguous technical problems and drive solutions from problem definition through production deployment and support. * Ability to distinguish between necessary engineering rigor and unnecessary complexity, with a focus on delivering maintainable solutions that create business value. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills across multiple layers of a system. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to provide technical leadership without formal authority through sound judgment, collaboration, mentorship, and example. * Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment where requirements and priorities may evolve. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with medical imaging standards and workflows, including DICOM. * Experience developing software in regulated or compliance\-driven environments such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or FDA\-regulated product development. * Experience building immersive, real\-time, or browser\-based 3D visualization systems. * Experience building software platforms that integrate AI/ML inference or computer vision capabilities into production workflows. * Experience working in startup or high\-growth environments where engineers operate with significant autonomy, ownership, and adaptability. Kinomatic is transforming orthopedic surgery through proprietary 3D visualization and VR technology that enables surgeons to rehearse procedures before entering the operating room. As we expand our direct\-to\-patient presence, we are building the scalable growth engine that powers awareness, education, and long\-term advocacy. *Kinomatic is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics.*

jobs.title: Field Superintendent
jobs.description: **BRIEF DESCRIPTION** --------------------- **General Position Summary** Supports the Site Manager in supervising and coordinating the construction of water treatment systems while developing field leadership and construction management capabilities. Supports on\-site activities to ensure that quality, schedule, and safety requirements established by the client and Kurita are consistently achieved. Reviews construction drawings, BIM models, and project schedules, and collaborates with suppliers and subcontractors to support efficient project execution. Prepares work schedules, maintains construction records, and develops reports to identify and resolve issues while contributing to successful site management and continuous improvement. **Essential Job Functions** **Water Treatment System Construction Management** * Coordinate site facilities, safety and health equipment, and temporary installations in compliance with U.S. regulations, client requirements, and site rules while supporting the Site Manager in execution and continuous improvement activities. * Support planning and coordination of deliveries for equipment, materials, and construction resources based on project requirements, site conditions, and construction priorities. * Proactively identify, communicate, and help resolve construction issues with contractors, suppliers, and partner companies to maintain safe and efficient project execution. * Regularly review field conditions, monitor progress against project schedules, and actively coordinate recovery actions when delays or conflicts are identified. * Monitor construction activities in accordance with company standards and maintain accurate construction records, field documentation, and work progress reports. * Utilize drawings, P\&IDs, BIM models, and digital construction tools to verify installation quality, identify discrepancies, and support issue resolution in the field. * Participate in construction management meetings and actively support communication among clients, contractors, project teams, and the Site Manager. * Work Location: On\-site at project locations, 5 days per week, with frequent field presence and direct interaction with construction activities required. * Travel: Support project activities at job sites as required to meet project needs and support professional development opportunities. **OTHER \& MISCELLANEOUS** * Prepare weekly reports, progress updates, and supporting documentation for the Site Manager and project stakeholders. * Seek continuous improvement opportunities by identifying safer, more efficient, and cost\-effective construction practices. * Support implementation of lessons learned and best practices to improve project execution and personal professional development. * Perform special projects and additional responsibilities as assigned by the Site Manager. * Maintain high ethical standards and demonstrate professionalism in all work activities. * Identify, communicate, and escalate irregular issues, risks, and concerns to the Site Manager in a timely manner. * Maintain effective communication with project teams, office personnel, contractors, suppliers, and clients. * Comply with all company policies, client requirements, and site\-specific procedures. * Promote and maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment while supporting site safety initiatives. * Promptly report issues affecting schedules, milestones, safety, quality, manpower, or costs, and actively support development of corrective actions. **QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------ **Education \& Work Experience** * Experience in construction supervision, field coordination, installation management, or similar construction\-related activities for industrial, commercial, utility, or water treatment projects. * Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field. * 3 or more years of relevant construction, field supervision, project coordination, or site execution experience. Candidates demonstrating strong leadership potential, self\-motivation, and a commitment to continuous learning are encouraged to apply. **Tools \& Equipment** * General office equipment including personal computers, printers, plotters, tablets, mobile devices, and network file sharing systems. * Software: Windows OS; Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook); Microsoft Project experience preferred. Familiarity with SharePoint, Smartsheet, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Autodesk Forma, BIM 360, or similar project collaboration platforms is highly preferred. * Familiarity with field coordination tools, look\-ahead schedules, digital reporting systems, construction tracking applications, and mobile site management tools is preferred. * Ability to use engineering and construction management platforms (e.g., AutoCAD, Navisworks, Revit, BIM, ACC, Forma) to support field supervision and project execution. Drafting is not required, but candidates should be able to: o View, interpret, and navigate drawings, models, schedules, and project documentation. o Use digital tools to identify discrepancies, verify installation details, monitor progress, and support field issue resolution. o Communicate effectively with subcontractors, suppliers, engineers, and project teams while utilizing drawings, models, and project management platforms. o Strong documentation, construction reporting, digital collaboration, and construction record management skills are preferred. **Certificates / Licenses** * Valid Driver’s License * EIT (Engineer in Training) preferred, or demonstrated commitment to professional development. * OSHA 30\-Hour (Construction) required; OSHA 510 (Construction) preferred, or willingness to obtain after hire. * EHS certifications such as ASP (Associate Safety Professional), CSP (Certified Safety Professional), or CHST (Construction Health and Safety Technician) preferred. * Specialized safety training (e.g., HAZWOPER, ESS, NFPA 70E, Fall Protection, or MEWP) preferred. * Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), SharePoint, Smartsheet, or similar construction management platforms is preferred. **WORK ENVIRONMENT \& PHYSICAL DEMANDS** ---------------------------------------- **Work Environment** The work environment described herein reflects conditions typically encountered while performing the essential duties of this position. Work is performed primarily on active construction sites, with some office\-based tasks as required. Employees may travel by car and/or plane to project sites and may be exposed to outdoor conditions (heat, cold, humidity), construction equipment, airborne particles, electrical hazards, and vibration. Work may extend beyond Arizona to other locations in the U.S., depending on project requirements and professional development opportunities. Employees may need to pass a background check and/or drug screening as required by Kurita and its clients. **Physical Demands** The physical demands listed here are representative of those required to perform the essential duties of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be provided for individuals with disabilities. Duties may require frequent sitting and occasional standing, walking, use of hands and fingers, and reaching with arms. The employee may occasionally need to lift or move up to 25 pounds. Vision requirements include the ability to read and analyze data on paper and computer screens, measure or identify items visually, and adjust focus as needed.

controls, drive corrective actions, and support continuous improvement initiatives. * Ability to review engineering drawings, specifications, inspection records, and field conditions to verify compliance with project requirements and quality standards. * Demonstrates leadership, ownership, and commitment to quality management, supporting successful project execution while maintaining client satisfaction and compliance with company standards. **Supervisory Responsibilities** * Provides leadership and oversight for quality control activities at assigned project sites. * May supervise QC inspectors and coordinate the activities of subcontractors, suppliers, testing laboratories, and third\-party inspectors to ensure compliance with project quality requirements. * Supports implementation of quality plans, inspection and test programs, NCR management, corrective actions, and turnover doc s, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and turnover documentation to verify compliance with project requirements. - Minimum 5 years of experience in construction quality control, inspection, or quality management, with demonstrated responsibility for field quality oversight. **WORK ENVIRONMENT \& PHYSICAL DEMANDS** ---------------------------------------- **Tools** * + - General office equipment including personal computers, printers, and electronic document management systems. - Software: Windows OS; Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams). - Proficiency in quality management software, digital inspection platforms, document control systems, and field reporting applications. - Ability to prepare, review, maintain, and distribute quality documentation, including inspection records, checklists, NCRs, CAPAs, testing reports, and turnover packages. - Familiarity with construction management and field coordination tools, including daily reports, punch list tracking systems, and mobile site applications. - Ability to interpret engineering drawings, P\&IDs, specifications, and quality requirements to verify construction compliance; drafting experience is not required. - Effective communication skills to coordinate quality\-related matters with clients, subcontractors, third\-party inspectors, engineering firms, and project teams. **Certifications / Licenses** * + - Valid Driver’s License. - OSHA 30\-Hour Construction Safety certification required; OSHA 510 certification preferred or willingness to obtain after hire. - Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards including ASME B31\.3, NFPA 70, NFPA 54, IBC Chapter 17, and other relevant construction and quality requirements. - Strongly Preferred: USACE Construction Quality Management (CQM) for Contractors Certification. - Preferred: Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification. - Preferred: ASNT Level II certification in applicable non\-destructive testing (NDT) methods. - Preferred: ICC Inspector certification or equivalent construction inspection credential. - Preferred: Quality Management certifications such as Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), ISO 9001 Internal Auditor, or equivalent. - Specialized safety training such as HAZWOPER, ESS, NFPA 70E, or equivalent is preferred. - Preferred: Valid aerial work platform operator certification (boom lift, scissor lift), or willingness to obtain after hire. **Work Environment** The work environment for this position primarily involves on\-site inspections and quality control activities at construction project locations, with some office\-based tasks such as preparing and managing quality documentation. The role requires frequent movement within construction sites, including entry into inspection areas and sampling locations. Employees may be exposed to outdoor conditions (heat, cold, humidity), rotating equipment, fumes or airborne particles, electrical hazards, and vibration. Use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is required during site activities. Occasional travel to project sites outside Arizona may be necessary. jobs.description: **Description** NGEN is the largest IT services program for the Navy. Under the Service Management, Integration, and Transport (SMIT) portion of NGEN, the Leidos team will deliver the core backbone of the Navy\-Marine Corps Intranet, including cybersecurity services, network operations, service desk, and data transport. Ultimately, Leidos will support the Navy in unifying its shore\-based networks and data management to improve capability and service while also saving significant dollars by focusing efforts under one enterprise network. At Leidos, we know the most talented and diverse IT and Engineering professionals will always have a multitude of career choices; your time at Leidos will be a wise investment in your career and in yourself. Leidos is seeking a Communications Network Engineer to support multiple sites in Yorktown, VA as one of the key members of the Field Services team. The candidate will be responsible for overall network engineering support for a broad range of programs including planning, designing, and evaluating various components of the network at Newport News Shipbuilding, VA and Yorktown Naval Weapons Station Yorktown, VA. Duties may include providing specifications for network architecture, evaluating, and recommending new technologies to enhance current capabilities, and performing needs assessments. Support level duties may include monitoring, installation, modification, testing and servicing of network equipment. This sub family is responsible for overall network engineering support for a broad range of programs including planning, designing, and evaluating various components of the network. Duties may include providing specifications for network architecture, evaluating, and recommending new technologies to enhance current capabilities, and performing needs assessments. Support level duties may include monitoring, installation, modification, testing and servicing of network equipment. NAVSUP requires elevated network support services, consisting of continuous technical support during working hours and rapid remediation in the event of failures, both during working hours as well as possible after\-hours support. Premier support is required to support the high tempo and mission critical operations of the NAVSUP staff including elevated services to assigned Flag Officers/Senior Executive Service and associated staff. The work location for this position will be at a government site and will require the ability to: * Lift and carry 50 lbs for up to 100 feet at a time; must be able to lift 25 lbs vertically using ladders * Work in confined spaces, such as raised floors or communications closets; noisy environments, such as data centers and operations centers; and be able to stand or sit for 8 hours at a time * Utilize basic hand tools such as screwdrivers and wrenches while rack mounting active and passive equipment using small screws and brackets * Identify different colors of wires and cables; jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: Working at Lockton At Lockton, we’re passionate about helping our people achieve their ultimate potential. Our people are curious, action\-oriented and always striving to make ourselves and those around us better. We’re active listeners working to ensure understanding and problem solvers developing innovative solutions. If you can see yourself delivering excellent service to clients, giving back to our communities and being a part of our caring culture, **you belong here.** About the Position Lockton is a global professional services firm with 6,500 Associates who advise clients on protecting their people, property and reputations. Lockton has grown to become the world's largest privately held, independent insurance broker by helping clients achieve their business objectives. To see the latest insights from Lockton's experts, check Lockton Market Update . A few of the reasons Associates love working at Lockton include: * Opportunities for growth and advancement, including paid training and professional development * 12\-week paid parental leave * A huge emphasis on community involvement * Frequent athletic and wellness events * Incredibly generous rewards; US Associates receive a Rolex for their 10 year anniversary! Business unit Lockton Management, LLC Schedule Full\-time Lockton Benefits Offerings Click Here Workplace Hybrid Your Responsibilities Lockton is the largest private, independent insurance brokerage in the world. A relationship\-focused business, we’re passionate about people and helping ours achieve their ultimate potential. Our Global Analytics team, located in Kansas City, MO, is adding a Technical Product Manager position. If you can see yourself delivering excellent service to clients, giving back to our communities and being a part of our caring culture, you belong here. Position Details The Technical Product Manager (TPM) will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of the Product Development lifecycle and will work very closely with Product Owners to drive the execution of product vision and strategy. Collaborating closely with system integration partners, engineering, architects, and business stakeholders, they develop and maintain detailed product scope roadmaps, timelines, and project plans. Combining expertise in technology and digital landscape, they drive the execution of technology\-driven solutions which enhance customer experience and market competitiveness. Your Responsibilities • Collaborate with the Product Owner to build the product. This includes creation of user stories. acceptance criteria, user testing and release timelines • Lead the end\-to\-end product development lifecycle from concept to launch, managing sprints, backlogs, and releases. • Manage the relationship with external system integration partners to define, prioritize, and manage the product roadmap. • Facilitate regular meetings and workshops with development teams to address roadblocks and employ product modules, features and complex functionality. • Act as a bridge between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear technical requirements. • Gather and analyze user feedback, system performance trends, and data analytics to inform product improvements. • Ensure the technology stack aligns with enterprise\-wide IT strategy and best practices. • Ensure best\-in\-class technology principles are applied to product development. • Coordinate with internal and external teams, including data analysts, developers, and engineers, to drive product success. • Plan and lead user acceptance testing (UAT) sessions with business stakeholders. • Work closely with regulatory and compliance teams to ensure all products meet industry regulations. • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as user adoption, development timelines, and product quality. • Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends to drive continuous innovation. • Identify opportunities to enhance product performance, user experience, and market positioning. • Perform other duties as assigned to support the success of the product and organization. Qualifications • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Insurance, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. • 5\+ years of experience in product management, preferably within the insurance analytics or technology space. • Problem\-solving skills aimed at overcoming roadblocks, developing intuitive solutions to complex problems, and navigating challenging requirements • Analytical skills with a data\-driven mindset and the ability to work effectively in fast\-paced environments. • Strong understanding of APIs, cloud computing, SaaS, software development processes, and data analytics tools. • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and proficiency in tools like Jira, Confluence, or Aha!. • Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, manage stakeholders, and deliver complex products successfully. • Fam at matter most to them through volunteering, donations, and community engagement. As a global company with strong local relationships, Lockton creates space for real‑world, client‑facing experiences. When you start your career here, we help you build a foundation that lasts. Explore your next step: connect with Lockton on Handshake and explore our website. February 3, 2026 Making an impact: An... Fundación Cuenta Conmigo is a nonprofit foundation created to support low\-income families with a family member suffering from cancer in the Chilean public health system. Specifically, the foundation assists families navigating the process of their child’s cancer treatment. This includes covering expenses and helping address needs that are not supported by the State or other non\-governmental institutions. This organization is near and dear to Ana Wainer’s heart. Her son, Dante’s, close friend, Vicente, was diagnosed with pre\-leukemia at age 9\. After long and exhausting treatment, he underwent a bone marrow transplant. Unfortunately, it was not successful. Vicente later relapsed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia, "a diagnosis that profoundly changed the lives of his family and of all of us who knew him and accompanied them throughout the process,” Ana says. At age 11, after a long and courageous battle, Vincente passed away. “Despite the deep sorrow, Vicente left us invaluable life lessons and opened our eyes to a reality that often remains invisible to much of society,” Ana says. Shortly after his passing in March 2019, Vicente’s parents founded Fundación Cuenta Conmigo in 2020\. Ana was a co\-founder of the foundation and served as a volunteer member on the board of directors for three years. Through her role at Lockton, she coordinated activities between Lockton and the foundation as part of their Christmas initiatives since 2022\. “From the moment I introduced the foundation at Lockton, the company was very open to collaborating and the response was overwhelmingly positive,” Ana says. “When I invited my colleagues to participate as volunteers, everyone showed a genuine interest in helping in any way needed.” Ana’s love and dedication towards this foundation have been recognized by Lockton, earning her the Lockton Cares Community Impact Award for the Latin America region. This award celebrates Lockton Associates across the globe who go above and beyond to improve their communities through volunteering and philanthropy. Each recipient can direct a $25,000 donation to a charity of their choice, funded directly by the Lockton family. “As first I was genuinely surprised to hear my name, followed by a deep sense of emotion, pride, and gratitude,” Ana explains. The award funds were used to purchase a brand\-new utility vehicle, which is now used to distribute the various donations the foundation receives and delivers to families undergoing treatment in public hospitals. Donations include food, Christmas gifts, medical supplies, orthopedic equipment, and other essential items as needs arise. Ana had to step down from her role on the board of directors, but this award represents the support she wished she could have continued providing. “I feel like it is a kind of legacy that Lockton helped me leave for the foundation, for Vicente, and for his family,” she says. As she becomes more familiar with Lockton culture, Ana says it was a pleasant surprise to see that the importance of culture is not something just written on paper, but something truly reflected in the company’s commitment to charitable causes around the world. “Lockton genuinely cares,” Ana says. It’s no secret how much this foundation means to Ana, and she will continue contributing and encourage more people show support in any way they can. Fundación Cuenta Conmiga gave Ana an opportunity to discover an unfamiliar world—one that anyone could find themselves in one day. “It taught me to value what I have,” she says. “To be more empathetic toward those going through difficult times."

jobs.title: Staff Mobile Equipment and Fleet Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mariana Minerals** ========================== Mariana Minerals is a software\-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making. **The Role** Mariana Minerals is seeking a Mobile Equipment and Fleet Engineer to build and optimize the equipment fleet for our open pit mining operations. You will own the technical specifications, equipment and OEM selection, and full lifecycle economics of production and support equipment. Autonomy is a central part of the role: you will help determine which equipment should operate without an onboard operator, how to achieve that through new purchases or retrofits, and how to integrate autonomous machines into a productive mine. Your scope includes haul trucks, wheel loaders, excavators, dozers, graders, water trucks, blast\-hole drills, blasting support equipment, RC and core drilling rigs, trailers, and other mobile equipment. You will work across operations, maintenance, mine engineering, procurement, OEMs, autonomy providers, and Mariana’s software team. **What You'll Do** * **Fleet selection and autonomy** + Design the fleet. Translate mine plans, production targets, haul profiles, ground conditions, road geometry, operating hours, and site constraints into fleet requirements. Match loading, hauling, drilling, and support equipment so the fleet performs as an integrated system. + Specify and select equipment. Develop technical specifications and compare machine classes, models, powertrains, configurations, and OEMs. Evaluate payload, cycle time, availability, maintainability, parts and dealer support, interoperability, and readiness for remote or autonomous operation. + Drive the autonomy roadmap. Identify where autonomous haulage, loading, drilling, and support equipment can create practical value. Compare purpose\-built autonomous machines with retrofit options, including whether and when removing the onboard operator makes technical, operational, and economic sense. + Engineer autonomous integration. Work with OEMs, autonomy vendors, site teams, and software developers on machine controls, sensors, communications, fleet coordination, remote supervision and intervention, and interfaces with dispatch and maintenance systems. Define acceptance tests and support safe commissioning. + Make autonomy work in the field. Plan for interactions among autonomous trucks, loaders, drills, manually operated equipment, and people. Evaluate the effect of autonomy on haul roads, loading areas, traffic rules, fueling and servicing, recovery procedures, productivity, and staffing. * **Lifecycle performance and data** + Own lifecycle economics. Build and maintain models for acquisition, fuel and energy, tires, maintenance, major components, rebuilds, autonomy conversion, replacement, and residual value. Use cost per tonne and project value to guide purchase and replacement decisions. + Improve equipment life and performance. Partner with operations and maintenance to address downtime, underutilization, payload losses, inefficient operation, and premature wear. Use condition monitoring and operating data to improve maintenance plans, equipment use, and rebuild timing. + Build with data and software. Define telemetry and data collection needs, connect equipment and maintenance information, and work with the MarianaOS team to develop tools for fleet selection, equipment health, utilization, autonomous performance, and continuous optimization. + Guide OEM and vendor choices. Assess technical capability, autonomy offerings, integration flexibility, service coverage, parts availability, and long\-term support. Stay current with advances in engines, powertrains, controls, and mining automation. **What You'll Bring** * Relevant experience. A background in mobile equipment engineering, fleet management, equipment maintenance, OEM applications, or technology integration in open pit mining or a similar heavy\-equipment environment. * Equipment knowledge. Practical understanding of machine performance and the mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and control systems that determine reliability, maintainability, and operating life. * Autonomy knowledge. Experience with autonomous or remotely operated equipment, machine controls, or equipment retrofits; and sound judgment about the realities of deployment in an active operation. * Analytical judgment. Ability to develop fleet and lifecycle cost analyses, investigate equipment data, test assumptions, and make clear recommendations that balance cost, performance, safety, and flexibility. * Collaborative drive. Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working with operators, maintainers, engineers, and software developers in a dynamic, multidisciplinary setting. * Curiosity and initiative. A genuine passion for equipment and engines, an interest in new technology, and the creativity to turn promising ideas into improvements that work in the field. **What Success Looks Like** Mariana has a fleet selected for the actual requirements of each operation, with clear specifications and defensible lifecycle costs. Autonomous equipment is deployed where it improves the operation, with proven integration into the broader fleet. Equipment data informs daily performance improvements and future fleet decisions. **Our culture is built on four principles:** -------------------------------------------- **Everyone Gets Home Safe.** We never put speed or cost ahead of people. **Extreme Ownership.** We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions. **Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate.** We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale. **Share Your Legos.** We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions. **Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!**

jobs.title: Production Systems Engineer, NPI
jobs.description: Meta is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Systems/Hardware engineer to join our Release to Production (RTP) team. The RTP team is responsible for the end\-to\-end hardware lifecycle of all Meta servers, including prototyping, pre\-production hands\-on system validation, hardware debugging, and stress testing. As a Systems/Production Systems Engineer, you will work closely with various teams, including HW/SW co\-design teams, hardware designers, networking teams, system manufacturers, component vendors, capacity engineering, production engineering, production services, and data center operations teams to enable new systems that will be deployed in our production data centers. ### **Production Systems Engineer, NPI Responsibilities:** * Drive and lead end\-to\-end system validation, and deployment for cutting\-edge Compute and Storage hardware platforms, including CPUs, Flash, Hard Disk Drives and Data Center Processing Units (DPUs) in data center environments * Proactively create experiments and tooling to diagnose and root cause hardware, firmware, and software failures across compute, storage, and networking systems using telemetry, logs, and hands\-on debugging * Design and implement robust system\-level test plans, including functional, stress, and performance tests. Test plans may also include emerging security domains such as Confidential Computing * Drive component vendors and system manufacturers to resolve hardware and firmware issues identified during production operations * Interface with external vendors and internal teams to understand the system architecture and develop hardware fault management for various server products * Drive new platform enablement, hardware validation, tooling specifications, and integration, customer workload testing, and experiment creation to detect and diagnose hardware/firmware/software health issues * Leverage understanding of RAS (reliability, availability, serviceability) to improve error reporting and error handling mechanisms for better operation quality and cost/effectiveness * Analyze production failure data to identify systemic trends and drive corrective actions with internal teams and external vendors * Create and maintain dashboards and data visualizations to surface hardware health signals and track remediation progress across the fleet * Drive necessary discussions with external and internal teams on test specifications and methodologies to improve test quality continuously, both within Meta, and in the broader industry ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 6\+ years of work experience in one or more domains such as: ASIC development, compute (ARM, x86\), AI\-ML hardware/software, storage (HDD, TLC/QLC SSD, HBA), memory (HBM, DDR5, LPDDR5\), network (NIC, DPU), server interconnect technologies, or similar * Knowledge of architecture and components on one of the following products: server/PC/Laptop * Development or debug experience in one or more areas: hardware fault management, error reporting, error handling on hardware products * Experience with Python, C/C\+\+ and/or similar languages, within a Linux environment, for server system management, automation, version control, CI/CD, or similar * Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues * Experience communicating technical findings and recommendations to cross\-functional teams, including hardware designers, vendors, and operations stakeholders * Experience working in a matrix organization ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of experience with a subset of one of the following domains: Compute Systems, Storage Systems, Accelerated Compute Systems/HPC, Kernel/Firmware Development and/or testing, Post Silicon Bringup * Experience with x86 or ARM\-based CPUs and their subsystems (e.g., memory, inter\-chiplet communications, RAS/DFT, power management, security) * Working/functional knowledge of common bus protocols such as I2C, SPI, USB, LPDDR, and/or PCIe * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting problems at the system level, crossing across multiple components, as well as hardware, firmware, and software boundaries * Familiarity with debugging tools for systems\-on\-chip (SoCs) \- e.g., JTAG, GDB, DSTREAM, Trace32 * Understanding of the hardware development process and how it pertains to the test strategy. Experience authoring test plans for complex chipsets for functional, stress, and performance testing * 2\+ years of experience scripting automation in Python or equivalent * Experienced in the integration of lab tools for automated workflows with large\-scale deployments * Hands\-on experience in managing/debugging Linux servers * Proficiency in continuous integration/continuous delivery tools ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi\-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc. People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally\-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values\-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the *Aggregate System* and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence. Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you. Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await! **Job Description:** **Data Center Solutions (DCS) Business Unit** The Data Center Solutions Business Unit within Microchip designs enterprise class storage products to enable the world’s leading enterprises and data centers utilizing the latest RAID, Security, PCIe, NVMe, SAS, SATA, SDRAM, NAND, CXL technologies. As a member of the Applications Engineering team, a successful applicant will be involved in providing best\-in\-class technical support to our customers for one or more of the Data Center Solution products. Our Applications Engineering Team is responsible for providing best\-in\-class technical support for our customers to evaluate, develop and ramp to production with our solutions, by working closely with the Product Development, Product Validation, Marketing, and Sales teams. This involves, but not limited to, developing and delivering training, customer collaterals and debug tools, resolving the problems and challenges. We offer a challenging and dynamic working environment with opportunities to learn and make substantial contributions toward the success of our business. **Responsibilities** * Support, manage and resolve the technical issues related to DCS Hardware and Firmware/Software products * Debug Firmware, Software and protocol level issues for enterprise storage devices * Work with customer and cross functional teams through the life\-cycle of the product from gathering requirements to post\-production support * Develop and maintain customer collaterals such as Firmware User Manual, Quick Start Guide, Release Notes, Errata, Application Notes etc. * Develop and provide product training to customers and internal teams * Demonstration of new products to customers and at industry events * Feasibility study, investigations, proof of concept, prototype of next generation products * Travel within North America and internationally, as needed to work at customer sites to provide on\-site support or attend meetings **Requirements/Qualifications:** **Qualifications** * Bachelors degree in in CE, CSE, EE with 5 \- 7\.5 years experience, (FW development of storage or communication products or AI/ML tools development) * Strong Firmware / Embedded Systems development and debug skills * Experience in design, develop and testing of firmware using C language * Experience in developing debug tools using any of the scripting languages (Java, TCL/TK, PERL, Python etc.) * Experience / Knowledge of SoC Architecture * Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team * Customer facing experience **Travel Time:** 0% \- 25%**Physical Attributes:** Hearing, Seeing, Talking, Works Alone, Works Around Others**Physical Requirements:** Regular business hours. 70% sitting, 15% standing, 15% walking**Pay Range:** We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive base pay, restricted stock units, and quarterly bonus payments. In addition to these components, our package includes health benefits that begin day one, retirement savings plans, and an industry leading ESPP program with a 2 year look back feature. Find more information about all our benefits at the link below: Benefits of working at Microchip The annual base salary range for this position, which could be performed in the US, is $70,304 \- $205,000\.\** Range is dependent on numerous factors including job location, skills and experience. Microchip Technology Inc is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. jobs.description: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. quipment Engineer II – CMP **Location:** Manassas, VA (Fab 6\) **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Job Family:** Equipment Engineering About Micron Micron Technology is a global leader in memory and storage solutions that enable technologies such as AI, 5G, cloud computing, and autonomous vehicles. Join a team committed to innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Position Summary Micron is seeking an experienced **Equipment Engineer II** to support CMP operations in our 300mm semiconductor manufacturing facility in Manassas, VA. This role is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing advanced wafer fabrication equipment to improve tool reliability, yield, productivity, and cost of ownership. The successful candidate will work closely with process engineers, technicians, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams to resolve equipment issues, lead improvement projects, and support high\-volume manufacturing operations. Key Responsibilities * Maintain and optimize semiconductor manufacturing equipment for high\-volume production. * Troubleshoot equipment issues using structured problem\-solving methods such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, and root cause analysis. * Support tool installations, qualifications, upgrades, and process integration activities. * Drive equipment uptime, reliability, throughput, and yield improvements. * Lead continuous improvement and cost reduction projects. * Analyze equipment and process data to identify performance gaps and corrective actions. * Develop and maintain maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, and best\-known methods (BKMs). * Partner with vendors and sister sites to improve equipment performance and share best practices. * Provide technical leadership, training, and mentoring to technicians and shift teams. * Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, and cleanroom requirements. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent semiconductor industry experience. * Semiconductor manufacturing or advanced equipment engineering experience. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Experience with SPC, FDC, statistical analysis, and data\-driven decision making. * Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting **CMP equipment in a 300mm wafer fabrication environment**. * Hands\-on experience with **EBARA 300X** and/or **Applied Materials LK Prime (LKP)** CMP platforms. * Experience with equipment installation, qualification, maintenance strategy development, and reliability improvement. * Knowledge of yield improvement methodologies, defect reduction, and process optimization. * Experience working directly with equipment vendors and driving corrective actions to closure. * Demonstrated success leading productivity, cost reduction, and equipment performance improvement projects. What You'll Bring * Strong ownership and accountability. * Ability to lead technical problem\-solving efforts and drive issues to closure. * Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence. * Strong mentoring and team\-building skills. * Commitment to safety, quality, and manufacturing performance. **Ideal Candidate** .An experienced CMP Equipment Engineer with direct knowledge of **EBARA 300X** and **Applied Materials LK Prime (LKP)** systems, strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving capabilities, and experience utilizing SPC, FDC, and data\-driven methodologies to improve equipment performance. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of enhancing equipment reliability, yield, throughput, and overall factory performance in a high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. Experience leveraging **AI tools, automation, data analytics, or AI\-enabled ways of working** to improve engineering efficiency, troubleshooting effectiveness, and decision\-making is highly desirable. jobs.description: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. The Signal Integrity (SI) Research \& Development team enables the electrical performance of Micron's industry\-leading memory and storage products, including DRAM, LPDRAM, NAND, HBM, SSDs, and emerging memory technologies. The team works across silicon, package, PCB, and system\-level designs to develop high\-speed signaling and power delivery solutions that support next\-generation computing, AI, networking, automotive, mobile, and data center applications. As a Signal Integrity Engineer, you will support the design, analysis, and validation of high\-speed memory interfaces and power distribution networks across Micron's product portfolio. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will use modeling, simulation, measurements, and AI\-enabled workflows to evaluate signal and power integrity performance, support product development, and contribute to future technology and industry standards initiatives. Responsibilities * Support signal integrity and power integrity analysis for high\-speed memory interfaces and power distribution networks through modeling, simulation, measurement, and correlation activities. * Collaborate with silicon, package, product, validation, and system engineering teams to ensure product electrical performance across all stages of development. * Develop and evaluate die, package, PCB, and system\-level models to identify performance risks and optimization opportunities. * Apply AI\-enabled tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering efficiency, automate analysis, improve reporting, and support technical problem\-solving. * Contribute to methodology development, standards exploration, customer support activities, and documentation of technical findings and recommendations. Minimum Qualifications * 0\-2 years of relevant experience through internships, research, academic projects, laboratory work, or industry experience in signal integrity, power integrity, high\-speed design, electrical engineering, or related technical fields. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. * Knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, transmission lines, high\-speed interfaces, PCB design, or electromagnetic fundamentals. * Experience with electrical simulation, modeling, laboratory measurement techniques, or engineering analysis tools gained through coursework, research, or projects. * Strong analytical, fixing, and problem\-solving skills. * Experience with programming, scripting, or automation using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively in multi\-functional teams. * Demonstrated ability to apply AI\-enabled tools and agentic workflows to improve productivity, data analysis, technical evaluations, and engineering communication. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with signal integrity, power integrity, high\-speed SerDes, memory interfaces, or package and PCB design through internships, research, or academic projects. * Familiarity with industry\-standard SI/PI simulation and modeling tools. * Knowledge of DRAM, LPDDR, HBM, NAND, SSD, or other memory technologies. * Experience developing automation solutions, data analysis workflows, or engineering productivity tools using Python or similar programming languages. * Experience using AI assistants, large language models (LLMs), or AI\-enabled engineering workflows such as Copilot, Claude, GPT, Gemini, or agentic automation platforms. * Familiarity with industry standards such as JEDEC, ONFI, IBIS, or related interface specifications. * Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a fast\-paced engineering environment. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. **Job Overview** ---------------- The Network Technician is responsible for supporting the physical\-layer network infrastructure within hyperscale AI and accelerated computing data center environments. This role focuses on deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of structured cabling systems, fiber plant infrastructure, optics, network hardware, out\-of\-band (OOB) management networks, and console connectivity systems. The Network Technician serves as the primary onsite resource for physical network operations, ensuring the reliability and integrity of the network infrastructure supporting mission\-critical computing environments. The role works closely with customer network engineering teams, data center operations personnel, OEM partners, and deployment teams to support network expansion, break\-fix activities, and operational readiness. This position requires strong technical discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to execute customer\-directed activities within highly controlled operational environments. How You Will Make an Impact Fiber Plant Operations * Install, route, label, and maintain fiber optic infrastructure supporting production and non\-production environments. * Support MPO/MTP trunk deployments, patching, and remediation activities. * Perform fiber testing, certification, and validation using approved testing methodologies and equipment. * Troubleshoot physical\-layer connectivity issues and support fault isolation efforts. * Verify compliance with bend radius, cable routing, and fiber management standards. * Support contamination prevention programs, fiber inspection, and connector cleaning procedures. Structured Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure * Install, route, terminate, label, and document structured copper and fiber cabling systems. * Support deployment and expansion activities for new racks, pods, and network infrastructure. * Validate cabling installations against customer standards, floor plans, and port maps. * Conduct physical audits and quality inspections of deployed network infrastructure. * Maintain cable management systems and infrastructure documentation. Network Hardware Support * Install, replace, and validate network hardware components, including: * Optics and transceivers * Network switches * Console servers * OOB management devices * Patch panels and associated infrastructure * Support directed hardware replacement and maintenance activities. * Assist customer network engineers with troubleshooting and restoration efforts. * Participate in hardware acceptance testing and operational readiness activities. jobs.title: Growth Engineer, Developer Platform
jobs.description: For more than 25 years, NVIDIA has driven innovation in computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing. DSX OS is NVIDIA's open source foundation for AI infrastructure. It is a growing portfolio of engineering teams building in the open. A project earns real open source standing when its team has actually adopted the practices, its governance model works day to day, and outside contributors have a clear, well\-run path into the project. You will be responsible for governance design, community infrastructure, contributor tooling, and the plan that carries a project through its first months in the open. This role owns building that process. Work with each team to help them design a governance model that fits how they actually work — who owns what, how decisions get made, how contributors get a real path in. * Grow active contribution. Own infrastructure for community engagement — Slack, community meetings, collaboration spaces — for every project as it comes online, and own its ongoing lifecycle. * Build the post\-launch plan. Track engagement across community channels, run the operational side of external events, and build automated metrics so program health is visible without manual reporting. * Turn engagements into playbooks. jobs.description: NYC \- 1211 Ave of the Americas Full time Job\_Req\_54518 **Job Description:** The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801\. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever\-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must\-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi\-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. We’re looking for a **Director of Engineering** to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands\-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects. You are a hands\-on technical leader who builds robust high\-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting\-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast\-paced newsroom. services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery. * Be able to personally analytics, and user\-facing applications. * Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process. * Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs. * Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud\-based systems. * Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Organize architecture discussions. * Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies. **Qualifications:** **Must\-Haves** * MS or BS in computer science, or related field. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * 5\+ years experience leading engineering teams. * Agile best practices. * Proficiency in modern programming languages and jobs.description: Software Engineer, Sr \- Content \& Industry Services Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3237 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. The Content \& Industry Services team is the engine behind that data — we ingest, process, and publish content from thousands of sources that powers every search, listing, and recommendation on the platform. Content is an enabler and a multiplier that allows us to personalize our products, make better decisions and manage our risks. We have an exciting and unique opportunity for a motivated and energetic Senior Software Engineer to join the Realtor.com Content team. You will work across the full stack developing and operating mission critical systems that integrate with thousands of data sources and process millions of records daily. This role will involve investing in AI\-driven solutions to improve content quality and developer efficiency. You will ship code that ensures the flow of content onto realtor.com and across our publisher network to reach tens of millions of consumers, learn about and leverage new technologies, work with an experienced team of engineers and be part of a team that has a lot of fun along the way! What You’ll Do: * Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and fellow Engineers to deliver high\-impact solutions that drive business value. * Lead by example, championing process improvements that enhance code quality, team efficiency, and the predictability of deliverables. * Mentor and coach engineers across all levels, fostering a culture of growth, ownership, and engineering excellence. * Design, build, and maintain robust, user\-centric application features that deliver intuitive and delightful experiences. * Design, develop, and operationalize scalable backend services, data pipelines, and distributed systems using modern data architectures on AWS. * Apply AI and automation to improve data quality, monitoring, and operational efficiency. Continuously optimize the developer experience by improving the toolchain, automating infrastructure provisioning, and streamlining CI/CD pipelines. * Stay current with emerging technologies; evaluate and recommend tools and frameworks that improve our architecture, performance, or developer productivity. * Work in a product development process that is primarily Agile/Scrum. What You'll Bring: We’re looking for an engineer who is not only passionate about building and maintaining scalable frontend and backend systems, but also about the business outcomes their solutions enable.
