jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best\-in\-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second\-largest distributor of roofing products, the second\-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com. What you will do:: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer, AI to design, build, and deploy production\-grade AI agents that augment workflows across our organization. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks, MCP servers, LLM orchestration libraries, and robust testing/monitoring practices. This role blends software engineering excellence with applied machine learning and offers the opportunity to push the boundaries of intelligent automation in real business environments. **Responsibilities** AI Agent Development \& Deployment * Architect, build, and optimize AI agents using modern agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/MCP\-based ecosystems, or equivalents). * Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, custom tools, and integrations to enable secure and scalable agent capabilities. * Design agentic workflows that can operate autonomously, perform multi\-step reasoning, and interact with structured/unstructured data sources. * Package and deploy agents into production environments with attention to reliability, observability, and performance. Sales \& Marketing Agent Use Cases * Build agents that support Sales Representatives, such as: * Lead and account research, enrichment, and prioritization. * Drafting and personalizing outbound emails and sequences. * Summarizing calls, meetings, and account activity to drive next\-best actions. * Integrating with CRM and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach) to automate data entry and insight surfacing. * Generating detailed bills of materials (BOMs), estimates, and quotes from drawings, specs, takeoffs, or CRM/opportunity data, including price checks, margin validation, and versioning. * Build agents that support Marketing, such as: * Generating and localizing content for campaigns, landing pages, and nurture programs. * Assisting with audience segmentation, experimentation, and performance analysis. * Powering internal “marketing copilots” that answer questions from campaign, web, and analytics data. * Partner with the business to identify high\-ROI workflows for automation and to measure the impact of deployed agents on pipeline, conversion, quoting speed/accuracy, and engagement metrics. Systems Engineering \& Tooling * Develop internal libraries, reusable modules, and standardized patterns for building agentic applications. * Integrate agent systems with enterprise APIs, cloud services, databases, pricing/catalog systems, and operational infrastructure. * Build CI/CD pipelines for both model\-related code and agent\-specific behavior, including automated testing, evaluation harnesses, and regression detection for LLM\-powered systems. Testing, Evaluation \& Monitoring * Create frameworks for continuous evaluation of agents, including prompt tests, scenario simulations, and safety/robustness checks. * Monitor agent performance in production, diagnose failures, and iterate quickly on improvements. * Implement logging, analytics, and feedback loops to guide ongoing training or refinement—especially for critical revenue and quoting workflows. Collaboration \& Strategy * Work closely with product, engineering, Sales, Marketing, and domain experts to translate business processes into agentic flows. * Partner with stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and design AI\-powered operational solutions. * Contribute to internal documentation, best practices, and AI engineering guidelines. What you will bring:: **Required** * 3–7\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or AI Engineer (flexible based on seniority). * Proven experience building AI agents or LLM\-driven applications in production contexts. * Hands\-on work with libraries/frameworks such as LangChain, OpenAI/MCP, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration tools. * Proficiency with Python (or Typescript/Node) and modern development workflows. * Experience integrating LLMs with external tools, APIs, vector databases, and retrieval systems. * Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization (Docker), cloud deployment (AWS/GCP/Azure), and DevOps fundamentals. * Familiarity with automated testing approaches for LLM applications (unit tests, scenario testing, eval harnesses). * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to design resilient systems in ambiguous environments. **Preferred** * Experience deploying and scaling MCP servers, custom toolchains, or enterprise agent frameworks. * Prior work building tools or automations for Sales, Marketing, or RevOps teams (e.g., CRM\-integrated apps, quoting tools, outbound tooling, marketing analytics or experimentation platforms). * Background or project experience in the building industry (construction, materials distribution, building automation, supply chain, procurement) or other B2B industry. * Experience with workflow engines (Airflow, Prefect, etc) and/or MLOps (Mlflow, Flyte, etc) and event\-driven architectures. * Familiarity with vector and search/retrieval systems. * Understanding of prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, or RLHF\-style evaluation frameworks. What you will earn:: * 401(k) with employer match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * PTO, company holidays, and parental leave * Paid training and certifications * Legal assistance and identity protection * Pet insurance * Employee assistance program (EAP) **QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. To comply with Pay Transparency laws, employers must disclose an annual salary range. Actual offers depend on factors such as location, experience, skills, and market data. This position may also offer variable compensation. Please contact careers@QXO.com if you have any questions related to this job posting. Pay Range: USD $150,000\.00 \- USD $220,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Location Technology System Test Engineer, Senior
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering **General Summary:** **Location Technology System Test Engineer, Senior** Tests and validates location technology systems spanning software and hardware components, including GNSS positioning, WWAN‑based location (LTE/NR), WLAN‑based positioning (Wi‑Fi), sensor‑based positioning, and geofencing solutions. Interprets wireless, sensor, and positioning specifications to design and execute system‑level test plans, scenarios, scripts, and procedures. Performs system integration, functional, and regression testing across lab and field environments. Validates multi‑sensor location solutions that combine GNSS, cellular, Wi‑Fi, and device sensors (e.g., inertial and motion sensors) for improved continuity, accuracy, and robustness. Documents system‑level defects using standardized bug tracking tools and collaborates closely with software, systems, and algorithm teams to drive issue resolution. Leverages agentic AI‑assisted workflows to improve test execution efficiency, automate log post‑processing, and accelerate result analysis for complex location systems. Develops and executes test programs to evaluate new location features and system modifications, ensuring accuracy, stability, and performance across GNSS, WWAN, WLAN, and sensor‑assisted positioning jobs.title: Applications Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Applications Mechanical Engineer** **Location:** Chesterfield, VA **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Starting Salary:** $95,000/year, higher depending on experience **Schedule:** 9/80 schedule with every other Friday off **Travel:** Approximately 10% ### **Position Overview** We are hiring a **Mechanical Engineer** to design, develop, and support heavy equipment used for railroad emergency response, lifting, and specialized maintenance operations. This is a hands\-on engineering position covering the full product lifecycle—from initial design and engineering calculations through manufacturing, field testing, customer support, and ongoing equipment improvements. The engineer will also work directly with customers and contribute to project planning and execution. ### **What You'll Do** **Design \& Engineering** * Develop mechanical designs for crane systems, heavy equipment, and specialized machinery. * Modify, redesign, and reverse\-engineer existing components and equipment. * Create and evaluate designs using **SolidWorks or equivalent parametric CAD software**. * Perform engineering calculations, **FEA**, prototyping, and field testing to validate designs. * Improve equipment performance, reliability, serviceability, manufacturability, and cost. * Maintain standard equipment designs and engineering documentation. * Ensure designs meet applicable engineering standards, safety requirements, and customer specifications. **Project \& Manufacturing Support** * Take ownership of engineering projects from concept through manufacturing, testing, field implementation, and lifecycle support. * Support crane rebuild and refurbishment projects, including inspections, repair planning, upgrades, testing, and final delivery. * Coordinate with manufacturing, operations, vendors, suppliers, and other engineering teams. * Track multiple projects and priorities while maintaining schedules and project requirements. * Provide technical assistance during production, equipment testing, and product releases. **Customer \& Field Support** * Communicate directly with customers regarding technical requirements, equipment performance, and engineering solutions. * Provide troubleshooting and technical support through field inspections, on\-site visits, and emergency response activities. * Assist with customer projects and coordinate technical requirements through completion. * Travel to customer sites, vendor locations, field operations, and the Richmond\-area facility as needed. * Support emergency operations outside normal business hours when required. **Quality \& Continuous Improvement** * Maintain accurate drawings, calculations, bills of materials, engineering records, and design documentation. * Support quality assurance, product standardization, and continuous improvement programs. * Apply engineering judgment and problem\-solving to complex equipment and manufacturing challenges. * Stay current with company products, industry standards, and engineering practices. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in **Mechanical Engineering** or a related discipline. * Proficiency with **SolidWorks** or comparable parametric CAD software. * Working knowledge of **Finite Element Analysis (FEA)** and ability to verify results with engineering calculations. * Understanding of mechanical design principles, manufacturing methods, and engineering documentation. * Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage several projects and priorities simultaneously. * Comfortable working independently and with cross\-functional teams. * Strong customer\-facing communication skills. * Valid driver's license. * Willingness to travel approximately 10%. * Commitment to safe engineering and manufacturing practices. ### **Preferred Experience** * **Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT)** or **Professional Engineer (PE)** certification. * **CSWA or CSWP SolidWorks** certification. * Experience designing or supporting **heavy equipment, cranes, mobile equipment, or industrial machinery**. * Knowledge of **hydraulic and electrical systems**. * Experience taking products from engineering through manufacturing and field deployment. * Familiarity with **OSHA, ASME, AWS, AAR**, or other applicable engineering standards. * Experience providing technical guidance or mentoring to less\-experienced engineers. ### **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** * 9/80 schedule with every other Friday off. * Primarily based in Chesterfield, VA, with occasional work at facilities, customer sites, vendor locations, and field operations. * Combination of office and industrial work environments. * Ability to sit, stand, walk, and communicate throughout the workday. * Ability to climb on equipment during inspections, testing, and troubleshooting. * Ability to occasionally lift tools, components, and equipment up to 50 lbs. * Ability to work extended hours and participate in emergency response when required. jobs.title: Associate Application Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Renesas is unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position now or in the future. This includes anyone on F1/OPT visas.** Junior engineer or New College Grad (NCG) for Application Engineering position with focus on analog and mixed signal products as well as software / firmware development for position in HiRel product group. The primary function will be to work with our Marketing and Applications Engineering team to define, design and release analog and mixed signal products as well as assist our team with software and firmware development for our analog and mixed signal products. You will be part of an engineering team that is also responsible for defining system level reference design boards for our customers. The engineer will work under the guidance and mentoring of a senior Application Engineer. Programming experience with Python, Java, and/or C languages as well as knowledge of Verilog coding with FPGAs desired. This will include the following: * Definition and Design of the Application Demo boards and System Level reference designs with collaboration from Apps and Marketing for satellites power systems. * Schematic design, layout and BOM of the boards (Altium EDA is necessary). The candidate is eventually required to do PCB layouts. * Working with our software development group to design and test the system GUI’s. * Characterization and documentation of reference design electrical performance. * Publication of User Manual/Design Guide and working with the build group to get the board released into production. * Support of FAE or Marketing / Sales to help refine their application needs into deliverable reference designs to showcase solution performance. **RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** **Board Design and Validation of Performance (30\-40% of time)**: Time spent planning and conceptualizing/block level architecture for the reference design. Validate the performance of the reference designs / demo boards. Prepare validation plan and compile validation reports post bench testing/characterization. You will be expected to keep accurate lab notes (software of your choice) and document any test procedures for future reference. On simpler reference designs, you will be required to provide the test house with a test requirement document to enable them to verify the operation of the board before being placed in stock. On more complicated reference designs, you will be required to do the verification of the operation before the boards are put in stock. **Documentation (30% of time):** Generate User’s Guide that provide a clear explanation of the purpose of the reference design and the advantages it brings to the customer. User Guides should also include schematic of board, picture of board, performance of key specs with test conditions and any software information. It is important to document how the boards were tested in the User’s Guide, so the customer can reproduce our results. If required, will be expected to publish customers responses, and possible Articles. FrameMaker is our publishing software for our User Guides thus familiarity with this software is preferred. **Customer Support (20% of time):** You will work with marketing and sales to facilitate the design\-in of our products as well as providing technical assistance to address customer questions and analyze field returns. This will include assisting with software development for our evaluation platforms. You will train Field Application Engineers on products and demonstrations systems to enhance sales channel effectiveness. **Design\-in Activities (10\-20%)** You will work with marketing and sales to facilitate the design\-in of our products and answer customer questions about the reference designs. You will train Field Application Engineers on the operation of the boards to enhance sales channel effectiveness. **Qualifications** **Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Renesas is unable to sponsor applicants for work visas for this position now or in the future. This includes anyone on F1/OPT visas.** * Candidate must possess a minimum bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Electrical/Electronic/Computer Engineering. * Candidate should be self\-motivated and conscientious. * Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Candidate must have good presentation skills. * Candidate should have a good knowledge of analog / mixed signal design and lab troubleshooting skills. * Candidate must understand and follow industry standards of test for analog /mixed signal IC devices. **Required Skills:** * 0\-3 Years in Applications and/or Systems Engineering role in Analog IC Development or Circuit Design Industry. * Experience in Schematic/Layout design tools for Analog Mixed Signal, Power Management, MCU, FPGA, and DDR Memory in system level applications. * Proficient with electronic bench lab equipment (power supplies, function generators, multi\-meters, oscilloscopes). * Experience in building system level applications involving FPGA/ASIC, MCU, DDR memory interface using Verilog a plus. * Familiar with Microsoft Office (Excel, Power Point). * Experience with using Schematic/Layout EDA software (ie. Altium) is necessary. * Analog Mixed Signal products necessary. * Analog Mixed Signal experience preferred. * Previous experience working on power systems on satellites and understanding the power needs of satellite systems is very desirable. * Past satellite system design a plus. * Experience modeling circuits (IBIS, SPICE, and/or SIMPLIS) is a plus. * Experience writing programming code (ie. Python) to automate lab bench equipment in GBIP/USB communication a plus. * Experience with programming in Java, C, or similar language preferred. * Knowledge of I2C/SPI communication protocols are a plus. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us? jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description: Reporting to the SVP Engineering, the Senior Data Analyst – LLMOps will work with the Application Development team to own the observability, evaluation, and quality measurement of Rightsline’s LLM\-powered features. This is a senior individual\-contributor role in which you will instrument the LLM stack end to end — traces, prompts, tool calls, latency, token spend, and output quality — build the evaluation suites that tell us whether a change made the product better or worse, and turn that telemetry into decisions the engineering and product teams act on. You will work across a SaaS application, a wide range of third\-party tools, an AWS\-hosted infrastructure, and an increasingly agentic development workflow. The position is based in North America, has no direct reports, and partners closely with the wider engineering, product, and data teams. **Mission \& Impact** --------------------- The Senior Data Analyst – LLMOps makes the behavior of Rightsline’s AI features measurable. Quality questions about prompts, retrieval, and agent workflows are too often answered with intuition and spot checks; you will replace that with tracing, offline and online evaluations, regression suites, and dashboards that show quality, cost, and latency trends over time. You will be working in a collaborative environment with a team who shares your passion for building something impactful, and success in the role looks like engineers and product managers reaching for your evaluation results and dashboards before they ship — and trusting what they see. **What You Will Own** --------------------- This role’s work spans five areas, each described below. **Observability and Telemetry** ------------------------------- * Instrument Rightsline’s LLM and agent workflows end to end with tracing and structured logging, using tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or equivalent * Define and maintain the metrics that describe AI system health — latency, token and cost per request, error and fallback rates, tool\-call success, and retrieval hit rates * Build and maintain dashboards and alerting so quality and cost regressions surface in hours rather than in customer tickets **Evaluation and Quality** -------------------------- * Design and maintain offline evaluation suites — golden datasets, scoring rubrics, and LLM\-as\-judge grading — for prompts, retrieval pipelines, and agent flows * Run online evaluations and A/B experiments on production traffic, and report results with enough rigor to support a ship / no\-ship decision * Track quality across model, prompt, and retrieval changes, and maintain the benchmark history that shows whether the product is actually improving * Partner with engineers on human review and annotation workflows, including labeling guidelines and inter\-rater agreement **Data Analysis and Reporting** ------------------------------- * Build and maintain the pipelines that move trace, evaluation, and usage telemetry into the analytics stack using SQL and Python * Analyze how customers actually use AI features — adoption, drop\-off, and failure patterns — and translate findings into prioritized recommendations * Produce recurring reporting on AI quality, cost, and usage for engineering, product, and leadership audiences **Cost, Reliability, and Troubleshooting** ------------------------------------------ * Monitor token spend and model usage, and identify where prompt, model, or caching changes cut cost without hurting quality * Investigate quality incidents — bad or unsafe outputs, hallucinations, tool failures, latency spikes — from trace to root cause * Follow and help extend Rightsline’s development best practices and standards in the pipelines, queries, and evaluation code you ship **Team Contribution** --------------------- * Attend and contribute to team meetings, and present telemetry and evaluation findings in a way non\-specialists can act on * Raise the team’s LLMOps literacy — help engineers instrument their own features, write their own evals, and read the dashboards **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- * 5\+ years in data analytics, analytics engineering, or data science, including hands\-on work with LLM\-based systems in production * Strong SQL and Python (including pandas and notebook\-based analysis), with the discipline to build repeatable pipelines rather than one\-off queries * Hands\-on experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse, LangChain/LangGraph, or equivalent * Practical understanding of LLM application architecture — prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, and agent workflows — and how each of them fails * Experience designing evaluation methodology: golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM\-as\-judge grading, human annotation, and A/B testing on production traffic * Working knowledge of experiment design and statistics, enough to say confidently whether a difference is real * Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and be accountable for your work, while operating within established standards * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and initiative — you can explain a quality regression to an engineer and to an executive in the same afternoon * BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or equivalent knowledge **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, Step Functions, and Amazon Bedrock * Familiarity with dbt, Airflow or a similar orchestrator, Git, and BI tools such as Looker, Power BI, or Tableau * Working knowledge of MS SQL, Redis or another NoSQL store, and vector stores used for retrieval * Exposure to model providers and platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock), guardrail and PII\-redaction tooling, and prompt versioning and release workflows * Experience with coding agents or AI developer tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) in day\-to\-day analysis work **Our Core Values** ------------------- At Rightsline, we look for these qualities in every hire, and we hold ourselves to them every day. * **Be Curious and Smart** ------------------------ Being smart isn't about having all the answers — it's about asking the right questions, seeking out new ideas, and never assuming you already know enough. * **Embrace Change** ------------------ This industry moves fast and so do we. We don't resist change — we lean into it. That means staying flexible, letting go of what isn't working, and treating uncertainty as opportunity rather than obstacle. * **Show Up** ----------- Showing up means being present — not just physically, but mentally and emotionally. Your teammates count on you. Your customers count on you. We do our best work when everyone is fully engaged and accountable to each other. * **Get it Done** --------------- Ideas are easy. Execution is the job. We hold ourselves to what we commit to, push through the hard parts, and measure success by our actual accomplishments. * **Be Humble** ------------- Nobody here has a monopoly on good ideas. We listen more than we talk, share credit freely, and check our egos at the door. The best outcome matters more than whose idea it was. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Rightsline is an equal opportunity workplace. All candidates will be afforded equal opportunity through the recruiting process. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity and/or expression. We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented individuals and creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know. **Apply Today** --------------- If you want to join a company that strives for a mission, purpose and making an impact, we encourage you to apply today.

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager - Southwest Region
jobs.description: Overview: **About Us** ============ Rural King is America’s Farm and Home Store, providing essentials to the communities we serve. With a wide array of necessities ranging from food and feed to farm and home products, Rural King serves over 150 locations across 17 states and is **constantly expanding**. Our annual sales exceed **$2\.5 Billion**, and our heart beats in Mattoon, IL, home to our corporate office, distribution center, and flagship store. One thing our customers appreciate is our unique shopping experience, complete with complimentary **popcorn and coffee**. It's just one way we show our appreciation for their support. At Rural King, we value our associates and strive to create a positive, rewarding workplace. We offer growth opportunities, competitive benefits, and a **people\-first** environment where dedicated individuals come together to serve rural communities passionately. Join us, and you'll find not just a job but a chance to **grow professionally**, contribute meaningfully, and make a difference in the lives of those we serve. **How we reward you** 401(k) plan that provides a 100% match on the first 3% of your contributions and 50% of the next 2% Healthcare plans to support your needs Virtual doctor visits Access to Centers of Excellence with Barnes Jewish Hospital and Mayo Clinic’s Complex Care Program 15% Associate Discount Dave Ramsey’s SmartDollar Program Associate Assistance Program RK Cares Associate Hardship Program 24/7 Chaplaincy Services Responsibilities: **What You’ll Do** ================== The Construction Project Manager oversees all responsibilities for construction, remodeling, and miscellaneous CapEx projects for all projects assigned. The Construction Project Manager I develops and implements strategies to maximize profitability by managing a project's budget, maintaining schedules, delivering quality spaces, and building client/contractor relationships. * Manage and lead all facets of the construction project from planning to closeout with industry best practices. * Lead the design team of engineers/architects to develop tenant plans for bidding, permitting, and construction. * Prepare overall project budgets, manage invitations to bid, and review proposals for a complete scope of work. * Negotiate, buy out, and create contractor and vendor agreements. * Ability to create project schedules and achieve tight deadlines while managing simultaneous multi\-state projects within budget. * Analyze constructability and value engineering techniques to provide the best value for projects. * Review tenant improvement documents and ensure design plans are in alignment with delivery requirements. * Identify project risks, develop mitigation plans, and implement action plans to reduce or eliminate impact. * Monitor, control, and track all the change management processes on managed projects. * Keep the team informed on all significant updates of the project, schedule progress, financial status, and relationships. * Coordinate requirements with utility companies for services and municipalities on required inspections and occupancy permits. * Partner with the Real Estate team to support growth in the RKR portfolio. * Assist in all maintenance functions with RKR 3rd party tenants and RK Stores as needed to lead or support. * May be required to cross\-train and perform other duties. jobs.title: Instrumentation and Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Within SSOE’s Advanced Technology division, we specialize in high\-tech facility design, offering top\-tier design and engineering services to a diverse array of clients and markets. Our team is composed of highly skilled and knowledgeable professionals who excel across various disciplines. We pride ourselves on our cross\-disciplinary approach, which allows us to understand and address our clients' needs more comprehensively than traditional, siloed methods. What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly conceptualize, plan, and detail every aspect of design. Our in\-house experts collaborate closely, optimizing and enhancing our work through multi\-discipline strategy sessions. By leveraging cutting\-edge techniques and state\-of\-the\-art software, we deliver industry\-leading technology and innovative solutions from day one. The Instrumentation and Controls Engineer will lead the design and coordination of instrumentation and control systems for cleanroom, fab, and advanced manufacturing facilities. This role develops complete I\&C design packages for process, utility, and support systems, including instrumentation selection, control narratives, loop diagrams, panel layouts, and coordination of PLC and DCS architectures. Working closely with project managers, discipline leads, clients, vendors, and contractors, the engineer will support design reviews, manage technical interfaces, and maintain quality through all project phases from early planning through construction and startup. The position requires strong attention to safety, code compliance, change control, and constructability in highly technical process environments. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: * Independently produce complete instrumentation and controls design packages for semiconductor and advanced technology facilities, including control system concepts, I/O lists, loop diagrams, schematics, panel layouts, and instrument indexes. * Develop and coordinate control system architectures for PLC and DCS\-based systems, including hardware selection, network interfaces, remote I/O, and integration with process and facility systems. * Interpret and incorporate P\&IDs, one\-line diagrams, process flow diagrams, and equipment data into coordinated design deliverables that support process performance, maintainability, and operational reliability. * Prepare control narratives, sequence of operations, cause\-and\-effect matrices, and point\-by\-point control descriptions for process, utility, and environmental systems. * Select and specify field instrumentation, analyzers, control valves, transmitters, switches, and associated accessories suitable for cleanroom, fab, and high\-tech manufacturing applications. * Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, process, structural, and architectural teams in AutoCAD and Revit environments, using model coordination tools such as Navisworks to resolve interferences and maintain design alignment. * Perform engineering calculations and layout reviews to support raceway sizing, panel space planning, signal separation, cable routing, and equipment placement in compliance with applicable electrical, fire, and instrumentation codes. * Support QA/QC reviews, interdisciplinary model reviews, and client design reviews to ensure accuracy, constructability, maintainability, and conformance with project requirements and industry standards. * Coordinate with vendors and equipment suppliers to review submittals, resolve technical deviations, verify instrument performance, and ensure compatibility with project specifications and control system standards. * Respond to RFIs, review shop drawings, participate in construction administration, and support field coordination to resolve design intent questions and maintain schedule and quality objectives. * Conduct site walks, existing condition verification, and field observations to validate installation progress, identify coordination issues, and support change management during construction and startup. * Assist with startup, commissioning, and turnover activities by reviewing functional testing, punch lists, as\-built documentation, and operational readiness requirements for I\&C systems. * Maintain clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with internal teams, clients, and contractors regarding design decisions, risks, scope changes, and issue resolution. * Mentor junior staff and contribute to technical knowledge sharing, standards development, and consistent application of instrumentation and controls best practices. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in engineering design technology, drafting, or a related technical field. * At least 15 years of instrumentation and controls design experience in industrial, semiconductor, advanced technology, or comparable process facility environments. * Demonstrated ability to independently develop a complete I\&C design package with minimal oversight. * Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit, with working familiarity in model coordination tools such as Navisworks. * Strong working knowledge of PLC and DCS hardware architectures, control panel construction, and field instrumentation types. * Ability to read, interpret, and translate P\&IDs, one\-line diagrams, process flow diagrams, and related technical documentation into coordinated design deliverables. * Solid understanding of applicable electrical and fire codes, ISA instrumentation standards, and safe design practices for high\-tech manufacturing facilities. * Experience coordinating across multiple disciplines and communicating technical requirements clearly with project managers, clients, vendors, contractors, and construction teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document decisions, manage design changes, and support technical reviews. * Proven ability to mentor junior staff, support quality\-focused project delivery, and contribute to complex, fast\-paced project environments. * Salary Range: $100,000 \- $150,000/year depending on location, education, depth of relevant experience, and any specialized licensure/certifications. Opportunity for ample rewards, leadership incentive components, and generous bonus opportunities. * Benefits: Includes comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), opportunities for professional development and training (including support for relevant licensure \& certifications), and generous PTO \& paid holidays. Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and engineering excellence. Our company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. We believe in fostering a dynamic and inclusive environment where every team member can thrive. If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward\-thinking team.

jobs.description: Responsibilities: **Piping Engineering \& Analysis Synopsis** The Piping Engineering \& Analysis discipline performs evaluations for piping systems in accordance with ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, ASME B31\.1, ASME B31\.7, and other codes as applicable to the specific evaluation being performed. The Piping Engineering \& Analysis discipline also performs the following specialty topics. * Vibration monitoring and analysis to evaluate system operational vibrations associated with plant modifications and operating events, and to provide vibration prevention and mitigation solutions and designs. * Evaluation of hydraulic transients, evaluation of piping systems for thermal stratification effects, operability evaluations, and qualification of piping for hydrodynamic loads. * Pipe rupture evaluations, evaluation of pipe wall thinning due to flow accelerated corrosion (FAC) or microbiological induced corrosion (MIC), and pipe flaw evaluations. **Position Specific Details** Provides senior level technical direction and supervision to the project team members in his/her discipline. Establishes project task schedules and budgets for his/her discipline to meet overall project requirements. Coordinates activities between disciplines. Is responsible for successful completion of project deliverables to meet all technical, quality, and project controls expectations. Provides technical guidance to project team members. Ensures that calculations are technically sound and in accordance with project requirements. * Reviews and approves simple system/structural designs and prepares and reviews complex system/structural designs to ensure completeness, accuracy, quality, constructability, and operability. * Performs engineering review of drawings. Reviews design input for complex system/structures. Defines client expectations for drawings. Coordinates interface between design and engineering. Actively participates in design reviews to ensure quality, constructability, and operability. * Prepares and reviews major system, installation, and material specifications. Defines technical and commercial requirements, including scheduling of vendor submittals needed for design input. * Prepares bid evaluations for complex systems and installation scopes. Participates in bid negotiations with vendors. May evaluate change orders on behalf of the client. * Prepares and reviews single\-discipline, complex reports/studies. Participates in the preparation of multi\-discipline reports. Reviews studies and reports to ensure that conclusions are technically sound, cost\-effective, and clearly communicated. **This position is based on a hybrid work schedule and will require in\-office work 3 days per week.** Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.** **Required Skills and Experience:** * BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Mechanics, Aerospace, or Structural/Civil Engineering, from an ABET Engineering Accreditation Commission\-approved program, with an emphasis in solid mechanics, structural analysis, theory of elasticity, metallurgy, and finite element analysis * P.E. license * 10 or more years of relevant experience * Extensive knowledge of ASME B31\.1 and ASME B\&PV Section III piping codes * Knowledge of the design, selection, and application of pipe supporting elements * Working knowledge of commercially available piping products and their application * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Valued but Not Required Skills and Experience:** * The ability to navigate a 3D CAD model * Experience with AutoPIPE or PIPESTRESS software * Knowledge of gas dynamics and hydraulic transients * Knowledge of pipe condition assessment * Experience with ANSYS Workbench and Mechanical ADP Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sequence** ================== We are in the midst of the intelligence revolution. In some industries, a startup will emerge from this period as a leader. In others, the incumbent will be vastly advantaged. We believe the opportunity is exponential when existing competitive attributes are paired with the power of AI. Sequence acquires ambitious, established enterprises in the service economy and refounds them as market leaders. We bring capital, engineering and operational expertise to each business we partner with. Our engineers work shoulder to shoulder with management teams to reimagine their business around what is now possible with AI. jobs.title: Customer Engagement Specialist
jobs.description: **Customer Engagement \& AI Project Specialist** **Build your career where business, technology, and AI come together.** **About CRM Experts Online** We help businesses transform how they operate using **CRM, ERP, automation, and AI agents**. Our team works with platforms like Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, NetSuite, and emerging AI technologies to build systems that automate work, improve customer experiences, and help companies grow. And increasingly, **AI is at the center of everything we build.** If you're early in your career and want to work somewhere you can learn how AI is actually being applied inside real businesses—not just talk about it—this is an opportunity to build experience that will matter for years to come. **Your Role: Customer Engagement \& AI Project Specialist** You'll work directly with **business owners, founders, executives, developers, and AI specialists** to help turn ideas into working solutions. One day you may be helping a client improve their Salesforce implementation. The next, you could be coordinating the launch of an AI agent that automates prospecting, customer service, operations, or internal workflows. You'll become the connection between the customer, the technology, and the team building it. **This is not a role where you sit on the sidelines.** You'll be encouraged to learn, experiment, use AI every day, take ownership, and grow quickly. **What You'll Do** **Work on Real AI Projects** * Help coordinate AI agents, automations, CRM, and ERP projects for real businesses. * Learn how businesses are using AI to automate sales, operations, customer service, and repetitive work. * Work alongside developers and AI engineers to turn business requirements into working solutions. * Use modern AI tools to research, communicate, analyze information, manage projects, and get more done. **Work Directly With Founders \& Executives** * Lead and participate in weekly client meetings. * Speak directly with CEOs, founders, managers, and business owners. * Understand their challenges and help translate them into technology solutions. * Build the confidence and executive communication skills that can accelerate your career. **Own Projects and Outcomes** * Help manage projects from idea through implementation. * Coordinate developers, clients, tasks, sprints, and deadlines. * Track deliverables and make sure things keep moving. * Identify problems early and help remove roadblocks. * Take ownership instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do next. * Help design and launch AI agents for real businesses * Test AI agents and make sure they are producing the right outcomes * Monitor agent performance and identify where they need improvement * Help train agents using business rules, workflows, and customer requirements * Work with agents that automate sales, recruiting, customer service, operations, reporting, and research * Help connect AI agents with platforms like Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, NetSuite, and other business systems * Learn how agentic workflows, prompts, APIs, integrations, and automation work together **Help Build the Future of Work** You may work on projects involving: * AI Sales Agents * AI Recruiting Agents * AI Customer Service Agents * AI Research Agents * CRM Health Check Agents * AI Monitoring Agents that watch other agents * Automated lead generation agents * Workflow and operations agents * AI assistants embedded inside business applications **Become AI\-First** We don't want AI to be something you occasionally use. We want you to learn how to make it part of **how you work**. You'll be encouraged to use AI to: * Analyze problems * Prepare for meetings * Research solutions * Create documentation * Manage projects * Automate repetitive work * Generate ideas * Improve customer experiences * Build AI\-powered workflows and agents The goal is simple: **learn how to work with AI now so you're prepared for the careers being created tomorrow.** Who We're Looking For You don't need to know everything on day one. We're looking for people with **energy, curiosity, communication skills, and the desire to grow.** **You may be a great fit if you:** * Communicate clearly and confidently in English * Enjoy talking with people and building relationships * Are comfortable speaking with business owners and executives * Are fascinated by AI and emerging technology * Learn new software quickly * Take initiative and follow through * Like solving problems * Want responsibility early in your career * Want to understand how businesses actually operate Experience with **Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, NetSuite, project management, Agile, Scrum, automation, or AI tools** is a plus—but curiosity and the ability to learn matter just as much. **Why Join CRM Experts Online?** Because this isn't just about getting your next job. It's about building skills for your **next decade of work**. You'll gain hands\-on experience across: **AI Agents** Automation **CRM** ERP **Sales Technology** Business Operations **Project Management** Client Strategy You'll work with real companies, real executives, real technology, and real business problems. For someone ambitious early in their career, that exposure can be incredibly valuable. We want people who look at AI and think: **"I want to learn how to build with this."** **"I want to understand where this is going."** **"I want to be part of it."** If that's you, we'd like to meet you. **Come build with us—and build a career designed for the AI era.** Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $61,100\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Application Question(s): * Could you complete the following two personality assessments and send us your results? \- IMA High: https://www.ima\-personality\-test.com/ \- 16Personalities: https://www.16personalities.com/ Ability to Commute: * Staten Island, NY 10305 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce\-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4\.com. **SUMMARY** As a Software Engineer I at Shift4, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining APIs and web interfaces that support third\-party integrations with restaurants, stadiums, and retail establishments. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure that our merchant\-facing solutions are deployed efficiently and effectively, supporting both internal and external teams. This role requires a self\-motivated individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is eager to contribute to product releases and maintain high\-quality solutions. **Please note that U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O\-1, H\-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future.** This is a hybrid position reporting into either one of the following offices: Center Valley, PA; Atlanta, GA; Tampa, FL; or Toronto, ON. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** **Continuous Integration \& Deployment of APIs and Web Interfaces** * Develop and maintain stable CI/CD pipelines for merchant\-facing APIs and web interfaces that integrate with third\-party brands. * Support internal teams by developing and deploying APIs that facilitate relationships with third\-party brand integrations. **Triage \& Support for Field Escalations** * Provide timely and effective triage for issues escalated from the field regarding solutions developed by the Growth Solutions development team. * Collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues and maintain high service quality for deployed solutions. **Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing** * Create and maintain living, scalable, and easily distributable documentation for deployment and operations, ensuring clarity and accessibility for the development and operations teams. * Regularly update and improve documentation as new features and solutions are implemented. **Timely Project Execution** * Maintain aggressive timelines for assigned projects, ensuring timely delivery without compromising quality. * Communicate project status updates regularly to ensure alignment with stakeholders and track progress. **Cross\-Functional Relationship Management** * Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with technical team members across different brands and departments. * Facilitate smooth communication and cooperation to ensure that solutions are developed and deployed effectively. **Engagement in Product Release Demos** * Participate in product demos during each release cycle, providing valuable input and feedback for continuous product improvement. * Contribute to discussions around new features and enhancements, ensuring that technical aspects are accurately represented. **Ownership \& Task Accountability** * Take full ownership of assigned projects, ensuring tasks are completed on time and according to specifications. * Communicate progress clearly and proactively address challenges or blockers that may arise. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required**: * Strong self\-motivation with the ability to work independently with minimal direction. * Excellent attention to detail and analytical problem\-solving skills. * Proficient time\-management skills with the ability to handle stress, prioritize tasks, and work under shifting deadlines. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to learn quickly and work effectively in a dynamic environment. **Preferred**: * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience * Experience in front\-end design and development with JavaScript, React, Ember, CSS, and HTML, and single\-page applications * Experience with Node.js, REST APIs, webhooks and microservices. * Knowledge of source code management, unit testing, and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with relational databases and with MS SQL and/or PostgreSQL query languages *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.*

jobs.title: Data Center - Controls Technician
jobs.description: **Position Location:** This role supports our Chantilly, VA location, which serves customers throughout the greater Northern Virgina area. This will position will specifically support a Data Center. Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. **Transform the everyday with us!** Our **Data Center \- Controls Technician** is responsible for the installation, commissioning, configuration, testing, operation, and maintenance of mission\-critical data center infrastructure and monitoring systems. This position plays a key role in deploying new equipment, validating system configurations, supporting power monitoring solutions, and ensuring all systems operate in accordance with project specifications, operational requirements, and customer expectations. As a technical resource, you will work closely with customers, engineers, project managers, vendors, and operations teams throughout the project lifecycle. You will support the integration of electrical power monitoring, building automation, and critical facility systems while providing expert troubleshooting, technical guidance, and exceptional customer service. Your expertise will contribute to maximizing uptime, improving operational efficiency, and supporting sustainable data center operations. **As a Controls Technician, you will:** * Commission new distributed digital control systems on construction sites within planned timelines * Document commissioning details; communicates deficiencies and progress * Act as the Lead Technician and plan work with Team Leader * Network technologies: Perform data back\-up from data servers and create automated back\-up procedures. Troubleshoot and resolve inconsistencies in the functions or sequence of operations Configures PC workstations and user interfaces. jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management – Database Business Unit
jobs.description: At SolarWinds, we're a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions. The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us! The Senior Director, Product Management leads product strategy, roadmap, and execution for the SolarWinds Database Business Unit—a portfolio that includes SQL Sentry, Database Performance Analyzer, and Database Observability delivered through SolarWinds Observability SaaS. Our customers are DBAs, data platform engineers, and the application teams who depend on them, at organizations where a slow query is a revenue event. This is a rare combination of portfolio ownership, domain depth, and reinvention. The database market is being reshaped by AI on two fronts at once: customers are racing to make their data estates AI\-ready, and the work of database administration itself is shifting from human\-driven triage toward agentic diagnosis and remediation. You will set the point of view that determines where SolarWinds plays in that shift, and you will run a product organization that builds the way it preaches—partnering with engineering in an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) model and using AI throughout the product management craft itself. You will lead and grow a team of product managers, own the portfolio P\&L in partnership with BU leadership, and serve as the executive voice of the database business with customers, analysts, partners, and the field. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own the multi\-year strategy and roadmap for the database portfolio across self\-hosted and SaaS delivery, spanning SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Db2, SAP ASE, and cloud\-native and NoSQL platforms. * Define the portfolio thesis: where we differentiate, where we integrate, where we partner, and where we sunset—and make the trade\-offs explicit and defensible to the executive team. * Drive the convergence strategy that brings depth\-of\-domain database capability into the broader SolarWinds Observability platform without diluting what DBAs value most about our products. * Own portfolio business outcomes in partnership with BU leadership: ARR growth, net revenue retention, adoption and expansion, pricing and packaging, and margin. * Build and defend the investment case for new bets through sizing, competitive analysis, and buy/build/partner evaluation, and present recommendations to the executive staff. * Establish a rigorous, evidence\-driven discovery practice—customer advisory boards, THWACK community engagement, win/loss analysis, telemetry, and direct DBA immersion—so roadmap decisions rest on evidence rather than opinion. ### **AI Thought Leadership** * Set and evangelize a forward\-leaning point of view on how AI changes database management: agentic troubleshooting, natural\-language query and performance analysis, autonomous tuning recommendations, anomaly detection, and predictive capacity and cost optimization. * Define the SolarWinds position on AI readiness for the data estate—how customers instrument, govern, and prepare the databases that now serve AI workloads—and translate that position into shipped capability, not just narrative. * Establish the trust framework for AI in the product: explainability, guardrails on write and remediation actions, data residency and privacy, model transparency, and the human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries that enterprise DBAs will require before they delegate anything. * Represent SolarWinds externally as a credible technical voice—with analysts, at industry and data platform events, in the THWACK community, and with strategic customers—and bring that market signal back into the roadmap. * Partner with Product Marketing to convert the AI point of view into positioning, packaging, monetization models, and field enablement that sales can carry. ### **AI\-Native Product Management Practice** * Use AI as a core instrument of the product management craft, not a side experiment: synthesizing customer and support signal at scale, mining product telemetry, accelerating competitive and market research, drafting and pressure\-testing requirements, and prototyping concepts before committing engineering capacity. * Build the AI operating model for the product organization—tooling, prompts and agents, ev erification keep pace with faster code generation. * Maintain the product organization's accountability for outcomes rather than output, ensuring that increased delivery velocity converts into customer value and measurable business results. * Collaborate closely with UX, architecture, QA, support, and security to deliver releases that meet SolarWinds Secure by Design standards. ### **Leadership and Cross\-Functional Influence** * Lead, hire, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed team of product managers; set clear expectations, raise the bar on craft, and build a bench of future product leaders. * Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and intellectual honesty in which strong opinions are welcomed and data settles disagreements. * Serve as the connective tissue across Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Finance to align the portfolio behind a single plan. * Support strategic sales and renewal opportunities as the executive product sponsor, and equip the field with the narrative, proof points, and roadmap transparency needed to win. * Communicate portfolio strategy, progress, and risk clearly and frequently to executive leadership. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years in product management with 5\+ years leading product teams, including experience managing managers or senior individual contributors in a distributed organization. * Demonstrated ownership of a software portfolio or business line with accountability for revenue, retention, and investment decisions—not solely feature\-level roadmap ownership. * Deep domain experience in databases, data platforms, or database/application performance management. Direct familiarity with relational and cloud database internals—query execution, wait states, indexing, and performance tuning—and credibility with a DBA audience. * Experience in observability, monitoring, IT operations management, or enterprise infrastructure software; experience shipping both self\-hosted and SaaS products strongly preferred. * Demonstrated fluency with AI and machine learning applied to products: LLM and agentic capabilities, anomaly detection, evaluation methods, and the trust, cost, and governance considerations that determine whether enterprises adopt them. * Hands\-on use of AI tooling in the product management workflow, with concrete examples of how it changed the team's speed or quality of decision\-making. * Experience partnering with engineering in AI\-assisted or AI\-driven development models (AI\-DLC, spec\-driven development, or equivalent), including how product artifacts and quality gates must change to support them. * Track record of translating a market point of view into a shipped roadmap and measurable commercial results. * Exceptional written and verbal communication with executive presence; proven ability to influence without authority across a matrixed, global organization. * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree a plus. * Willingness to travel up to 20% for customer, partner, and industry engagements. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Prior experience as a DBA, data platform engineer, or database consultant. * Experience integrating an acquired or standalone product into a broader platform. * Established presence in the data platform community—speaking, writing, or open\-source contribution. * Experience with usage\-based or consumption pricing models for observability or data products. Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Db2, SAP ASE, and cloud\-native and NoSQL platforms. * Define the portfolio thesis: where we differentiate, where we integrate, where we partner, and where we sunset—and make the trade\-offs explicit and defensible to the executive team. * Drive the convergence strategy that brings depth\-of\-domain database capability into the broader SolarWinds expansion, pricing and packaging, and margin. * Build and defend the investment case for new bets through sizing, competitive analysis, and buy/build/partner evaluation, and present recommendations to the executive staff. * Establish a rigorous, evidence\-driven discovery practice—customer advisory boards, THWACK community engagement, win/loss analysis, telemetry, and direct DBA immersion—so boundaries that enterprise DBAs will require before they delegate anything. * Represent SolarWinds externally as a credible technical voice—with analysts, at industry and data platform events, in the THWACK community, and with strategic customers—and bring that market signal back into the roadmap. * Partner with Product Marketing to convert the AI point of view into positioning, packaging, monetization models, and field enablement that sales can carry. ### **AI\-Native Product Management Practice** * Use AI as a core instrument of the product management craft, not a side experiment: synthesizing customer and support signal at scale, mining product telemetry, accelerating competitive and market research, drafting and pressure\-testing requirements, and prototyping concepts before committing engineering capacity. * Build the AI operating model for the product organization—tooling, prompts and agents, ev erification keep pace with faster code generation. * Maintain the product organization's accountability for outcomes rather than output, ensuring that increased delivery velocity converts into customer value and measurable business results. * Collaborate closely with UX, architecture, QA, support, and security to deliver releases that meet SolarWinds Secure by Design standards. ### **Leadership and Cross\-Functional Influence** * Lead, hire, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed team of product managers; set clear expectations, raise the bar on craft, and build a bench of future product leaders. * Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and intellectual honesty in which strong opinions are welcomed and data settles disagreements. * Serve as the connective tissue across Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Finance to align the portfolio behind a single plan. * Support strategic sales and renewal opportunities as the executive product sponsor, and equip the field with the narrative, proof points, and roadmap transparency needed to win. * Communicate portfolio strategy, progress, and risk clearly and frequently to executive leadership. organization. * Demonstrated ownership of a software portfolio or business line with accountability for revenue, retention, and investment decisions—not solely feature\-level roadmap ownership. * Deep domain experience in databases, data platforms, or database/application performance management. Direct familiarity with relational and cloud database internals—query execution, wait states, indexing, and performance tuning—and credibility with a DBA audience. * Experience in observability, monitoring, IT operations management, or enterprise infrastructure software; experience shipping both self\-hosted and SaaS products strongly preferred. * Demonstrated fluency with AI and machine learning applied to products: LLM and agentic capabilities, anomaly detection, evaluation methods, and the trust, cost, and governance considerations that determine whether enterprises adopt them. * Hands\-on use of AI tooling in the product management workflow, with concrete examples of how it changed the team's speed or quality of decision\-making. * Experience partnering with engineering in AI\-assisted or AI\-driven development models (AI\-DLC, spec\-driven development, or equivalent), including how product artifacts and quality gates must change to support them. * Track record of translating a market point of view into a shipped roadmap and measurable commercial results. * Exceptional written and verbal communication with executive presence; proven ability to influence without authority across a matrixed, global organization. * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree a plus. * Willingness to travel up to 20% for customer, partner, and industry engagements. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Prior experience as a DBA, data platform engineer, or database consultant. * Experience integrating an acquired or standalone product into a broader platform. * Established presence in the data platform community—speaking, writing, or open\-source contribution. * Experience with usage\-based or consumption pricing models for observability or data products. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Join the **Sony Engagement Platform Services (SEPS)** Team, where innovation meets collaboration in the dynamic world of digital engagement. At SEPS, we are building the next\-generation platform that powers how fans connect with the content—and the creators—they love. Our mission is to unlock meaningful, data\-driven engagement across Sony’s entertainment ecosystem, from games and anime to music, film, and live experiences—empowering both internal teams and external partners to build at scale. Our mission is to create a world\-class engagement platform that not only enhances existing revenue streams but also drives new opportunities through a robust ecosystem of partners and creators. By decoupling application development from platform services, we empower our teams to deliver exceptional solutions with agility and efficiency. If you are passionate about shaping the future of digital engagement and want to be part of a vibrant community that values creativity and collaboration, we invite you to explore the exciting opportunities within our team. Together, we will shape the future of fan experiences and define the foundation for what’s possible in the realm of engagement. To learn more visit: www.sony.com/en/SonyInfo/technology/stories/entries/sep\_introduction/ **POSITION SUMMARY** We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a focused team within SEPS Data Science supporting payment, subscription, and risk experiences across PlayStation’s direct\-to\-consumer business. This is a hands\-on role for someone who will build data, dashboards, reports, and systems that help teams fight fraud and improve decision\-making. Work ranges from short\-term efforts to longer strategic projects, requiring creativity, adaptability, and strong technical execution. This role will be working very closely with the Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) Global Payments Team that plays a central role in enabling consumers across the world to purchase hardware, digital content and services. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, automated workflows, monitoring, alerts, dashboards, and reporting solutions for GPFD teams. * Develop reliable, governed, and AI\-ready data products that support analytics, automation, machine learning, and generative AI use cases. * Partner with data scientists, analysts, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver trusted, documented data for production workflows. * Use cloud technologies, orchestration tools, and modern engineering practices to improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency. * Document architectures, data flows, and processes, and communicate technical concepts to audiences ranging from engineering teams to executives. * Support team growth through mentoring, knowledge sharing, technical reviews, hiring participation, and a strong commitment to protecting Sony and its customers. Honesty, trustworthiness and ethical conduct are material requirements for the responsibilities outlined above * **QUALIFICATIONS FOR POSITION** **Your qualifications and experience should include:** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, database development, software development, systems design, or data analysis. * Strong SQL, data modeling, database design, DDL, DML, data validation, and performance\-optimization skills. * Proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or PowerShell, with experience building automated data pipelines and workflows. * Familiarity with structured and semi\-structured formats, Linux or Windows environments, secure data transfer, permissions, authentication, and encryption. Experience preparing and operationalizing data for analytics, AI, or ML use cases, including data quality, lineage, governance, feature engineering, and responsible use of AI\-assisted tools. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, DynamoDB, Oracle, Hadoop, Athena, or EMR. * Experience with streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, or ActiveMQ. * Familiarity with reporting and observability tools such as Tableau, Splunk, Datadog, or Domo. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, storage, orchestration, and automation tools such as Docker, Packer, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet. * Exposure to AI platforms, vector databases, feature stores, model monitoring, retrieval\-augmented generation, or production ML infrastructure. Knowledge of payments processing, digital commerce, or card\-not\-present fraud. * We are committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for you to thrive as part of Sony’s purpose to “fill the world with emotion through the power of creativity and technology.” Benefits: SCA offers benefits\-eligible employees (generally regular employees scheduled to work 20 or more hours a week) a comprehensive benefits program that offers coverage and support for employees and their family’s physical, emotional, and financial well\-being. What we offer you: * Comprehensive medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage with coverage for spouses/domestic partners and child dependents, including access to a Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Employee assistance plan and comprehensive behavioral health benefits * Fertility benefits, including, surrogacy, and adoption assistance programs * Basic and supplemental life insurance for employees as well as supplemental life insurance coverage for their spouses/domestic partners and children * Voluntary benefits such as group legal, identity theft protection, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance * Short\-term \& long\-term disability plans * Up to 12 weeks of paid parental and caregiver leave * 401(k) Plan with pre\-tax, Roth, and after\-tax options and company match with immediate vesting Education assistance and student loan programs * Other Programs: * \[Flexible Work Arrangements, including remote and hybrid work schedules] * Time off to include vacation, paid holidays, sick leave, Summer Fridays (early release), and a winter break between Christmas and New Year’s Day (based on business needs) * Referral bonuses (subject to eligibility) * Matching gift program * A wide variety of employee business resource groups (EBRGs) * Special discounts on Sony products, offered exclusively to Sony employees Employee stock purchase plan (Sony covers commissions and fees for your Sony stock purchases made through after\-tax payroll deductions) * *The anticipated annual base salary for this position is $180,000 to $205,000\. This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.* \#LI\-AS1 SCA will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation. **Disability Accommodation for Applicants to Sony Corporation of America** Sony Corporation of America provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in job application procedures. For reasonable accommodation requests, please contact us by email at careers@sonyusa.com or by mail to: Sony Corporation of America, People Experience Department, 25 Madison Avenue, New York, NY 10010\. Please indicate the position you are applying for. We are aware that unauthorized individuals or organizations may attempt to solicit personal information or payments from job applicants by impersonating our company through fraudulent job postings. We take these matters seriously but cannot control third\-party websites. To protect your personal information, please verify that any job posting you respond to also appears on our official Careers page: www.sonyjobs.com . Please also be advised that we never request personal identifying information (such as Social Security numbers, bank details, or copies of identification documents) during the initial stages of our application process.
