jobs.title: Director of Business Development & AI Automation
jobs.description: **Base Salary \+ Uncapped 10% Profit Share on the New Business You Build** Aesthetic \+ Regenerative Medical Group \| Full\-Time \| Onsite \| Southern California (Orange County, Palm Desert, Temecula, San Diego) **Pay: $73,000 per year base salary \+ uncapped 10% profit share on new business you develop** **Who We're Looking For** This role is built for a rainmaker who is also an efficiency fanatic. We're a growing, lean\-running medical group specializing in aesthetic and regenerative medical services, and we're hiring a charismatic, high\-energy, deeply tech\-savvy operator who wants to build something — and get paid a meaningful share of the profits they create. Your bonus is tied to profit, and you'll have real ownership over both sides of that equation. On the revenue side: outbound sales, partnerships, and public speaking. On the cost side: using AI and automation to run our operations leaner than anyone thought possible. Every deal you close and every workflow you automate grows the same number — yours. You should be the kind of person who is energized by outbound calls, walks into a room of strangers and leaves with three warm leads, and is completely comfortable delivering a talk to a chamber of commerce, a police union meeting, or a corporate HR team — and who then goes home and builds an AI agent to answer patient texts at midnight. If you're looking for a quiet 9\-to\-5, this is not your job. If you're looking for real ownership, direct access to physician leadership, and a bonus structure where your hustle and ingenuity directly determine your income — keep reading. **A note on seniority: we don't care about it.** We're not hiring years logged or titles held — we're hiring hunger, energy, and demonstrated results. If you're early in your career but you've closed real deals and built real automations, you'll beat a 20\-year veteran here. Show us what you've built. **The Deal** * **$73,000 fixed base salary** — this is a salaried, exempt position * **10% of the profits from new business revenue you develop** — uncapped. Because it's a profit share, not a revenue share, the efficiencies you engineer flow straight into your bonus: land the contract, then automate its delivery, and you get paid on both. Full formula provided in a written bonus agreement. * Benefits: \[Insert benefits: health, PTO, mileage reimbursement, etc.] **Be clear\-eyed about the hours:** this is a high\-ownership leadership role, not a 40\-hour week. Successful people in this seat routinely invest well beyond standard hours — evenings, events, and weekend availability included — and are reachable when urgent needs arise (outreach events, clinic escalations, payroll deadlines, time\-sensitive launches). The base salary does not increase with hours worked; the profit share is where extra effort turns into extra income. **Primary Outcome \#1: New Revenue** * **Hunt and close new revenue**: ongoing community outreach, outbound sales calls, partnership development, and new income streams for the group * **Present publicly and often**: deliver talks, seminars, and presentations at community gatherings, business groups, wellness events, and partner organizations — you are the public face of our growth * **Forge corporate wellness and executive health programs** with local mid\-size and large organizations (discovery, proposals, pricing support, contracting support, rollout) * **Propose wellness programs for governmental organizations and government employees**, including first responders such as police and fire departments * Build and manage a pipeline of opportunities — track outreach, follow\-ups, meetings, proposals, and results **Primary Outcome \#2: AI\-Driven Efficiency \+ Profitability** You will own the mission of making this the leanest, most automated medical group in Southern California. We expect you to relentlessly find low\-cost, high\-leverage solutions rather than throwing headcount or expensive software at problems. * **Automate the patient pipeline with AI**: deploy AI tools to capture, respond to, qualify, and route incoming patient leads, phone calls, and text messages — AI receptionists/voice agents, chat and SMS assistants, smart routing, and automated follow\-up and reactivation * **Automate marketing with AI**: build AI\-driven marketing systems — content generation, campaign creation and optimization for Google Ads and Meta Ads, email/SMS nurture sequences, review and reputation workflows, and reporting * **Streamline operations for profitability**: identify bottlenecks and waste across locations, redesign workflows, and automate scheduling, intake, confirmations, and internal handoffs using Zapier, Airtable, APIs, and AI platforms integrated with our EHR (e.g., Jane), Slack, Microsoft Teams, and SMS systems * **Champion lean solutions**: maximize output per dollar — vet tools ruthlessly, eliminate redundant spend, and build scrappy in\-house solutions where off\-the\-shelf is overpriced * **Measure everythi l (Onsite)** Work is performed onsite at clinics in Orange County, Palm Desert, Temecula, and San Diego. Regular travel between locations is an essential part of the role. **Requirements (Must Have)** * **Proven business development track record**: outreach, outbound calls, relationship building, and closed deals — be ready to tell us who you targeted and what you landed * **Exceptional presence and communication**: charismatic, persuasive, and confident presenting to groups and speaking at public events * **Extreme tech\-savviness with AI tools**: hands\-on experience deploying AI for real business workflows — lead response, voice/chat/SMS automation, marketing automation — not just casual chatbot use. Be ready to demo something you built. * **Lean\-operations mindset**: a track record of cutting costs or multiplying output without adding headcount * **High integrity on compliance**: working awareness of HIPAA as it applies to patient communications and automation, and the judgment to build fast without cutting corners on patient care or regulations * **Extreme work ethic and availability**: self\-driven, responsive outside traditional business hours when urgent needs arise, and motivated by performance\-based upside * Experience working in or managing a medical practice or medical group (operations, staffing, patient flow) — we care about what you did there, not how many years you logged * Bookkeeping capability with hands\-on payroll processing experience * Strong automation skills: Zapier, Airtable, APIs, Jane (or similar EHR), Slack, Microsoft Teams, and SMS platforms * Working understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads * Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and reliable transportation; ability to work onsite across multiple Southern California locations with schedule flexibility **Preferred (Nice to Have)** * Experience in aesthetics, med spa, cash\-pay clinics, wellness, concierge medicine, or regenerative services * Experience deploying AI voice agents, AI receptionists, or conversational AI in a healthcare or appointment\-based business * Experience building corporate wellness / executive health programs or selling services to organizations or government * Multi\-location operations experience; strong Excel/Google Sheets reporting skills; vendor management * Bilingual (Spanish/English) **Our Hiring Process** We're selective about this seat, and we respect your time — here's exactly what to expect: * **1\. Intro call** — a focused conversation about your track record and what drives you * **2\. Working session** — walk us through deals you've closed and demo automations you've built, and talk through real scenarios from our clinics, from growth opportunities to compliance judgment calls. This is where builders shine and resumes stop mattering. * **3\. The pitch** — the final round is a live presentation: you'll pitch a concept, program, or service to our physician leadership as if we were a prospective client. Treat us like a corporate HR team you're trying to close. If you love to sell, this is the round you'll look forward to. We move fast for the right person. **How to Apply** Send: * Your resume * A short note covering: (1\) your biggest business development win — who you targeted, what you pitched, and the revenue result; (2\) the best AI automation you've built — tools used, what it replaced, and the dollars or hours it saved; (3\) an example of you presenting or speaking publicly; (4\) your payroll/bookkeeping experience * Optional: video of you presenting, screenshots or demos of automations, dashboards, campaign examples, or event photos **Apply to: zach@coolmarketing.com** *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* Pay: From $73,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk. At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI\-powered future. AI Fearlessly. **About the Role** We are looking for a **Staff Data Engineer – Data Platform** to help design and build the next generation of the **Vision One Data Platform** . This is a highly technical, hands\-on role focused on creating a modern data foundation that enables Vision One engineering teams to discover, govern, access, transform, and analyze data across the platform. You will work at the intersection of **distributed databases, data engineering, data governance, semantic discovery, and self\-service analytics** . A key part of the role is enabling **dbt as a self\-service data transformation and modeling capability across Vision One OLTP databases** , while building the underlying architecture, governance, and data movement infrastructure required to do this reliably at scale. You will work closely with platform, product, security, and data engineering teams to establish common data standards and infrastructure that can be reused across Vision One. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build the **Vision One Data Platform** , including data ingestion, replication, transformation, governance, discovery, and serving capabilities. * Build scalable data pipelines and **change\-data\-capture (CDC)** architectures using technologies such as **Datastream** and similar streaming/replication technologies. * Enable **self\-service dbt** across Vision One OLTP data sources, providing product teams with governed capabilities to transform, model, test, document, and expose their data without requiring the central data platform team to build every pipeline. * Establish patterns for safely extracting and replicating data from **OLTP and distributed SQL databases** into analytical and downstream data systems. * Design architectures around distributed SQL technologies such as **YugabyteDB, CockroachDB** , or similar platforms. * Work with technologies such as **Databricks** and modern analytical processing engines to support large\-scale data processing and analytics. * Build a comprehensive **data catalog and metadata foundation** that enables teams and AI agents to understand what data exists, where it comes from, what it means, and how it can be used. * Develop **semantic data discovery** capabilities that allow engineers, analysts, applications, and AI agents to discover relevant data based on business meaning rather than only database/schema names. * Establish data governance standards covering **ownership, lineage, schemas, quality, access control, retention, and lifecycle management** . * Develop reusable data platform primitives and APIs that product teams can consume as self\-service capabilities. * Build automated mechanisms for **data quality, schema evolution, lineage, observability, and freshness monitoring** . * Design for evolving product schemas and ensure the platform can accommodate continuous changes without creating excessive duplication or operational overhead. * Partner with security and platform engineering teams to establish appropriate **fine\-grained data access controls** across databases, schemas, tables, and data products. * Help establish the **source\-of\-truth architecture** for Vision One data while minimizing unnecessary data duplication. * Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to other data engineers and product engineering teams. Drive engineering standards around reliability, scalability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence. * **What You Bring** **Required:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, distributed systems, backend engineering, or a related field. * Strong experience designing and building **large\-scale data platforms and data pipelines** . * Deep understanding of **OLTP and OLAP architectures** and the tradeoffs between them. * Hands\-on experience with **CDC, data replication, and streaming architectures** . * Strong SQL expertise and experience working with relational databases at scale. * Experience with **distributed SQL databases** , such as YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner, or similar technologies. * Experience building data transformation workflows using **dbt** or similar data modeling frameworks. * Experience with modern analytical/data platforms such as **Databricks, Spark, Trino, Snowflake, BigQuery** , or equivalent. * Strong understanding of data governance concepts including **metadata, lineage, data quality, ownership, access control, and data catalogs** . * Experience designing systems that support  g **fine\-grained authorization** for data platforms. * Experience managing large\-scale telemetry, security, observability, or other high\-volume data. * Experience balancing **data quality, query performance, platform reliability, and infrastructure cost** . **What Success Looks Like** In this role, you will help establish a Data Platform where: * Vision One data can be **discovered through a common semantic layer** , rather than requiring teams to understand every underlying database and schema. * Product teams can use **dbt as a governed self\-service capability** across their OLTP data. * Data lineage, ownership, quality, and access policies are **built into the platform rather than managed manually** . * Data can move reliably from distributed OLTP systems into analytical and downstream systems through standardized CDC and streaming patterns. * Product teams can consume platform capabilities without repeatedly building their own ingestion, transformation, governance, and discovery infrastructure. * The platform provides a **trusted source of truth** while minimizing unnecessary copies of data. * The resulting data foundation can support not only traditional analytics and applications, but also **AI and agentic experiences across Vision One** . **Engineering Leadership** As a Staff Engineer, you will be expected to operate beyond the boundaries of a single team. You will shape architecture, establish technical standards, mentor engineers, drive cross\-team adoption, and solve ambiguous problems that span multiple products and systems. You should be comfortable going deep into implementation details while simultaneously thinking about the long\-term architecture of a **large\-scale, multi\-product security data platform** . **Why Join TrendAI?** --------------------- TrendAI is a leader in AI security. We not only delivered the first open\-weight, cybersecurity\-focused large language model, but also the industry's first security companion agent evaluated directly by customers. Trend Vision One integrates endpoint, cloud, network, email, identity, AI application, and data security into a single, unified platform. In this role, you will help define how a security\-critical product is built — including how AI shapes the development process itself. You will partner with engineering leaders applying AI to that process, working in an environment where the bar on systems thinking, critical review, and security instinct has gone up, not down. **What We Offer You:** You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. TrendAI provides benefit options for you and your family. * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance * Life insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Pre\-partum, maternity, parental and medical leave * Mental Health Wellness Program * Adoption Assistance * Wellness Incentive * Pet Insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off * 14 Annual Holidays * Tuition Assistance Employee Resource Groups * We offer competitive compensation with bonus opportunity tied to company performance, along with room to enhance your skills through ongoing learning and broad technological opportunities. Achieving work\-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work. \#LI\-JL1 At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. Trend Micro provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. Trend Micro does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy and childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care leave status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER
jobs.description: Job description: **Overview** ***Code that keeps care moving.*** Behind every Medicare member who finds the right provider, gets a claim paid correctly, and receives care on time, there's software that has to work, every time. At USAMCO, The National Networks of Choice, you'll write that software. We're a Medicare\-focused managed care organization connecting members, providers, and health plans nationwide, and we're in the middle of a bold transformation. We're rebuilding a 40\-year\-old legacy foundation into a modern, cloud\-native healthcare platform powered by Creatio CRM, a Databricks data lakehouse, and automated delivery. This isn't a maintenance gig. It's a chance to design and build the systems that will run healthcare operations for years to come. **Why This Matters** In healthcare, software quality is personal. A clean integration means a provider shows up correctly in a directory. A well\-tested release means a claim gets paid on time. A secure design means a senior's health data stays protected. We're looking for an engineer who feels that responsibility and builds accordingly. **What You'll Build** * Modern healthcare applications. Design, develop, and maintain applications, services, and APIs that support members, providers, and claims operations. * The integrations that connect it all. Build reliable data flows between Creatio, Databricks, and legacy systems, turning decades of healthcare data into something teams can trust and use. * The modernization itself. Translate legacy business logic into clean, well\-documented, maintainable code as we move off our IBM i platform. * Quality from the start. Champion code reviews, automated testing, and sound architecture so the codebase stays healthy as it grows. * Secure by design. Write software that protects member data and meets HIPAA and CMS requirements from the first commit. * A smarter delivery pipeline. Put your experience to work contributing to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability so the team ships faster and safer. * A stronger team. Mentor developers across a team of about 30 technologists and help set the engineering standards USAMCO runs on. **Your First\-Year Impact** * Deliver key components of our legacy\-to\-modern migration. * Build and stabilize integrations that power provider, member, and claims data. * Raise the bar on code quality, testing, and documentation across the team. * Help mature our CI/CD and release practices alongside platform and infrastructure partners. **What You Bring** * 10\+ years of professional software development, including at least 3 in a senior or lead role. * A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Deep proficiency in one or more modern languages, such as C\#/.NET, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large, complex datasets. * Hands\-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs, web services, and data pipelines. * Experience building on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP). * Working DevOps experience, including CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar), version control best practices, and exposure to infrastructure as code or containers. * A documentation\-first mindset and a knack for building systems others can understand and maintain. * The ability to explain technical trade\-offs clearly to engineers, business partners, and executives. **Bonus Points** * Healthcare, health insurance, or other regulated\-industry experience (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST). * Experience with Databricks, Creatio, or other low\-code/CRM platforms. * Experience modernizing legacy systems, especially mainframe, IBM i, or RPG environments. * Familiarity with data engineering concepts like data lakehouses, medallion architecture, or change data capture. * A graduate degree in a relevant field. **Why USAMCO** * Purpose\-driven engineering. Your code directly supports access to care for Medicare members across the country. * Modernization with real stakes. Build modern architecture in an industry where getting it right truly matters. * A seat at the table. Your experience shapes design decisions, not just tickets. * Leadership that invests in you. Engineering rigor, a culture of documentation, and a formal Learning \& Development program to keep you growing. * Room to lead. As our engineering organization grows, so does your opportunity to lead it. **Compensation** USAMCO offers a highly competitive compensation package, with base salary based on education, experience, and the expertise you bring. We're ready to make a compelling offer to the right candidate. Total rewards include comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings with company contribution, paid time off, and professional development support. Ready to build software that helps people get care? Let's talk. *USAMCO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees.* Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Dependent care reimbursement * Family leave * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid holidays * Paid parental leave * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85015 Required Education: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Required Experience: * Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in software development. * Proven track record of working on mid to large\-scale software projects. * Experience with agile development methodologies and practices. * Hands\-on experience with version control systems such as Git. Required Skills and Abilities: * Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, C\+\+, or Python. * Strong understanding of software development principles and design patterns. * Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, for effective collaboration with team members. * Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. * Familiarity with software testing and debugging techniques. * Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.

jobs.title: Lead, Application and AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Values \& Innovation** ------------------------ At Under Armour, we are committed to empowering those who strive for more, and the company's values \- Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes and Stand for Equality \- serve as both a roadmap for our teams and the qualities expected of every teammate. Our Values define and unite us, the beliefs that are the red thread that connects everyone at Under Armour. Our values are rallying cries, reminding us why we're here, and fueling everything we do. Our pursuit of better begins with innovation and with our team's mission of being the best. With us, you get the freedom to go further \- no matter your role. That means developing, delivering, and selling the state\-of\-the\-art products and digital tools that make top performers even better. If you are a current Under Armour teammate, **Purpose of Role** ------------------- As a Lead Application and AI Security Engineer in our Digital Product Security organization, you will secure Under Armour’s portfolio of Direct\-to\-Consumer \& Business\-to\-Business applications. As a secure software and AI security leader, you will drive secure\-by\-design development practices, establish security guardrails for AI\-enabled solutions, and advance AI\-powered security capabilities across our software development lifecycle. You will also build AI\-based security capabilities and leverage industry\-leading solutions to protect our customer applications and data spanning web applications, mobile applications, and application programming interfaces (APIs). **Your Impact** --------------- * Define and execute our application and AI security strategy, policies, and roadmap across all of our software development teams * Lead the integration of AI\-powered security capabilities across the software development lifecycle * Partner with engineering teams to embed security and AI controls into developer coding platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and applications * Serve as the technical lead for AI security initiatives across web, mobile, API, and third\-party AI service consumption * Develop application and AI security standards for technology that consumes, integrates, or builds AI/ML capabilities * Establish governance, guardrails and security requirements for the development, deployment, and operation of GenAI, LLMs, and agentic solutions * Evaluate, pilot, and operationalize emerging AI security technologies * Define acceptable use policies, code review requirements, data protection controls, and validation processes for AI\-generated code * Mentor developers, architects, and engineering leaders on secure application development practices **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in computer science/IT/engineering or a related discipline with typically 8 years of cyber security experience or Master's degree with typically 6 years of relevant experience or typically 12 years of relevant work experience without degree * Understanding of how modern engineering teams build software using AI coding assistants, code generation platforms, and AI\-powered services * Requires 5\+ years of application security experience * Strong familiarity with OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and secure AI software development practices * Strong familiarity with secrets detection, SAST, DAST, SCA, \& API security testing * Experience securing AI\-enabled applications, including LLMs, AI agents, MCP integrations, prompt injection defenses, model governance, and data protection controls * Experience using AI to code scripts that leverage APIs to build custom application security solutions * Strong cross\-functional teaming skills to coordinate and implement security enhancements with product and engineering teams **Workplace Location** ---------------------- * **Location:** Candidates must reside within a commutable distance to our corporate headquarters in Baltimore, Maryland, as periodic on\-site attendance may be required * **Work Schedule:** Remote with periodic on\-site attendance * **Travel:** 1\-2 times per year * **Sponsorship Eligibility:** UA does not offer sponsorship of job applicants for employment\-based work authorization for this position at this time. **Relocation** -------------- No relocation provided **Base Compensation** --------------------- $155,000\.00\-$200,000\.00 USD Most new hires fall within this range and have the opportunity to earn more over time. Initial placement within the salary range, however, is based on an individual's relevant knowledge, skills and experience for the position. UA is committed to helping our teammates succeed and advance in their careers. Base salary is only one component of our competitive Total Rewards package. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Paid "UA Give Back" Volunteer Days: Work alongside your team to support initiatives in your local community * Under Armour Merchandise Discounts * Competitive 401(k) plan matching * Maternity and Parental Leave for eligible and FMLA\-eligible teammates * Health \& fitness benefits, discounts and resources\- We offer teammates across the country programs to promote physical activity and overall well\-being **Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity** --------------------------------------- At Under Armour, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, family or paternal status and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Under Armour seeks to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people representing a wide variety of backgrounds and perspectives. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact our Human Resources team via candidateaccommodations@underarmour.com. jobs.title: NOC Engineer I
jobs.description: UDT is a national technology solutions provider that modernizes, connects, secures, and manages technology environments for commercial enterprises, state and local governments, and educational institutions. The trusted advisor to many of the nation’s top K\-12 school districts and corporate leaders across a spectrum of industries including hospitality, health care, financial services and more – UDT offers one of the most robust suites of customizable, end\-to\-end technology solutions in the industry. With a portfolio that spans IT managed services, endpoint lifecycle solutions, cybersecurity, networking, computing, cloud, connectivity, and voice services, UDT helps clients align technology with their most important business priorities – empowering insight\-driven IT strategies that accelerate innovation, streamline costs, and reduce risk. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Miramar, Florida, UDT has more than 400 professionals nationwide and growing operational facilities in Florida, Tennessee, Texas, and South Carolina. For more information, visit udtonline.com. **T****his is a full\-time office\-based position, located Orlando, Florida** ***Applicants must reside within daily commuting distance Orlando, FL*** **NOC I Engineer** **Summary** NOC Engineer I will provide first level technical support and services and is responsible for analyzing, installing, configuring, maintaining and repairing network infrastructure and application components. Responsibilities also entail support for IT Service Management technological equipment and software including but not limited to: workstations, servers, printers, and vendor specific hardware and software especially where related to network connectivity. This position is responsible for leading the Network Operation Center (NOC) support, service operations, quality control, maximized performance resolution, hardware and software installation and maintain within Service level Agreements to ensure services and support are being met and delivered in a consistent manner to clients. The NOC Engineer I is also responsible for the proactive monitoring, hardware and software trending, scheduling follow\-ups, reporting and registering of incidents/requests communicated by the clients. **Responsibilities** * Responsible for resolving and supporting within the NOC via remote control solutions and on\-site client support of low/medium complexity incidents (pertaining to but not limited to: WAN and LAN connectivity, routers, firewalls, and security) as well as service requests, perform escalations, generate daily tickets for the services and support provided. * Support disaster recovery solutions and executes Severity/Crisis Management process with communication to IT department, and other departments including management, vendors and clients during a planned or unplanned outage. * Informs management and key client personnel of operational and procedural deficiencies when encountered during shifts or from problem management issues. * Performs remote access solution implementation and support (VPN, Terminal Services, and Citrix), remote monitoring and management of system alerts/notifications, proactive services and support by investigating, tracking, monitoring and document all departments/sites for nonfunctioning devices, perform repairs and routine maintenance of hardware and software, scheduling and documenting all support activities, completion of ticket registering daily which includes the following but not limited to escalations, resolutions and departmental/customer follow ups. * Provides support on escalated client communications and ensures a rapid decision response, perform investigative analysis while providing accurate, thorough answers in a timely manner to customer inquiries. * Interface with client’s executives, technical representatives, other technology services department/personnel, UDT partners, and all levels of UDT employees to ensure that operational procedures, accurate escalation processes, timely document registration within UDT’s Professional Service Automation (PSA) tool and status updates are performed and streamline workflow is maintained to ensure customer satisfaction. * Works with clients/vendors to resolve technical problems in the most effective and expeditious manner, collaborate to implement practices to improve operations. * Collaborates with management in the implementation of programs incorporating changes to methods, systems and procedures. * Participate in discovery sessions with prospects and customers to gather and understand their technical and functional requirements. * Maintain satisfactory consistent resolution of customer service level agreements and improve customer service, perception, and satisfaction * Work with the Service Desk Dispatcher to ensure requests are routed/escalated to the proper resource in a consistent manner * Responsible for entering all work as service tickets, time and expenses in UDT’s Professional Service  ion (PSA) tool * Design and deploy company LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including servers, routers, firewalls, load balancers hubs, switches, UPSs, and other hardware * Configures, tests, and maintains LAN/WAN equipment and related services * Identifies, diagnoses, and resolves network problems * Architecting, creating, managing and maintaining Network, Server and PC health for clients (as defined by SLA) * Managing existing and deploying new system configurations, including Windows Server, Virtualization Systems, Mobile Devices, Mobile Platforms and Desktops (Windows and MAC) * Provide formal corporate communications on directional changes or changes that will impact existing services * Select and implement security tools, policies, and procedures in conjunction with the company’s security team * Monitor and maintain all levels of network security internally and externally * Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all implemented networks **Qualifications \& Experience** * Must be extremely customer and team focused. Willing to put the customer first and ensure they are engaged regularly. Be a productive, educated, advocate for the team and UDT, utilizing your past experience to provide the highest quality support possible. * 2\+ years of experience in local area networks, internet connectivity, or internet security appliances. • 2\+ years of experience supporting routers, switches, or wireless access points. * 2\+ years of experience with DNS, SMTP, SNMP, * + 4\+ years of hands on/phone support work experience in a technical support or NOC role. 3\+ years of working and documenting customer needs in a ticketing system. ConnectWise or similar is a plus. * Experience with voice technology like PBX, VoIP, POTS, or PSTN preferred. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple demanding activities in a high performing department, resolving multiple complex engineering items through interactions with team members, phone calls, ticketing system and e\-mail. Proficiency in MS Office Suite. **Education** * A bachelor’s degree in information technology or business is preferred and/or a combined technical certifications and job experience is required. * A current Cisco CCENT or CCNA certification is preferred * A current Fortinet FCE or FCA (NSE 3 or NSE 4\) certification is preferred * Certifications such as ITIL Foundations or other equivalent technical certifications is preferred. * Any other certifications or professional development units (PDUs) are a plus. **Travel** * Must be able to travel as needed to Corporate Headquarters in Miramar FL or customer locations as requested **Working Conditions** * Reporting into the office with some optional remote working options available. * Office setting with sitting for extended periods of time. * Ability to lift 25lb **What UDT offers you** We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the organization. UDT’s Total Rewards package includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage as of the 1st of the month, health savings accounts, flexible savings accounts, 401(k) plan with company match, 7 annual holidays and flexible time off options. Join us and be part of an inclusive, energizing, and collaborative environment. UDT is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is committed to workforce diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, or national origin. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background and pre\-employment drug screen. UDT is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status

jobs.title: Customer Service Engineer (CT/MRI/PET-CT/X-ray/ANGIO)
jobs.description: Description: **Who we are?** United Imaging is a leading global medical device developer and supplier with a diversified portfolio of advanced medical products, digital healthcare solutions, and intelligent solutions that cover the entire process of imaging diagnosis and treatment. From our North American HQ in Houston, we are passionate about expanding our customer sales and support structure, embracing the highest quality and craftsmanship in each of our medical imaging products, and dedicated to building an outstanding organization. Join our innovative team with the mission of developing and supplying advanced technologies and improving patient care worldwide. As part of our global team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues while developing and expanding your career. **Company Page**: http://www.united\-imaging.com/en/home/ **Benefits** When joining our team, we offer the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, short\- \& long\-term disability insurance, employee assistance program, company paid basic life insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, sick leave, and (12\) paid holidays. Compensation decisions are based upon the candidate level of skill, qualifications, geographical location and experience, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the posted pay range. Additionally, the position may also be eligible to earn performance\-based incentive compensation (such as cash bonus(es). **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Provide top\-level on\-site service support that delights our customers and sets the benchmark for the medical imaging industry * Work closely with Customer Care Center (regional and headquarter level) to effectively carry out trouble\-shooting, maintenance, and updates on designated products * Embrace new technology while levering core strengths in customer service and service support * Play a key role in new, first\-of\-a\-kind medical imaging system product launches in the US market * Continually build competence in providing technical assistance and support to our customers * Quickly and efficiently escalate challenges as appropriate to ensure expeditious resolution of all issues and high levels of customer satisfaction * Responsible for installation of UIH diagnostic imaging equipment for designated products in geographic region * Attend service training courses overseas and in the US as needed and work toward completion of the UIH Professional Certificate. Requirements: This position is for a remote field service engineer. The selected candidate must live in or near the posting location for this position. **Education** * Associate degree in technical field and/or equivalent experience preferred **Experience** * Familiar with the principles and hardware/software configurations of diagnostic imaging equipment (MR, CT, PET\-CT, X\-ray, etc.) and previous experience with relevant equipment strongly preferred * Ideally, have previous field service experience where you have managed a geographic territory and demonstrated strong troubleshooting ability with hardware, mechanical, and software systems * Possess relevant IT skills with competence on Windows, Microsoft Office suite, and network communication and connectivity; **Required Skills or/ Attributes** * Strong customer communication skills with ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing * Demonstrated ability to contribute to a team environment focused on customer success * Superb customer facing skills needed for working with customers and internally at all levels within UIH / 3rd parties, contractors, and subcontractors. Must be able to quickly build rapport and gain respect from others; * Valid driver's license and good driving record required; * Willingness to travel extensively (at least 75%) as needed for customer support and training. **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** United Imaging is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity, equity, and inclusion matter. United Imaging provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.\*Note: Relocation is not available for this role

jobs.description: **The Opportunity** Unity Vector represents the next generation of our AI\-powered advertising ecosystem, a forward\-looking evolution of our machine learning infrastructure and models. We are seeking a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to join our Vector Ads Modeling team. In this role, you will work with a high\-performing high\-impact team to advance ads recommendation algorithms to deliver personalized ads experience. **What you’ll be doing** * Identity opportunities and design modeling roadmap that addresses customer needs. * Drive foundational research for new models and paradigms. * Leverage rich user data and large\-scale compute to validate models rapidly. * Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to productionalize research. **What we’re looking for** * Expertise: Hands\-on experience applying state\-of\-the\-art machine learning and deep learning models to complex real\-world problems, specifically in the domains of user behavior modeling. Proficiency in Python, Pytorch and deep learning frameworks. * Data \& Analytics: Solid understanding of metric design, large\-scale data analysis, and distributed computing frameworks. * Strategic Impact: Proven ability to drive projects end\-to\-end, solving critical cross\-team problems and delivering measurable business results. **Additional information** Gross Annual Salary: $197,400 \- $325,400 USD *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. jobs.description: All required qualifications must be documented on application materials. Required Qualifications: * BA/BS degree in an engineering discipline (preferably in mechanical engineering) plus at least two years of experience or a combination of related engineering education and work experience to equal at least 6 years * Experience with 3D CAD software * Previous research engineering experience * Ability to work in and around strong magnetic fields * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Strong organization skills Preferred Qualifications: * Experience in a fabrication environment (Maker Space, R\&D Lab or Shop) * Experience with MRI systems and support * Project management experience The Center for Magnetic Resonance Research (CMRR) is seeking an experienced driven individual who is eager to join our team of engineers supporting a variety of research projects. While this position has a mechanical engineering focus, we are seeking a well\-rounded engineer or technician who can contribute where needed, is eager to solve research problems, is a team player, and provide overall engineering project management support. Primary responsibility of this position is to provide mechanical engineering design, development, prototyping, testing, and evaluation solutions in support of faculty led research projects. Additional responsibilities include management of our electrical and fabrication labs, 3D printing and printer maintenance, CAD design, and MRI system peripheral equipment installation and integration. This position supports the CMRR research faculty, the general needs of the Center, and works in collaboration with fellow engineers. The role requires someone who possesses great communication and time management skills alongside technical and problem\-solving skills. Work Arrangement: The position is expected to work primarily on\-site. Your work location will be The Center for Magnetic Resonance Research at the University of Minnesota. The Department retains the right to modify flexible work arrangement agreements on a temporary or permanent basis for any reason at any time. Responsibilities: 3D printing and printer management (30%) * Work with investigators to develop, prototype, and fabricate 3D printed solutions to support the needs of their specific research projects * Serve as subject matter expert * Maintain and manage the print queue across several printers * Perform regular maintenance on the various printers and laser cutters * Repair equipment * Maintain materials stock such as filament, resin, powders, and acrylic sheets * Support and educate investigators about 3D printing feasibility and best practices Mechanical design (25%) * Design/develop innovative solutions for research project needs/problems tailored to available manufacturing techniques * Work with individual researchers to translate the needs of their projects to the magnet environment, including selecting the optimal fabrication techniques. * Work with investigators, in cooperation with RF engineers, to design coil housings to fit the needs of their specific research projects * Design magnet accessories (eye tracking mounts, screen holders, etc.) to support the needs of researchers * Mechanical design for various research project needs including prototype testing, feasibility assessments, troubleshooting, and evaluating/modifying designs Electrical and machine shop management (20%) * Keeping research engineering and prototyping electronics and machine shops clean and organized * Ordering tools and parts for the shops when stocks go low * Maintaining shop equipment * Training users on equipment (3D printers, laser cutters, soldering irons, etc.) * Managing shop access MRI peripheral equipment installation, integration, and maintenance (15%) * System design, integration, testing, and modification to meet the specific needs of various research projects * Documentation of systems for users * Work with researchers to troubleshoot problems and new use cases as needed * Maintenance and repair of existing equipment Research engineering project management (10%) * Tracking various projects being worked on by research engineering team * Prioritize projects based on input from leadership * Providing updates to various stakeholders as needed * Supervising 1\-3 student support engineers Applications must be submitted online. To be considered for this position, please click the Apply button and follow the instructions. You will be given the opportunity to complete an online application for the position and attach a cover letter and resume. Additional documents may be attached after application by accessing your "My Job Applications" page and uploading documents in the "My Cover Letters and Attachments" section. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775\) 784\-1495 or jobs@unr.edu . **Job Description** The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) College of Science invites applications for the position of Chair, Department of Chemistry, at the rank of Professor, a tenured position, with an anticipated target hire date of **July 1, 2027** **.** Exceptional candidates at the Associate Professor rank will also be considered. T he Department and College seek a dynamic, collaborative and visionary leader to serve as Chair to advance the Department of Chemistry’s research, education and service missions. The Department is one of 10 departments in the College of Science, together with the College’s public service programs, and plays a foundational role in research and education across the University. The Department includes two dozen academic and administrative faculty, whose expertise spans analytical, bio\-organic, computational, inorganic, materials, organic, physical and theoretical chemistry. The Department offers a highly reputable B.S. in Chemistry with multiple areas of emphasis, and has maintained continuous American Chemical Society (ACS) certification status since 1941\. It also offers M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in Chemistry, and participates with the Department of Physics in the interdisciplinary Ph.D. program in Chemical Physics. The Chemistry graduate programs support approximately 65\-75 graduate students working with research\-active faculty. Undergraduate and graduate students benefit from extensive opportunities for faculty\-mentored research and access to advanced research infrastructure. Departmental research is supported by extramural grants from federal and private agencies, with over $10M in research funding in FY25\-26\. Research spans experimental and theoretical chemistry, and is supported by extensive shared instrumentation in the Shared Instrumentation Laboratory (SIL), including NMR spectrometry, X\-ray diffraction, mass spectrometry, optical and laser spectroscopy, and materials characterization capabilities. The Department also operates ChemStores, a research stockroom that provides chemicals, supplies, and related resources to researchers across campus. The Department has a strong tradition of interdisciplinary research, including the Hitchcock Center for Chemical Ecology, which brings together investigators from chemistry, biology, mathematics, biochemistry, natural resources and environmental science. The interdisciplinary Ph.D. program in Chemical Physics provides an additional bridge between Chemistry and Physics. Together, these activities provide a strong foundation for expanding collaborative research across the College of Science, the University, and with external partners. The Chair will work collaboratively with faculty, staff, students, the Dean and College leadership to establish and implement a forward\-looking vision for the Department. The Chair will strengthen research excellence and extramural funding, advance undergraduate and graduate education, recruit and retain outstanding faculty and students, strategically manage departmental resources and infrastructure. The Chair is expected to maintain an innovative, externally funded research program, with competitive startup support available. The Chair will help position Chemistry as a leader in interdisciplinary research and education and enhance the Department's visibility and impact within Nevada and nationally. A successful Chair will be expected to address a set of key opportunities and responsibilities, including: * Develop and implement a strategic vision for the Department. * Strengthen the Department's research enterprise. * Promote interdisciplinary collaboration across the College of Science and University. * Recruit, retain, mentor and support outstanding faculty and staff. * Sustain and advance excellence in undergraduate education. * Strengthen graduate education and training. * Expand opportunities for undergraduate research and experiential learning. * Support strategic management and development of research and instructional infrastructure. * Advance a strong culture of laboratory safety and responsible research. * Develop and support effective mentoring and professional\-development programs. * Oversee and strategically manage the Department's budget, personnel, space and other resources. * Advance external engagement and resource development by working with College and University leadership. * Enhance the visibility and reputation of the Department. * Foster a collegial and inclusive academic environment. * Align departmental priorities with the College of Science Strategic Plan and UNR's strategic init future powered by knowledge. The University is also ranked by U.S. News \& World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.” Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land\-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics. The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290\-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025\. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as “University Village,” to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty. Collaborating with world\-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18\-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry\-level software engineers by graduation. In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada – led by the University of Nevada, Reno – was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state. Through its commitment to high\-impact education, world\-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150\-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world. The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

jobs.description: Posting Information **Department** Biostatistics \- CSCC\-462002 **Career Area** Information Technology **Posting Open Date** 09/29/2026 **Application Deadline** 10/13/2026 **Open Until Filled** No **Position Type** Permanent Staff (EHRA NF) **Working Title** Statistical Programmer **Appointment Type** EHRA Non\-Faculty **Position Number** 20078665 **Vacancy ID** NF0010047 **Full Time/Part Time** Full\-Time Permanent **FTE** 1 **Hours per week** 40 **Position Location** North Carolina, US **Hiring Range** $62,115 \- $87,000 **Proposed Start Date** 11/02/2026 Position Information **Be a Tar Heel!** A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world\-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn. One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community. University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** for numerous retail, restaurant and performing arts discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates on select campus events. UNC\-Chapel Hill offers full\-time employees a **comprehensive benefits package**, paid leave, and a variety of health, life and retirement plans and additional programs that support a healthy work/life balance. **Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit** Collaborative Studies Coordinating Center The Collaborative Studies Coordinating Center (CSCC) is a division within the Department of Biostatistics of the School of Public Health at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, NC (UNC). As the coordinating center for a number of multi\-center clinical trials and epidemiology studies, the CSCC provides study design, data management, statistical analysis, quality assurance, and study management services to a broad array of projects funded primarily by the National Institutes of Health (NIH). The organization includes faculty from the departments of Biostatistics, Epidemiology, and Medicine and research staff with training and experience in biostatistics, epidemiology, computer science/data management, and project management. Total employees currently number between 100 and 105\. The CSCC is responsible for approximately $32,000,000 in funding for 55\-60 contracts and grants, and an additional 65 subcontracts. The CSCC was established in 1971 as the Lipid Research Clinics (LRC) Coordinating Center and has operated continually since that time. To reflect the addition of new studies and expansion into new research areas, the LRC Coordinating Center changed its name to the Collaborative Studies Coordinating Center (CSCC) in 1984\. Major research programs currently include the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study (ARIC); Adolescent Medicine Trials Network for HIV/AIDS Interventions (ATN); SPIROMICS II: Biological underpinning of COPD heterogeneity and progression (SPIROMICS II); SPIROMICS GIC Support; Data, Modeling, and Coordination Center for PrecISE Network (PrecISE); Hispanic Community Health Study (HCHS); and Preconceptional health of Latinas and its association with child adiposity (HCHS\-FLOR). Information on these, as well as others can be found at http://www.cscc.unc.edu/cscc/index.php **Position Summary** This Statistical Programmer position provides SAS programming services to fulfill needs of the ongoing CSCC projects. Programming is done in response to written computing requests and involves sophisticated data management programming, producing complicated tables and graphs, and running statistical analyses. Work is performed under direction of a study’s lead programmer or study project manager or the center’s statistical computing manager. Study computing needs sometimes diversify beyond SAS to entail use of R, Python, JavaScript, and other statistical programming languages (e.g., MPlus, Stata). **Minimum Education and Experience Requirements** Master’s or Bachelors and 0\-2 years’ experience; or will accept a combination of related education and experience in substitution. **Required Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience** * At least one year of professional work experience in SAS programming for statistical applications. * Excellent SAS DATA step and SAS macro facility programming skills with demonstrated ability to develop, understand, and maintain complex programs to fulfill clinical study data management and reporting needs * Effective interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently with general guidelines and little supervision as well as in a collaborative team environment working with strict development requirements and guidelines. * Knowledge of statistical concepts is essential for understanding the context of the work and for communication purposes. Successful performance in this position will require a customer service orientation and the ability to pay close attention to detailed specifications as well as interest in understanding and meeting broader study goals **Preferred Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience** Experience using R, Python, and/or JavaScript for data management and analysis, including graphical displays. **Special Physical/Mental Requirements** **Campus Security Authority Responsibilities** Not Applicable.

jobs.title: Director of Manufacturing Quality Operations
jobs.description: **WHY VEIR?** Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, VEIR is a U.S.\-based designer and manufacturer of category\-defining superconducting power delivery systems built for the extreme energy demands of the AI era. By commercializing next\-generation superconducting technology into deployable, real\-world systems, VEIR delivers \~10× higher power density than conventional options, enabling "speed\-to\-power" where incremental optimization falls short. VEIR's initial focus is AI data centers behind the meter, with solutions engineered for repeatable deployment through reference designs and integrated controls, designed to incorporate learnings as deployments scale. **The Role** We are building the manufacturing and quality foundation for a new class of critical infrastructure products — including a liquid nitrogen (LIN) cooling system and a termination assembly — that will support live data center deployments. We are looking for a Director of Manufacturing \& Quality Operations to lead this foundation from the ground up: taking our products through pilot builds in 2027 and into a manufacturing and quality system capable of scaling quickly to support live data centers in 2028\. This leader will manage two functions — **Manufacturing Engineering** and **Quality** — and will be a critical voice in building the operational credibility our customers need to trust us with mission\-critical infrastructure. This role reports to the COO and works in close partnership with our internal design engineering team and our Cable Manufacturing team (a peer function producing cable assemblies in\-house, which does not report into this role but is a close collaborator). **What You'll Own** **Manufacturing Engineering** * Directly manage the Sr. Manufacturing Engineer – Termination Assemblies and the Manufacturing Engineer – LIN System, and grow the team as volume scales. * Drive Design for Manufacturability/Assembly (DFM/DFA) across both product lines in full partnership with our internal design engineering team, optimizing for lead time, cost, and quality. * Own the fabricator and contract manufacturer relationships for both product lines — sourcing, qualifying, and managing partners, and acting as a ruthless advocate for our cost, quality, and schedule requirements. * Bring in outside technical experts as needed (e.g., cryogenics, welding/pressure vessel, high\-power termination, controls integration) to close capability gaps and de\-risk critical design and process decisions. * Own the manufacturing readiness roadmap: successful pilot builds in 2027, transitioning to a production\-ready design and supply base that can support live data center deployments in 2028\. * Build a scaling plan (supplier capacity commitments, second\-source strategies, tooling/fixturing investment) so the organization can flex production up quickly if order volume accelerates. * Serve as a technical and operational reference point for prospective customers evaluating our manufacturing readiness and reliability. **Quality** Quality is being built as a company\-wide operating discipline, not a back\-office function — held to the same bar our own customers apply to their suppliers, and built with the same resilience mindset large infrastructure OEMs now expect across their supply base. This role builds and leads three areas, phased as follows: **Phase 1 – Quality Management System** * Design and stand up the company's Quality Management System from the ground up: a documented quality plan, defined control systems and written procedures for each quality function, and the traceability discipline (serial/lot tracking, calibration records, inspection and test records) needed to withstand external audit. * Establish document and revision control so engineering, quality, and manufacturing always work from the current released specification, including a formal process for reviewing, approving, and time/quantity\-bounding any deviation from drawing or spec. * Lead the organization through ISO 9001 certification for manufacturing operations by Q3 2027, establishing the quality management foundation and audit\-ready documentation this requires. * Define and own the longer\-term roadmap to extend ISO 9001 certification company\-wide, positioning us as a certified product developer and a credible, audit\-ready partner as we scale toward production — a bar increasingly expected by OEMs and infrastructure customers of their suppliers and partners. **Phase 2 – Supplier Quality** * Hire and build the Supplier Quality Engineering function and stand up a formal supplier approval process: preliminary supplier assessment, an audited quality\-system review scored against a standardized checklist, prototype/technical approval, a process audit during sample production, and a signed quality agreement (defining acceptable quality levels and non\-quality cost recovery) before any supplier ships production volume. * Scale part\-approval rigor— dimensional da nty and field quality issues (expedited replacement material, field rework procedures, on\-site support), customer complaint intake and corrective\-action reporting, and a cadence of customer quality/business reviews. * Ensure we can execute against whatever quality requirements our customers impose contractually — including customer\-specific supplier quality manuals, audits, scorecards, and reporting obligations — with the same discipline and rigor we require of our own supply base. #### **Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Partner closely with the Cable Manufacturing team lead to ensure end\-to\-end system quality and coordinated manufacturing planning, even though that team does not report into this role. * Represent manufacturing and quality readiness to leadership, investors, and prospective customers. * Build a repeatable, systematic approach to risk management across manufacturing and supply chain — treating it as an ongoing discipline rather than a one\-time setup. #### **What You'll Bring** * 10\+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations and/or quality leadership for complex electromechanical, high\-power, or critical infrastructure hardware. * Direct experience building a manufacturing engineering and/or quality function from the ground up — startup, new product line, or early\-stage manufacturing scale\-up experience strongly preferred. * People\-management experience leading manufacturing and/or quality engineers. * Deep working knowledge of DFM/DFA, contract manufacturer/fabricator management, incoming and first\-article inspection processes (e.g., PPAP), and supplier corrective action systems. * Experience standing up a Quality Management System and leading an organization through ISO 9001 (or equivalent) certification. * Experience building supplier quality programs end\-to\-end: supplier approval/audit methodology, PPAP or equivalent first\-article discipline, performance scorecards, and structured corrective action (8D or similar). * Experience building supply chain risk visibility (critical/single\-source supplier mapping, sub\-supplier exposure, bill\-of\-materials risk scoring) as a proactive discipline rather than a reactive one. * Comfortable operating with ambiguity at an early stage — able to build scalable systems while staying hands\-on with day\-to\-day execution. * Strong cross\-functional collaborator, especially with design/product engineering teams. * Excellent communicator, able to represent the company's operational and quality credibility directly to customers and partners. #### **Nice to Have** * Experience with cryogenic systems, pressure vessels, or high\-power electrical termination/connection hardware. * Experience in data center or critical power/cooling infrastructure. * Experience building supply chain resilience programs (geopolitical risk mapping, dual\-sourcing strategy, sustainability/EHSS reporting). **BENEFITS \& PERKS** Healthcare coverage with 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision 401(k) Retirement Savings Program 12 Company Holidays \+ unmetered PTO 12 Weeks 100% Paid Parental Leave for all new parents Stock Options Employee Assistant Program (EAP) Regular teambuilding, off\-sites, and lunch \& learns **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY:** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. We strive to respect the dignity and ‎‎independence of people with disabilities and are committed to giving them the same ‎‎opportunity to succeed as all other employees. VEIR is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description: **Summary:** VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti\-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.**Duties \& Responsibilities:** **Senior Manufacturing Engineer** ================================= *VIAVI Solutions — Fiber Instruments NPI \| Indianapolis, IN* **Summary** ----------- Join the founding members of a new Operations Engineering NPI team in Indianapolis, chartered with bringing VIAVI's next generation of fiber optic test instruments — OTDR modules, handheld fiber testers, optical power meters and sources, and automated fiber certification platforms — from R\&D into volume manufacturing. As the Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you own how these products get built: the process flow, the tooling and fixturing, the work instructions, and the qualification that proves the line can produce them repeatably and at cost. You will work in close partnership with R\&D in Indianapolis and VIAVI's prime fiber optic design center in St. Etienne, France, and with our internal and contract manufacturing factories. ***Note to Applicants: This is a factory process and industrialization role. It is NOT a product design, field service, or production supervision position.*** **Professional Growth and Tooling** ----------------------------------- We're building this team from the ground up and investing in the right engineer to help shape it: * **Photonics Process Training:** Structured ramp\-up on fiber handling, splicing, connectorization, and optical cleanliness control if you are coming from an adjacent electromechanical or electro\-optical background. * **Greenfield Ownership:** Define the process architecture, documentation standards, and tooling strategy for a portfolio, rather than inheriting someone else's. * **Global Exposure:** Direct working relationships with an international R\&D organization and with contract manufacturing partners. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- **Manufacturing Process Definition** * **Define the build process:** Own end\-to\-end manufacturing process design for new fiber optic instruments — process flow, assembly sequence, station definition, routings, and work content — from PCBA integration through optical subassembly, final assembly, calibration, and pack\-out. * **Optical assembly processes:** Develop and qualify processes for fiber handling and routing, bend radius control, splicing and connectorization, optical connector integration (SC/LC/FC, UPC/APC), adhesive dispense and cure, and optical subassembly alignment. * **Contamination control:** Establish connector end\-face inspection and cleaning protocols to industry standards and the broader cleanliness discipline that fiber optic assembly yield depends on. * **Line design and capacity:** Define line layout, station ergonomics, cycle time, line balance, and labor content; model capacity against forecast volumes and identify the constraints before they bite. **Design for Manufacturing and Assembly** * Partner with R\&D in Indianapolis and St. Etienne from concept phase forward, providing structured DFM/DFA feedback on part design, tolerance stack\-up, fastening and joining methods, optical accessibility, and assembly sequence. * Participate in design reviews as the manufacturing voice; quantify the cost and yield impact of design choices rather than asserting them. * Drive design changes that reduce part count, assembly time, scrap risk, and the need for skilled manual operations. **Tooling, Fixturing, and Equipment** * Specify, design, procure, and qualify assembly tooling, fixtures, jigs, and process equipment, working with internal resources and external suppliers. * Partner with the Senior Test Engineer to ensure assembly fixturing and test fixturing interfaces are compatible and CM\-ready. * Develop and execute equipment qualification and process validation protocols; own the data that proves a process is capable before release. * Build capital justifications for tooling and equipment in support of the Operations Engineering Manager's capital plan. **Documentation and Process Control** * Author and maintain manufacturing documentation: work instructions, visual aids, process specifications, assembly drawings, routings, and inspection criteria. * Lead PFMEA development and translate the output into control plans with defined process controls, reactio , including across time zones. * As a founding member of a new team, help establish team norms and practices in addition to individual technical delivery. * Report status against commitments, demonstrate self\-directed initiative, and mentor less experienced engineers and technicians as the team grows. **Pre\-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:** **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- **Education** * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical
