jobs.title: Junior Data Security Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What You'll Be Doing:** You'll be a contributing member of the Data Services team that builds and maintains the MCP server infrastructure powering enterprise security data operations at Verizon — vulnerability data tooling, data transfers to Google Cloud Storage, analytics data sharing, and the pipelines and services that connect it all together. You'll work on real services with real ownership — not in isolation, but alongside senior engineers who will help you build context and judgment. You're expected to complete assigned work end\-to\-end, ask the right questions when you're stuck, and grow your understanding of how the data platform fits together over time. You're expected to actively use AI tools in your daily workflow. This team works that way by design, and we expect Engineer IIs to come in ready to learn and apply those capabilities as a productivity accelerator, not just a convenience. Responsibilities include: * Contributing to the team's MCP server — building, maintaining, and extending MCP tools that expose vulnerability data and security datasets to AI agents and internal consumers. * Implementing feature work and bug fixes across data pipeline services under the direction of senior engineers — ingestion improvements, schema changes, and reliability work. * Building and maintaining data transfer pipelines to Google Cloud Storage — moving structured security data reliably between enterprise systems and GCS buckets. * Supporting data sharing integrations for analytics consumers — contributing to the services and exports that make security datasets available to downstream reporting and analytics platforms. * Participating in breaking\-change analysis when shared data schemas or MCP tool contracts evolve: understand downstream impact and surface concerns to senior engineers. * Contributing to internal tooling and operator\-facing surfaces where data platform capabilities are exposed — learning to think about what the consuming side needs, not just what the service provides. * Contributing to GCP\-hosted services and infrastructure work — deploying and maintaining workloads in Google Cloud Platform as the team expands its cloud footprint. * Implementing security remediations identified through assessment, including application\-layer vulnerability fixes and security configuration hardening, with senior engineer review. * Applying cloud\-native secrets management patterns under guidance: Key Vault integration, Managed Identity, encrypted connections, and JWT validation. * Writing secure code by default — parameterized queries, input validation at system boundaries, least\-privilege service accounts. * Participating in white\-box security reviews of internal services — beginning to read code with an attacker's eye and learning to identify common application\-layer vulnerabilities. * Contributing to documenting findings with specificity: file paths, line numbers, and reproduction steps under the direction of senior team members. * Translating security findings into working code fixes with senior engineer guidance on scope and remediation approach. * Using AI coding assistants as a daily accelerator — for navigating unfamiliar services, drafting code, and applying patterns across a codebase with senior review. * Generating and maintaining technical documentation with AI assistance — service overviews, data flow descriptions, and runbooks that help the next engineer. * Learning to validate generated code against the actual codebase, catch hallucinated APIs, and recognize when a suggestion needs to be overridden rather than shipped. **What We're Looking For** You're early in your career but past the very beginning. You take your work seriously — when you're assigned a service or a task, you dig in, ask smart questions, and see it through. You don't need someone to manage every step, but you know when to pull in senior eyes before making a call that's above your current context. You take security hygiene seriously from the start — credential handling, input validation, least\-privilege — and you apply those practices consistently, not just when someone's watching. You're curious about how data moves — not just the pipeline stage you're working on, but where the data came from, where it ends up, and what breaks if your piece gets it wrong. That end\-to\-end thinking m aintaining backend services, REST APIs, and data processing logic. * Familiarity with data pipeline concepts — understanding how data moves between systems, basic ETL patterns, and what can go wrong at each stage. * Understanding of common injection vulnerabilities and the importance of input validation and secure credential handling — especially relevant when working with vulnerability datasets * Exposure to cloud storage or data transfer patterns — GCS, S3, or similar object storage in a project or professional context. * Comfort reading unfamiliar code — you can follow data flow and find where the important logic lives even in codebases you didn't write. * Active or recent use of AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) — not just awareness, but a genuine attempt to build them into how you work. Even Better If You Have * Security\+ or equivalent foundational security knowledge, or active pursuit of it * Awareness of OWASP Top 10 or OWASP API Security Top 10 * Any exposure to SAST tooling or secrets scanning in a CI/CD pipeline * Hands\-on experience with GCS — reading, writing, and managing objects; understanding bucket structure and IAM access patterns * Familiarity with analytics data sharing patterns — exports to BigQuery, Looker, Google Sheets, or similar platforms * Basic familiarity with JWT / OAuth 2\.0 — understanding how tokens are issued and validated for service\-to\-service data access * Any exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) — understanding what MCP servers do and how tools are defined and consumed by AI agents * Hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub, IAM, or related services * Any experience with Azure DevOps, GitLab, or similar CI/CD tooling * Familiarity with database patterns — query design, connection management, or migration tooling (EF Core or similar) * Some exposure to TypeScript or a JavaScript frontend framework (React, Angular, or similar) * Demonstrated genuine use of AI coding tools — can speak to what you've tried, where it helped, and where you learned it needed checking * Ability to write clear technical documentation that helps another engineer understand what you built and why If Verizon and this role sound like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in\-person trainings and meetings.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries. ### **About the Role** We are actively looking for an experienced front\-end engineer to join our Web Platform team. capabilities of all web engineering teams. * **Innovate the stack:** Continuously evaluate, select, and design the architecture using next\-generation web technologies and frameworks. * **Own (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) and driving overall code quality. * **Forward\-thinking mindset:** Experience with or a strong interest in AI\-assisted development and integrating AI into engineering workflows. * Degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field of study. ### **US Employee Benefits** Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water.** We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support \- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. **What we do:** For 150 years, Watts has built best\-in\-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting\-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead. PURPOSE: Watts Heating \& Hot Water Solutions platform is seeking a highly\-motivated Controls Engineer to be part of their team at Blauvelt, NY. Under the direction of Controls Engineering Manager, the Controls engineer will work cross\-functionally to execute and deliver New Product Development (NPD) projects on time, within budget, and with adherence to the commercial specification. The Controls Engineer is responsible to design, development, and application of proprietary controls for hydronic heating and water heating systems from concept to acceptance working within the Heating \& Hot Water Solutions (HHWS) business unit and collaborating with other controls groups within Watts Water Technologies, Inc. The Controls Engineer will also be responsible to lead their assigned NPD projects.**Scope of Position** Watts Water Technologies is seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer I to support New Product Development (NPD) initiatives. In this on\-site role, the Software Engineer will collaborate cross\-functionally to design, develop, integrate, debug, and test embedded software for proprietary electronic control systems used in hydronic heating and water heating products. The engineer will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software architecture, implementation, verification, validation, and product release, helping bring innovative solutions from concept to market within the Watts Applied Solutions (WAS) business unit. This position does not have any supervisory responsibilities. The Software Engineer I reports to the Embedded Software Engineering Manager. This is an on\-site position located in Blauvelt, New York. **Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain C\+\+20 / Qt 6 applications for ARM\-based embedded Linux controllers used in commercial hydronic and water heating products. * Implement new features and resolve defects across the firmware stack, including UI screens, control logic, and I/O handling for analog inputs, RTDs, flow sensors, relays, and touchscreens. * Write clean, deterministic C\+\+ code suitable for real\-time control, avoiding dynamic memory allocation in time\-critical paths. * Integrate device communication over Modbus, BACnet, RS\-485/RS\-232, CAN bus, and Ethernet. * Build and cross\-compile firmware using CMake and Yocto toolchains; deploy binaries to target hardware via SSH for on\-device debugging in Qt Creator. * Write and maintain unit tests (Qt Test / GoogleTest) and Doxygen documentation per team coding standards (. clang\-format, license headers, enum constants). * Contribute to Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and packaging. * Use Git/GitHub for version control; triage issues, reproduce reported bugs, and submit changes through pull requests and code reviews. * Utilize AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) effectively and responsibly to streamline development, increase efficiency, and strengthen code quality. * Read schematics and PCBs to support hardware/software integration and lab validation against test benches. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Controls, Hardware, QA, and Product teams on NPD projects from concept to acceptance. * Assume responsibility for other projects assigned by the Embedded Software Engineering Manager or Company management. * Responsibility directly tied to Watts Values (Integrity, Accountability, Continuous Improvement, Transparency) * Travel up to 5%. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, electronics and communications, software engineering, computer science/engineering or related field. * 1\+ years of experience developing production\-level code using C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or newer preferred). * Experience with software development in a Linux desktop environment * Experience with version control using Git \& GitHub * Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, BACnet, CAN bus, Ethernet/IP, Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi, MQTT, and Cellular. * Familiarity with Schematic design and PCB layout * Excellent interpersonal skills, maintain strong working relationship with all internal groups * Proficient in business applications \- MS Office, Adobe Acrobat, etc. * Understanding of and adherence to appl , accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. * Punctuality and dependability. * Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. * Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. * Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. * Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer\-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. **Working Conditions:** While performing the job duties, you will be working on\-site at a manufacturing facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor and will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. You will be required to work in the office at the Blauvelt, NY location (Monday – Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. **Physical Requirements***: Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:* * *Ability to stand for long periods of time.* * *Ability to lift and carry up to \[insert amount] pounds.* * *Ability to push and pull up to \[insert amount] pounds.* * *Ability to physically move around manufacturing floor.* * *Ability to read documents and communicate clearly with management and coworkers.* * *Ability to wear personal protective equipment, which may include, but is not limited to, safety shoes, hearing protection, and safety glasses.* **Pay Range**: The expected salary range for this position is $88K \- $95K annually. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law. Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason. **\#LIOnsite** **Watts in it for you**: ***Please note that the following******benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles.*** * Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience * Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits * Family building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave * 10 paid holidays and Paid Time Off * Continued professional development opportunities and educational reimbursement * Additional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programs * Learn more about our benefit offerings here: https://tapintowattsbenefits.com/ **How we work:** At Watts, our culture is team\-oriented and supportive. Employees here genuinely care about the quality of their work, and about each other. Our people are the heart of who we are and contribute to our longevity and continued success. And this is a place where you can have a big career. No matter your role, there are opportunities for learning and development, and your daily contributions make a meaningful impact on the lives of people who use our products and on the future of water. jobs.title: Engineering Software Developer
jobs.description: Description: WireCrafters, LLC, established in 1967, is a manufacturer of wire partitions, storage lockers, safety barriers, and other related material handling products. Privately owned, WireCrafters has a reputation in the industry for its commitment to legendary customer service, rewarding work for associates, and producing the very best quality products. Learn more about WireCrafters at www.wirecrafters.com. Full\-time, Monday \- Friday. This position is based in Louisville, KY. Candidates should be able to reliably commute or relocate before starting work. After 90 days you will be eligible for benefits: * Health/Dental/Vision Insurance * Flexible Spending Account * Life Insurance * 401(k) * 401(k) Matching * Paid Time Off **GENERAL SUMMARY** WireCrafters is seeking an Engineering Software Developer to build and improve custom software used by our engineering and manufacturing teams. This role is focused on Autodesk Inventor automation, engineering drawings and the creation of configurable parts and assemblies through code. We are moving away from relying heavily on Autodesk Factory Design so we can create more flexible, customized engineering tools. The developer in this role will work directly with engineering users to automate repetitive CAD tasks and expand our internal design\-automation capabilities. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Develop and maintain engineering applications using C\#, VB.NET / Visual Basic, and the Microsoft .NET platform. * Use the Autodesk Inventor API to create, modify, and configure parts and assemblies programmatically. * Automate engineering drawings, including views, dimensions, annotations, parts lists, and related drawing objects. * Build tools for automated component placement, constraints, parameters, iProperties, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). * Improve and support existing VB and C\# engineering applications while helping modernize legacy workflows. * Work with engineers and manufacturing personnel to translate manual design processes into reliable software workflows. * Troubleshoot CAD automation issues and write organized, maintainable, documented code. * Assist with integrations between engineering software, Autodesk systems, databases, and other business systems as needed. What Success Looks Like * Create an Inventor assembly through code based on product or job requirements. * Automatically place and constrain components using defined engineering rules. * Generate accurate production\-ready drawings from configured assemblies with less manual drafting. * Reduce repetitive engineering work while improving consistency, maintainability and speed. * Become a dependable technical resource for both software development and CAD automation. Requirements: **SKILLS \& KNOWLEDGE** **Required Core Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software\-development experience, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, CAD, or design automation. * Working knowledge of C\# and the .NET ecosystem; ability to read, maintain, or develop Visual Basic / VB.NET code. * Experience with object\-oriented programming and Visual Studio. * Hands\-on experience with Autodesk Inventor or another mechanical 3D CAD platform. * Understanding of mechanical assemblies, engineering drawings, BOMs, parameters, and parametric modeling concepts. * Ability to analyze a technical workflow, work independently through problems, and communicate effectively with engineering users. * Experience with Git or another source\-control system. **Preferred Qualifications** * Autodesk Inventor API, iLogic, Autodesk Vault, or Vault API experience. * CAD API / automation experience with Inventor, SolidWorks, Creo, Solid Edge, AutoCAD, or a similar platform. * SQL / SQL Server, REST APIs, JSON, XML, or application\-integration experience. * Experience with product configurators, rules\-based engineering, automated drawing generation, or BOM automation. * Background in manufacturing, steel fabrication, engineered\-to\-order products, CNC data, or production systems. **Education and Experience** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field is preferred. An associate degree combined with strong relevant software/CAD automation experience will also be considered. Equivalent professional experience may substitute for formal education.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer (Engineer II)
jobs.description: **Job Summary** **Job Description** Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution is seeking a **Robotics Software Engineer** to join the National Deep Submergence Facility (NDSF). This is a regular, full\-time, exempt position and its eligible for benefits. This position supports underwater vehicles and associated oceanographic systems. The engineer will develop, integrate, test, and maintain software used to operate robotic vehicles, acquire scientific data, and turn data collected at sea into reliable scientific and engineering products. This position offers the opportunity to work on software that supports human\-occupied, remotely operated, and autonomous underwater vehicles, including HOV Alvin, ROV Jason, and AUV Sentry. The successful candidate will work with engineers, technicians, vehicle operators, scientists, and external collaborators in the laboratory and at sea. The work spans the full lifecycle of marine robotic systems, from design and bench testing through vehicle integration, field operations, troubleshooting, and post\-deployment analysis. The ideal candidate is excited to brainstorm creative engineering approaches to science problems, combine existing tools like ROS1/ROS2 with developing technologies like AI/ML, and validate them in the field under demanding conditions. We're looking for a self\-starter who gets fulfillment seeing their ideas come to life operationally. This is an Engineer II position on WHOI's engineering ladder. With some supervision to achieve assigned objectives, the engineer will identify and participate in engineering projects in support of scientific and research activities through demonstrated skill in robotics software, embedded or real\-time systems, scientific computing, or a related area. Assignments will require creativity, independent thinking, sound engineering judgment, and a proven understanding of fundamental engineering and research principles. The engineer will contribute to the continued development and modernization of WHOI's marine robotics software ecosystem. Current work includes maintaining operational ROS 1 systems; developing and deploying ROS 2 software; migrating proven capabilities between generations of the software stack; integrating navigation, control, sonar, acoustic, optical, and environmental sensors; improving simulation and operator interfaces; and developing reproducible pipelines for post\-dive navigation and scientific data products. Because these systems operate in remote and demanding environments, reliability, testability, observability, and clear documentation are central to the position. The engineer must be able to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team and must be willing to support vehicle testing and operations at sea. **Essential Functions \& Duties** * Conceptualize, design, implement, and test software solutions for underwater robotic vehicles and oceanographic instrumentation. * Develop and maintain modular robotics software in modern C\+\+ and Python on Linux\-based systems, primarily using ROS 1 and ROS 2\. * Integrate sensors, actuators, navigation systems, data loggers, operator interfaces, and vehicle subsystems using serial, Ethernet, UDP/TCP, CAN, and other device interfaces and protocols. * Contribute to navigation, vehicle control, mission execution, health monitoring, simulation, visualization, and scientific data\-acquisition capabilities. * Port and validate operational capabilities from legacy systems to modern software architectures while preserving interfaces, behavior, and data compatibility where required. * Develop automated tests, simulation tools, replay workflows, and regression datasets to verify software before deployment and to reproduce issues observed during field operations. * Diagnose and resolve software, networking, timing, sensor\-integration, and electromechanical system problems in the laboratory and at sea. * Process, analyze, visualize, and quality\-control vehicle and scientific data; contribute to reproducible post\-dive workflows and data products. * Participate in system design reviews, code reviews, integration tests, vehicle readiness activities, mobilization and demobilization, and field or at\-sea operations. * Prepare and maintain technical documentation, test plans, operating procedures, engineering reports, and software user documentation. May independently author reports or articles within the engineer's area of responsibility. * Communicate technical results and operational status clearly to engineering staff, vehicle operators, scientists, ship's crew, and collaborators. * Contribute to safe, reliable vehicle operations and follow applicable software\-development, laboratory, cybersecurity, and shipboard safety practices. So, let’s get to it! **A Little About Us** Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients. At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture. **A Little About You** You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are. **Position Overview** **Why Zelis?** Healthcare is one of the most complex industries in the world—and one of the biggest opportunities for AI to create meaningful impact. Zelis sits at the center of the healthcare financial ecosystem, connecting payers, providers, and millions of healthcare consumers. We’re investing in AI not simply as a productivity tool, but as a new way to build technology and solve complex business problems. At the center of that work is Apollo, our internal agentic AI platform. Apollo gives engineers the infrastructure, tools, controls, and reusable capabilities they need to safely build and deploy AI\-powered applications across Zelis. We’re looking for a hands\-on AI Platform Engineer to help build it. You’ll join while the platform is still taking shape and have meaningful influence over the technical foundations other engineers will build on. **What You’ll Do** This role sits at the intersection of AI, platform engineering, developer experience, and enterprise\-scale delivery. You’ll help turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into dependable platform primitives that engineers across Zelis can use to build real applications. You’ll have significant influence over how Apollo evolves—from the agent harness and execution environment to model and tool governance, context, observability, evaluation, and developer experience. **You will:** * **Build the core agentic platform.** Design and evolve capabilities across agent execution, workflow state and orchestration, context assembly, model routing, tool contracts, evaluation, observability, policy enforcement, and automated repair loops. * **Create safe execution environments.** Build and operate isolated agent runtimes across containerized, local, and simulation environments, supporting persistent sessions, testing, previews, adversarial review, and diagnose\-and\-repair workflows. * **Develop reusable platform services.** Help shape capabilities such as our AI Gateway, Context Engine, policy profiles, semantic models, project bootstrap tools, observability, and delivery integrations. * **Make thoughtful technology bets.** Evaluate emerging foundation models, coding agents, MCP technologies, workflow engines, developer tools, and commercial and open\-source platforms. Run disciplined experiments and turn the right ones into supported Apollo capabilities. * **Make security and governance part of the platform.** Build identity\-aware access, isolation, policy\-as\-code, auditability, and controls for model and tool usage so engineers can move quickly without creating unnecessary risk. * **Design for developers.** Create clear APIs, interfaces, documentation, and paved paths that allow application engineers to take advantage of sophisticated AI infrastructure without needing to understand every element of the underlying control plane. * **Learn from real\-world use.** Work closely with forward\-deployed/agentic AI and business\-unit engineers, understand what is working and where they are getting stuck, and turn repeatable patterns into reusable platform capabilities. **What You’ll Bring** We care less about matching every technology on a checklist and more about finding someone who has built complex systems, thinks clearly about tradeoffs, and is energized by the opportunity to help define how AI engineering should work at scale. **You’ll likely bring:** * Strong software or platform engineering experience, including building and operating production systems used by other engineers. * Experience w  reliability, maturity, cost, maintainability, and long\-term platform value—not simply technical novelty. * An understanding of identity, secrets management, network boundaries, audit logging, and policy enforcement in enterprise environments. * The ability to work through ambiguity, run focused experiments, make clear technical decisions, and adjust course based on what you learn in production. * Strong communication skills and an interest in working directly with engineers, product partners, security, architecture, and senior stakeholders to drive adoption. * Experience building an internal developer platform, AI or agent platform, or engineering productivity product is especially relevant. Experience operating in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated environment is helpful but not required. ***Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.*** **Location and Workplace Flexibility** Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In\-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies. While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in\-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule. **Base Salary Range** $180,000\.00 \- $247,500\.00 At Zelis we are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation packages. The base salary range allows us to make an offer that considers multiple individualized factors, including experience, education, qualifications, as well as job\-related and industry\-related knowledge and skills, etc. Base pay is just one part of our Total Rewards package, which may also include discretionary bonus plans, commissions, or other incentives depending on the role. Zelis’ full\-time associates are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well\-being, and financial protection. The US\-based benefits include a 401k plan with employer match, flexible paid time off, holidays, parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the role. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all. **Accessibility Support** We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require a reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email TalentAcquisition@zelis.com. **Disclaimer** *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities, duties, and skills from time to time.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Planner GPU Compute
jobs.description: Zoox made the world’s first purpose\-built commercial robotaxi, combining advanced self\-driving hardware and software. In order to ensure safe operation, low latency and consistent resource utilization are critical. The Planner Compute team is responsible for the performance of the largest single software component within the autonomy stack, the motion planner. The Planner Compute team is looking for an expert in GPU performance. You will instrument, monitor, analyze and optimize GPU\-based algorithms that are performance\-critical for our solution. The scope for GPU usage ranges from machine learning inference to custom CUDA kernels written specifically for the motion planner. ### **In this role, you will:** * Analyze performance metrics to identify GPU hotspots and optimizations * Contribute to the adaptation of our current planner to multiple GPU architectures with different resources * Optimize ML models for latency and GPU memory usage * Support engineers within Planner as a subject matter expert on CUDA \& GPU performance ### **Qualifications** * BS in computer science or related field and 6\+ years of experience. * Strong knowledge of CUDA as applied to recent GPU microarchitectures (e.g., Ampere, Blackwell) and experience debugging/optimizing GPU kernels using tools like Nsight. * Strong knowledge of C\+\+ and experience in large code bases, comfortable in Linux development environments. * Experience in development, debugging, and profiling of complex multiprocess systems (e.g., robotic systems, game engines). ### **Bonus Qualifications** GPU kernel development experience There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **What we do** Somewhere in the world this morning, a new hire opened a box and found a laptop that already had their name on it, their apps installed and their company's policies applied. Nobody at their company touched it. When that person leaves, the laptop comes back, gets wiped and goes to the next hire. That box is the output of our software. allwhere runs the full lifecycle of IT equipment for distributed companies: procure, deploy, retrieve, redeploy, retire. Our customers are IT teams at fast\-growing companies with employees everywhere, and they run their entire hardware operation through our platform and API. **Why this is a hard engineering problem** The hard part is that our product's output is physical. An API call has to become a purchase order, a technician imaging a machine at a depot, a courier in another country and a device coming back on time when someone leaves. Every one of those steps can be late, partial or reported inconsistently, and the platform has to stay correct anyway. That means building systems that model the real world honestly: long\-running workflows that span days and multiple external parties, data that has to stay consistent across services and partners, and an API that customers integrate into their own onboarding and offboarding automation. We operate worldwide, so it has to hold across regions, partners and edge cases we haven't seen yet. **What you'll own** You'll set technical direction for our core platform and API, raise the bar on how we design and operate systems, and ship. This is a hands\-on role: you'll write a lot of code, and the decisions you make about architecture, reliability and developer experience will define the product for years. We're a small company at an inflection point. The work you do in your first year will be visible in what customers can do with the product, not buried in a roadmap. **How we work** We're AI native. Every engineer works with Claude Code daily, and we treat AI agents as a core part of how software gets built here, not a productivity add\-on. You'll help shape how that evolves. Engineers own problems end to end, from a customer need through design, build, test and production. Cycle times are short and we deploy continuously. You'll work directly with product, operations and customers, not through layers. **Who you'll work with** You'll report to our VP of Engineering, who joined this year after ten years at Instagram, where he ran engineering for Reels. He came here for the same reason we hope you will: a small team, a real product with real customers, rapid growth, and problems that don't fit neatly inside one discipline. **What we need from you** * Deep TypeScript, with real production depth in Node (we use NestJS) and React. * You've built and operated systems at scale in a cloud environment. We're on AWS; you should be comfortable owning production there. * You've designed systems with real\-world messiness: integrations with external partners, asynchronous workflows, data that has to stay consistent across services. * You build software with AI agents every day and have opinions about how to do it well. We're an AI\-native team, so this is central to how you'd work here. * Strong product judgment. You can take a customer problem to a shipped solution and explain the trade\-offs to people who don't write code. **Helpful, not required** Event\-driven systems (we use SQS and EventBridge). Experience in logistics, marketplaces or anywhere else software has to move physical things. A track record of mentoring engineers. **What we offer** Generous base salary, depending on experience, plus equity. We're early enough that your equity is meaningful and your work directly moves what it's worth. Comprehensive health benefits, 401k, and PTO policy. Three days a week together in our NYC office; the rest is up to you. You must be authorized to work in the US. allwhere does not sponsor work visas at this time. VmrGwdjwRG
